entries.meaning: 离弃，丢弃；遗弃；抛弃；放弃
entries.example: They had to abandon the car when the road flooded.
entries.exampleZh: 道路被洪水淹没时，他们不得不弃车。

entries.example: The abandonment of the project left many workers without jobs.
entries.exampleZh: 该项目的放弃使许多工人失去了工作。

entries.example: Please write the full name instead of the abbreviation on this form.
entries.exampleZh: 请在这张表格上写全名，不要写缩写。

entries.example: I cannot abide people who talk loudly in the library.
entries.exampleZh: 我无法忍受在图书馆里大声说话的人。

entries.example: His abnormal behaviour worried his teachers and his parents.
entries.exampleZh: 他的反常行为让老师和父母都很担心。

entries.example: The machine has been working abnormally since this morning.
entries.exampleZh: 这台机器从今天早上起一直运转异常。

entries.meaning: 废除，取消；彻底废除，废止
entries.example: The government plans to abolish the old tax next year.
entries.exampleZh: 政府计划明年废除这项旧税。

entries.example: They demanded the abolition of the unfair law immediately.
entries.exampleZh: 他们要求立即废除那条不公平的法律。

entries.example: The debate about abortion continues in many countries today.
entries.exampleZh: 关于堕胎的争论在当今许多国家仍在继续。

entries.meaning: 突然的，意外的；唐突的，鲁莽的
entries.example: The meeting came to an abrupt end at noon.
entries.exampleZh: 会议在中午突然结束了。

entries.meaning: 缺席，不在；缺席的时间，外出期；缺乏，不存在
entries.example: In the absence of clear evidence, the police released him.
entries.exampleZh: 由于缺乏明确的证据，警方释放了他。

entries.example: Three students were absent from class this morning.
entries.exampleZh: 今天早上有三名学生缺课。

entries.example: I am absolutely sure that I locked the door.
entries.exampleZh: 我完全确定我锁了门。

entries.meaning: 吸收；吸引…的注意，使全神贯注；把…并入，同化
entries.example: Plants absorb water and nutrients through their roots.
entries.exampleZh: 植物通过根吸收水分和养分。

entries.example: His absorption in the book made him miss his stop.
entries.exampleZh: 他看书太专注，结果坐过了站。

entries.meaning: 抽象的；理论上的；抽象派作品；抽象的，抽象派的；摘要，梗概；抽象派艺术作品
entries.example: Her abstract paintings are difficult for young children to understand.
entries.exampleZh: 她的抽象画小孩子很难理解。

entries.meaning: 不合理的，荒唐的；荒谬的，荒唐的
entries.example: It is absurd to blame the weather for your mistake.
entries.exampleZh: 把自己的错误归咎于天气是荒谬的。

entries.meaning: 丰富，充裕；大量，丰富，充足
entries.example: In summer, this region has an abundance of fresh fruit.
entries.exampleZh: 夏天这个地区有大量新鲜水果。

entries.meaning: 丰富的，富裕的；大量的，充足的
entries.example: The region has abundant rainfall and very rich soil.
entries.exampleZh: 这个地区雨量充沛，土壤肥沃。

entries.meaning: 虐待；滥用；滥用；虐待；辱骂，毁谤；滥用；虐待；辱骂
entries.example: The new law aims to prevent the abuse of power.
entries.exampleZh: 新法律旨在防止滥用权力。

entries.meaning: 学院的；学术的；纯理论的，不切实际的；大学教师
entries.example: Her academic work earned high praise from the whole committee.
entries.exampleZh: 她的学术工作赢得了整个委员会的高度赞扬。

entries.example: New policies may accelerate the growth of small local businesses.
entries.exampleZh: 新政策可能会加快当地小企业的发展。

entries.example: Her acceptance of the offer surprised all of her close friends.
entries.exampleZh: 她接受那个提议让所有好友都很惊讶。

entries.meaning: 取得，获取；接近；通道，入口；接近的机会；存取
entries.example: Students need access to quiet rooms during the final exam week.
entries.exampleZh: 学生在期末考试周需要能使用安静的房间。

entries.meaning: 同谋，帮凶；附属的；附件，零件，配件；装饰品；同谋，帮凶，包庇犯
entries.example: This small accessory makes the whole outfit look far more elegant.
entries.exampleZh: 这件小配饰让整套服装显得优雅得多。

entries.example: The report says the accident happened just after midnight on Sunday.
entries.exampleZh: 报告称这起事故发生在周日午夜刚过。

entries.example: She accidentally left her keys on the kitchen table again.
entries.exampleZh: 她又不小心把钥匙落在厨房桌子上了。

entries.meaning: 适应，容纳；容纳；向…提供住处；使适应，顺应
entries.example: The new hall can accommodate up to three hundred guests.
entries.exampleZh: 新大厅最多可容纳三百位客人。

entries.example: We found comfortable accommodation near the station at a fair price.
entries.exampleZh: 我们在车站附近以公道的价格找到了舒适的住处。

entries.example: Her brother will accompany her to the interview tomorrow morning.
entries.exampleZh: 明天早上她哥哥会陪她去面试。

entries.example: With careful planning, we can accomplish most of the work today.
entries.exampleZh: 只要仔细规划，我们今天就能完成大部分工作。

entries.meaning: 符合；协议；相符合，相一致，相和谐；授予，赠与，给予；一致，符合；谅解，协议
entries.example: The two sides finally reached an accord after long talks.
entries.exampleZh: 双方经过长时间会谈终于达成了一项协议。

entries.example: All staff must act in accordance with the safety rules.
entries.exampleZh: 全体员工必须按照安全规定行事。

entries.meaning: 说明…的原因；占…；记述；解释；账目
entries.example: Her account of the event was clear and very detailed.
entries.exampleZh: 她对那件事的叙述清晰且非常详细。

entries.example: Managers are accountable for the safety of everyone in their team.
entries.exampleZh: 管理者要对自己团队里每个人的安全负责。

entries.example: My cousin works as an accountant for a large shipping firm.
entries.exampleZh: 我表弟在一家大型航运公司做会计。

entries.example: Interest will accrue on your savings from the first day.
entries.exampleZh: 你的存款从第一天起就会产生利息。

entries.example: Dust can accumulate quickly if you never clean these shelves.
entries.exampleZh: 如果你从不清理这些架子，灰尘会很快堆积起来。

entries.meaning: 精确的；准确的，正确无误的
entries.example: The witness gave an accurate description of the suspect's clothing.
entries.exampleZh: 目击者准确描述了嫌疑人的衣着。

entries.example: Do not accuse him before you have heard the full story.
entries.exampleZh: 在你听完整个故事之前，不要指责他。

entries.example: You must accustom yourself to the noise of the city.
entries.exampleZh: 你必须让自己习惯城市的噪音。

entries.example: I am accustomed to walking to work every morning.
entries.exampleZh: 我习惯每天早上步行去上班。

entries.example: She worked hard to achieve her goal before the deadline.
entries.exampleZh: 她努力工作，在截止日期前实现了目标。

entries.example: Winning the prize was a great achievement for the young team.
entries.exampleZh: 赢得这个奖项对这支年轻的队伍来说是巨大的成就。

entries.meaning: 酸的，酸性的；尖刻的，刻薄的；酸
entries.example: The acid in the lemon juice can damage your teeth.
entries.exampleZh: 柠檬汁里的酸会损害你的牙齿。

entries.meaning: 承认；告知收到；承认，承认…的权威；告知收到，确认；对…表示谢意，报偿
entries.example: We must acknowledge the help we received from our neighbors.
entries.exampleZh: 我们必须承认从邻居那里得到的帮助。

entries.meaning: 使认识，使了解；使认识，使了解；使熟悉
entries.example: Let me acquaint you with the rules of this game.
entries.exampleZh: 让我给你介绍一下这个游戏的规则。

entries.example: She is an old acquaintance from my university days in Boston.
entries.exampleZh: 她是我在波士顿上大学时的一位老相识。

entries.example: Children acquire language skills by listening to adults around them.
entries.exampleZh: 孩子们通过听周围成年人说话来获得语言技能。

entries.example: The government must take action to reduce air pollution now.
entries.exampleZh: 政府现在必须采取行动减少空气污染。

entries.meaning: 激活；使活动起来；使开始作用
entries.example: Press this button to activate the alarm system in the building.
entries.exampleZh: 按下这个按钮来启动楼里的警报系统。

entries.meaning: 严重的；急性的；灵敏的，敏锐的；精明的
entries.example: The patient felt acute pain in his chest last night.
entries.exampleZh: 病人昨晚感到胸口剧烈疼痛。

entries.example: She is acutely aware of the risks involved in this plan.
entries.exampleZh: 她敏锐地意识到这个计划所涉及的风险。

entries.example: It takes time to adapt to a new working environment.
entries.exampleZh: 适应新的工作环境需要时间。

entries.example: The film is a loose adaptation of a famous Russian novel.
entries.exampleZh: 这部电影是一部著名俄罗斯小说的松散改编。

entries.meaning: 上瘾，沉溺；有瘾的人；入迷的人；使成瘾，使入迷
entries.example: He became a drug addict after losing his job and family.
entries.exampleZh: 在失去工作和家庭之后，他成了吸毒成瘾的人。

entries.example: In addition to English, she speaks French and German fluently.
entries.exampleZh: 除了英语，她还能流利地说法语和德语。

entries.example: We need additional staff to handle the summer rush.
entries.exampleZh: 我们需要额外的员工来应对夏季的高峰。

entries.example: The mayor promised to address the housing problem this year.
entries.exampleZh: 市长承诺今年解决住房问题。

entries.example: The room was small but adequate for a short stay.
entries.exampleZh: 房间虽小，但短期住宿足够了。

entries.meaning: 粘附；追随；坚持；黏附，附着；遵守；坚持；追随，支持
entries.example: Please adhere to the safety rules while working in this lab.
entries.exampleZh: 请在这个实验室工作时遵守安全规则。

entries.meaning: 毗连的；紧接着的；邻近的，毗连的
entries.example: Our hotel is adjacent to a quiet park and a small lake.
entries.exampleZh: 我们的酒店紧邻一个安静的公园和一个小湖。

entries.meaning: 贴近，毗连；靠近；贴近；与…毗连
entries.example: The two gardens adjoin each other along a low stone wall.
entries.exampleZh: 这两个花园沿着一道低矮的石墙彼此毗连。

entries.example: You may need to adjust the mirror before you start driving.
entries.exampleZh: 你可能需要在开始开车前调整后视镜。

entries.example: This chair has an adjustable back and a soft seat.
entries.exampleZh: 这把椅子有一个可调节的靠背和一个柔软的座位。

entries.meaning: 管理，政府；局（或署、处等）；管理；管理部门，行政机关；实行，执行
entries.example: The administration announced new rules for all public schools today.
entries.exampleZh: 政府今天宣布了适用于所有公立学校的新规定。

entries.example: I felt great admiration for her courage during the difficult race.
entries.exampleZh: 在那场艰难的比赛中，我对她的勇气深感钦佩。

entries.meaning: 承认；承认，供认；准许…进入
entries.example: I must admit that I forgot to send the email.
entries.exampleZh: 我必须承认我忘了发那封邮件。

entries.meaning: 青春期的；青少年的；青少年
entries.example: Many adolescent boys struggle with sleep because of late screen use.
entries.exampleZh: 许多青春期男孩因深夜使用屏幕而睡眠困难。

entries.meaning: 采纳；收养；采用，采取；正式通过，批准
entries.example: The council plans to adopt a stricter policy on plastic waste.
entries.exampleZh: 委员会计划通过一项更严格的塑料垃圾政策。

entries.example: The adoption of the new law surprised many local business owners.
entries.exampleZh: 新法律的通过令许多当地企业主感到意外。

entries.meaning: 崇拜，爱慕；很喜欢；崇拜，敬慕；爱慕，热爱；非常喜欢
entries.example: I adore the smell of fresh bread in the morning.
entries.exampleZh: 我喜欢早晨新鲜面包的香味。

entries.example: Living near the station gives us a real advantage when commuting.
entries.exampleZh: 住在车站附近让我们通勤时具有真正的优势。

entries.example: This location is advantageous for shops that depend on foot traffic.
entries.exampleZh: 这个位置对依赖人流的商店有利。

entries.example: Their trip across the desert turned into a dangerous adventure.
entries.exampleZh: 他们穿越沙漠的旅行变成了一场危险的冒险。

entries.example: The young adventurer carried a map and very little food.
entries.exampleZh: 这位年轻的冒险者带着一张地图和很少的食物。

entries.meaning: 相反的，敌对的；不利的，有害的
entries.example: The medicine may cause adverse effects in some patients.
entries.exampleZh: 这种药可能会在一些病人身上引起不良反应。

entries.example: High sugar levels can adversely affect your health over time.
entries.exampleZh: 高糖水平会随着时间对你的健康产生不利影响。

entries.example: She showed great strength during a period of serious adversity.
entries.exampleZh: 在一段严重的逆境中，她表现出了极大的坚强。

entries.example: They plan to advertise the new cafe on social media.
entries.exampleZh: 他们计划在社交媒体上为这家新咖啡馆做广告。

entries.example: It is advisable to book your tickets well in advance.
entries.exampleZh: 最好提前预订你的票。

entries.meaning: 拥护；辩护律师；拥护，提倡，主张；拥护者，提倡者；辩护者，律师
entries.example: She is a strong advocate of cleaner public transport.
entries.exampleZh: 她是更清洁的公共交通的坚定拥护者。

entries.meaning: 空气的；航空的；飞机的，航空的；空中的，架空的；天线
entries.example: We fixed a new aerial on the roof to improve reception.
entries.exampleZh: 我们在屋顶装了一根新天线来改善接收效果。

entries.example: She works in aerospace and designs parts for small satellites.
entries.exampleZh: 她在航空航天行业工作，为小型卫星设计零部件。

entries.meaning: 美学的，审美的；悦目的，雅致的
entries.example: The new library has real aesthetic value as well as practical use.
entries.exampleZh: 新图书馆既有实用价值，也有真正的审美价值。

entries.example: He has always shown great affection for his old dog and cat.
entries.exampleZh: 他一直对自家的老狗和猫表现出深厚的感情。

entries.meaning: 使隶属于；附属机构，分公司
entries.example: This small company is an affiliate of a large international group.
entries.exampleZh: 这家小公司是一个大型国际集团的附属机构。

entries.example: Her political affiliation remained unclear to most of her new colleagues.
entries.exampleZh: 对大多数新同事来说，她的政治隶属关系仍不清楚。

entries.meaning: 断言，证实；断言，坚持声称；证实，确认
entries.example: I can affirm that the report was delivered before the deadline.
entries.exampleZh: 我可以确认，报告在截止日期前已经提交。

entries.example: Chronic back pain can afflict people who sit at desks all day.
entries.exampleZh: 整天坐在办公桌前的人可能会饱受慢性背痛之苦。

entries.example: We cannot afford a new car this year, unfortunately.
entries.exampleZh: 遗憾的是，我们今年买不起新车。

entries.example: The next item on the agenda is the annual budget.
entries.exampleZh: 议程上的下一项是年度预算。

entries.meaning: 代理人，代理商；政府代表；动因，原因；剂
entries.example: Our travel agent found a cheaper flight for the whole family.
entries.exampleZh: 我们的旅行代理为全家找到了更便宜的航班。

entries.meaning: 加重，加剧；加重，加剧，使恶化；激怒，使恼火
entries.example: Loud music late at night can aggravate your neighbours.
entries.exampleZh: 深夜大声放音乐可能会惹恼你的邻居。

entries.meaning: 总计的，合计的；总数，合计；总计达，合计；使聚集，使积聚
entries.example: The aggregate cost of the repairs came to three thousand dollars.
entries.exampleZh: 维修的总费用达到三千美元。

entries.meaning: 挑衅的；侵略的，好斗的；敢作敢为的；有进取心的
entries.example: His aggressive manner at meetings often makes his colleagues uncomfortable.
entries.exampleZh: 他在会议上咄咄逼人的态度常让同事感到不舒服。

entries.example: She could not hide her agitation before the important interview.
entries.exampleZh: 重要面试前，她无法掩饰自己的焦躁。

entries.example: He continued to agonize over the choice for several days.
entries.exampleZh: 他连续几天一直在为这个选择而苦恼。

entries.example: The injured climber was in agony until help finally arrived.
entries.exampleZh: 受伤的登山者痛苦不堪，直到救援终于赶到。

entries.meaning: 惬意的；同意的；令人愉快的，惬意的；同意的，乐意的
entries.example: The hotel staff were agreeable and helped us with everything.
entries.exampleZh: 酒店员工很随和，什么事都乐意帮我们。

entries.meaning: 援助，有助于；帮助，救护；助手，辅助手段；帮助，援助
entries.example: The charity provides aid to families affected by the flood.
entries.exampleZh: 这家慈善机构向受洪水影响的家庭提供援助。

entries.example: The flight attendant walked down the aisle with a tray of drinks.
entries.exampleZh: 空乘人员端着一托盘饮料沿过道走来。

entries.meaning: 惊恐，忧虑，警报；使惊恐，使担心
entries.example: The fire alarm rang loudly and everyone left the building quickly.
entries.exampleZh: 火警警报大声响起，大家都迅速离开了大楼。

entries.example: Alas, the store was closed when we finally got there.
entries.exampleZh: 唉，我们终于到那儿的时候，商店已经关门了。

entries.meaning: （收存照片或邮票的）册子；粘贴簿，集邮簿，相册
entries.example: She keeps every old photograph in a thick leather album.
entries.exampleZh: 她把每一张旧照片都放在一本厚厚的皮面相册里。

entries.example: This drink contains no alcohol, so children can enjoy it too.
entries.exampleZh: 这种饮料不含酒精，所以孩子们也可以喝。

entries.meaning: 机警的；提醒；警惕的；警觉的，留神的，注意的；使认识到，使意识到；警戒，戒备；警报
entries.example: The guard stayed alert throughout the long night shift.
entries.exampleZh: 那名保安在漫长的夜班期间一直保持警觉。

entries.example: My brother finds algebra difficult but he enjoys geometry.
entries.exampleZh: 我弟弟觉得代数很难，但他喜欢几何。

entries.meaning: 陌生的；外国的；外国人；外国的，外国人的；陌生的；性质不同的，不相容的；外国人，外侨；外星人
entries.example: The story describes an alien who lands in a quiet village.
entries.exampleZh: 这个故事讲的是一个外星人降落在了一个安静的村庄里。

entries.meaning: 使疏远，使不友好，离间；转让，让渡
entries.example: His harsh words could alienate even his closest friends.
entries.exampleZh: 他刻薄的话语甚至可能疏远他最亲近的朋友。

entries.example: The wheels need proper alignment after hitting that deep hole.
entries.exampleZh: 撞上那个深坑之后，车轮需要做正确的定位校准。

entries.example: The report will allege that the company hid the truth.
entries.exampleZh: 这份报告将声称该公司隐瞒了真相。

entries.example: The manager allegedly took money from the company account.
entries.exampleZh: 据称那位经理从公司账户里拿了钱。

entries.example: My sister is allergic to peanuts and always checks food labels.
entries.exampleZh: 我妹妹对花生过敏，所以她总是查看食品标签。

entries.meaning: 减轻，缓解；减轻；缓解，缓和
entries.example: These simple steps can alleviate the pain in your lower back.
entries.exampleZh: 这些简单的做法可以缓解你下背部的疼痛。

entries.example: The two countries formed a strong alliance against their common enemy.
entries.exampleZh: 这两个国家结成了牢固的联盟来对抗共同的敌人。

entries.example: The allied forces landed on the coast early that morning.
entries.exampleZh: 盟军那天清晨在海岸登陆。

entries.example: The school will allocate more money to the science department.
entries.exampleZh: 学校将拨更多的钱给科学系。

entries.meaning: 津贴，补助费；津贴，补贴；零用钱
entries.example: My parents give me a small monthly allowance for bus fares.
entries.exampleZh: 我父母每月给我一点零用钱用来坐公交车。

entries.example: This strong alloy is used to build aircraft wings.
entries.exampleZh: 这种坚固的合金被用来制造飞机机翼。

entries.example: France was a loyal ally during the long negotiations.
entries.exampleZh: 法国在漫长的谈判中是一个忠诚的盟友。

entries.example: She parked her bicycle alongside the old stone wall near the river.
entries.exampleZh: 她把自行车停在河边的老石墙旁边。

entries.example: Please arrange these files in alphabetical order before the meeting starts.
entries.exampleZh: 请在会议开始前将这些文件按字母顺序排列。

entries.example: We cannot alter the final schedule without the manager's written permission.
entries.exampleZh: 没有经理的书面许可，我们不能更改最终日程。

entries.example: The dress needs a small alteration before I wear it to the party.
entries.exampleZh: 这条裙子在我穿着去参加聚会前需要做一点小改动。

entries.meaning: 使交替；交替的；交替的，轮流的；间隔的；轮流，交替
entries.example: The two doctors alternate shifts every Monday and Friday morning.
entries.exampleZh: 两位医生每周一和周五早上轮流值班。

entries.meaning: 代替品；两者选一的，供选择的；另类的；替换物，选择；选择的自由
entries.example: We need an alternative route because the main bridge is closed today.
entries.exampleZh: 我们需要一条替代路线，因为主桥今天关闭了。

entries.example: You can take the train; alternatively, we could drive and share the fuel cost.
entries.exampleZh: 你可以乘火车；或者，我们可以开车并分摊油费。

entries.example: The amateur photographer won a small prize at the local fair.
entries.exampleZh: 这位业余摄影师在当地集市上赢得了一个小奖项。

entries.example: The British ambassador gave a short speech at the cultural event.
entries.exampleZh: 英国大使在文化活动中发表了简短讲话。

entries.example: The ambient noise in the cafe made conversation difficult for us.
entries.exampleZh: 咖啡馆里的环境噪音让我们交谈困难。

entries.meaning: 模棱两可的；分歧的；引起歧义的，模棱两可的，含糊不清的
entries.example: His answer was ambiguous, so nobody knew which plan he supported.
entries.exampleZh: 他的回答模棱两可，所以没人知道他支持哪个方案。

entries.meaning: 野心，报复；雄心，抱负，野心；期望得到的东西
entries.example: Her greatest ambition is to open a small school in her hometown.
entries.exampleZh: 她最大的抱负是在家乡开办一所小学校。

entries.meaning: 有雄心的；热望的；有抱负的，雄心勃勃的；有野心的
entries.example: The young team has an ambitious plan to finish the project early.
entries.exampleZh: 这个年轻团队有一个雄心勃勃的计划，要提早完成项目。

entries.meaning: 修订；修改，修订，改进；赔罪，赔偿
entries.example: The committee will amend the rules after receiving more public feedback.
entries.exampleZh: 委员会将在收到更多公众反馈后修订规则。

entries.example: The soldiers carried enough ammunition for three days of heavy fighting.
entries.exampleZh: 士兵们携带了足够三天激烈战斗的弹药。

entries.example: There is ample time to ask questions before the final session ends.
entries.exampleZh: 在最后一节会议结束前有充足的时间提问。

entries.meaning: 放大，增强；扩大；详述，进一步阐述
entries.example: We can amplify the speaker's voice with this small device.
entries.exampleZh: 我们可以用这个小装置放大演讲者的声音。

entries.example: The scientist measured the wave's amplitude with a simple ruler.
entries.exampleZh: 科学家用一把简单的尺子测量了波的振幅。

entries.example: The children watched the clown with great amusement and loud laughter.
entries.exampleZh: 孩子们非常开心地看着小丑，笑声很大。

entries.meaning: 类似的，相似的；可比拟的
entries.example: The two problems are analogous, so the same method should solve both.
entries.exampleZh: 这两个问题类似，所以同样的方法应该能解决两者。

entries.example: This device is a modern analogue of the old mechanical clock.
entries.exampleZh: 这个装置是老式机械钟的现代类似物。

entries.meaning: 相似，类似；比拟；比拟；类比，类推
entries.example: She used an analogy to explain the complicated process to us.
entries.exampleZh: 她用了一个类比向我们解释这个复杂的过程。

entries.example: Experts will analyse the data before they publish the final report.
entries.exampleZh: 专家会在发布最终报告之前分析这些数据。

entries.meaning: 分析，分析报告；分解，解析
entries.example: Her careful analysis of the results impressed the whole research team.
entries.exampleZh: 她对结果的仔细分析让整个研究团队印象深刻。

entries.example: He has a strong analytical mind and solves problems very quickly.
entries.exampleZh: 他有很强的分析头脑，解决问题非常快。

entries.example: My ancestor built this house more than a hundred years ago.
entries.exampleZh: 我的祖先在一百多年前建造了这座房子。

entries.meaning: 古代的；古代的，古老的；年老的，看上去很老的
entries.example: We visited an ancient temple during our trip to the mountains.
entries.exampleZh: 我们在去山里的旅途中参观了一座古庙。

entries.example: She hurt her ankle while playing football with her friends.
entries.exampleZh: 她和朋友踢足球时伤了脚踝。

entries.example: They celebrated their tenth wedding anniversary with a small family dinner.
entries.exampleZh: 他们用一顿小型家庭晚餐庆祝了结婚十周年纪念日。

entries.example: The host will announce the winner at the end of the show.
entries.exampleZh: 主持人将在节目结束时宣布获胜者。

entries.example: Loud music late at night can annoy the neighbours very much.
entries.exampleZh: 深夜大声放音乐会让邻居非常恼火。

entries.meaning: 每年的，一年一次的；年报，年鉴；一年生的植物
entries.example: The company holds an annual meeting for all its employees.
entries.exampleZh: 公司为所有员工举行年度会议。

entries.example: The group meets annually to discuss the budget and future plans.
entries.exampleZh: 该团体每年开会讨论预算和未来计划。

entries.example: In this battery, the anode releases electrons during the chemical reaction.
entries.exampleZh: 在这种电池中，阳极在化学反应过程中释放电子。

entries.meaning: 匿名的；无名的，不具名的；匿名的；无特色的，无个性特征的
entries.example: The writer chose to remain anonymous and never revealed her real name.
entries.exampleZh: 这位作家选择保持匿名，从未透露她的真实姓名。

entries.example: This plan should answer our needs without costing too much money.
entries.exampleZh: 这个计划应该能满足我们的需求，而且不会花太多钱。

entries.example: The old radio still works when we raise its antenna.
entries.exampleZh: 我们竖起天线时，这台旧收音机仍然能用。

entries.meaning: 期望，预期；预料，预期，期望；先于…行动，提前使用
entries.example: We anticipate a busy week because several important clients are visiting.
entries.exampleZh: 我们预计这周会很忙，因为几位重要客户要来访问。

entries.meaning: 古代的；古物；古时的，古老的；古物，古玩，古董
entries.example: She bought an antique chair at the market last Sunday.
entries.exampleZh: 她上周日在市场买了一把古董椅子。

entries.meaning: 焦虑；焦虑，忧虑；渴望，热望
entries.example: Her anxiety before the exam made it hard to sleep.
entries.exampleZh: 考试前的焦虑让她难以入睡。

entries.example: She thinks she is anybody, but nobody here agrees with her.
entries.exampleZh: 她以为自己是个重要人物，但这里没人这么认为。

entries.example: They rented a small apartment near the train station last month.
entries.exampleZh: 他们上个月在火车站附近租了一套小公寓。

entries.example: The teacher was worried by the apathy of her students.
entries.exampleZh: 老师为学生们的冷漠感到担忧。

entries.example: You should apologize to your sister for breaking her cup.
entries.exampleZh: 你打碎了姐姐的杯子，应该向她道歉。

entries.example: He offered a sincere apology for arriving so late.
entries.exampleZh: 他为迟到这么久致以诚挚的歉意。

entries.meaning: 器械，器具，仪器；机构，组织
entries.example: The lab has a new apparatus for measuring air pressure.
entries.exampleZh: 实验室有一台测量气压的新仪器。

entries.example: It soon became apparent that the plan would not work.
entries.exampleZh: 很快就明显看出这个计划行不通。

entries.meaning: 请求，呼吁, 上诉；求助，诉请；要求；有吸引力；控诉，移交上级法院审理；吸引力；呼吁；上诉
entries.example: The charity launched an appeal to help flood victims.
entries.exampleZh: 那家慈善机构发起呼吁，帮助洪灾受害者。

entries.example: Her sudden appearance at the party surprised everyone.
entries.exampleZh: 她突然出现在聚会上，让大家都很惊讶。

entries.example: He tried to appease his angry boss with a gift.
entries.exampleZh: 他试图用一份礼物来平息老板的怒气。

entries.example: The details are listed in the appendix at the back.
entries.exampleZh: 详细内容列在书后的附录里。

entries.meaning: 鼓掌；喝彩；鼓掌，喝彩；向…鼓掌，向…喝彩；称赞，赞许
entries.example: The audience began to applaud as the singer returned.
entries.exampleZh: 歌手返场时，观众开始鼓掌。

entries.example: Loud applause filled the hall after the final song.
entries.exampleZh: 最后一首歌结束后，大厅里响起了热烈的掌声。

entries.example: This kitchen appliance makes cooking much faster and easier.
entries.exampleZh: 这台厨房电器让做饭变得更快更省事。

entries.example: These rules are not applicable to foreign students.
entries.exampleZh: 这些规定不适用于外国学生。

entries.example: Each applicant must send two letters of recommendation.
entries.exampleZh: 每位申请者必须寄送两封推荐信。

entries.meaning: 申请，申请书；施用，涂抹；应用，实施；实用性
entries.example: She sent her application to three universities last week.
entries.exampleZh: 她上周把申请材料寄给了三所大学。

entries.meaning: 应用，实施，使用；适用；申请，请求；涂，敷，施
entries.example: Students may apply for the scholarship before May.
entries.exampleZh: 学生可以在五月之前申请这项奖学金。

entries.example: The board decided to appoint her as the new director.
entries.exampleZh: 董事会决定任命她为新的主管。

entries.example: The manager gave a fair appraisal of her work this year.
entries.exampleZh: 经理对她今年的工作给出了公正的评价。

entries.example: There was an appreciable drop in temperature after the storm passed.
entries.exampleZh: 暴风雨过后，气温明显下降了。

entries.example: She showed her appreciation with a warm handwritten note.
entries.exampleZh: 她用一封温暖的手写便条表达了感激之情。

entries.example: The audience was very appreciative of the young pianist's performance.
entries.exampleZh: 观众对这位年轻钢琴家的演奏非常赞赏。

entries.meaning: 方法；向…靠近；靠近；途径，方式
entries.example: We need a new approach to solving this problem.
entries.exampleZh: 我们需要一种新方法来解决这个问题。

entries.meaning: 适当的；适当的，恰当的；私吞；拨款供专用
entries.example: Please wear appropriate clothes for the formal dinner tonight.
entries.exampleZh: 今晚的正式晚宴请穿合适的衣服。

entries.meaning: 挪用；据为己有，占有；挪用；拨款
entries.example: The appropriation of funds for the new library was approved.
entries.exampleZh: 为新图书馆拨款的提案获得批准。

entries.example: The plan still needs official approval from the city council.
entries.exampleZh: 该计划仍需市议会的正式批准。

entries.meaning: 赞同；赞成，称许；赞成，称许；批准
entries.example: My parents do not approve of my late-night study habits.
entries.exampleZh: 我父母不赞成我熬夜学习的习惯。

entries.example: The journey takes approximately three hours by train.
entries.exampleZh: 乘火车这段路程大约需要三个小时。

entries.meaning: 恰当的；聪明的；易于…的，有…倾向的；恰当的，适宜的；聪明的，反应敏捷的
entries.example: His comment was apt and made everyone at the table laugh.
entries.exampleZh: 他的评论很恰当，让桌旁的人都笑了。

entries.example: She aptly described the situation as a quiet storm.
entries.exampleZh: 她恰当地把这种局面形容为一场无声的风暴。

entries.example: The teacher's arbitrary decision upset many students in class.
entries.exampleZh: 老师武断的决定让班上许多学生感到不满。

entries.meaning: 弧，弓形物；弧光；弧形；弧；电弧，弧光
entries.example: The ball flew in a high arc over the garden fence.
entries.exampleZh: 球以一道高高的弧线飞过了花园的篱笆。

entries.example: They walked under the stone arch at the garden entrance.
entries.exampleZh: 他们从花园入口处的石拱门下走过。

entries.example: The architect designed a bright house beside the river.
entries.exampleZh: 这位建筑师在河边设计了一栋明亮的房子。

entries.example: Few animals can survive the harsh arctic winter here.
entries.exampleZh: 很少有动物能在这里严酷的北极冬季中生存。

entries.meaning: 表演场地，竞技场；活动场所
entries.example: The concert filled the huge arena within minutes.
entries.exampleZh: 音乐会几分钟内就坐满了巨大的体育馆。

entries.meaning: 争论，争辩，辩论；主张；说服
entries.example: They often argue about money at the dinner table.
entries.exampleZh: 他们常常在餐桌上为钱争吵。

entries.example: Problems may arise if we ignore these early warnings.
entries.exampleZh: 如果我们忽视这些早期警告，问题可能会出现。

entries.example: The rebels plan to arm every volunteer before the final battle begins.
entries.exampleZh: 叛乱者计划在最后一场战斗开始前武装每名志愿者。

entries.example: The knight wore heavy armor before entering the cold stone castle.
entries.exampleZh: 骑士在进入冰冷的石头城堡前穿上了沉重的盔甲。

entries.example: The strange noise did arouse our curiosity late last night.
entries.exampleZh: 那个奇怪的声音昨晚深夜确实引起了我们的好奇心。

entries.example: We can arrange a meeting for next Monday if that works.
entries.exampleZh: 如果方便的话，我们可以把会议安排在下一个星期一。

entries.meaning: 整理，排列；安排；准备工作
entries.example: The flower arrangement on the table looks simple yet quite elegant.
entries.exampleZh: 桌上的插花看起来简单却相当优雅。

entries.meaning: （美观地）排列；陈列；展示；陈列，一系列；排列，队形；衣服，盛装；
entries.example: The store displayed a wide array of fresh fruit near the entrance.
entries.exampleZh: 商店在入口附近陈列了各种各样的新鲜水果。

entries.meaning: 逮捕，拘留；停止，阻止；吸引；逮捕，拘留，扣留
entries.example: Police arrest the suspect near the train station every morning.
entries.exampleZh: 警察每天早晨在火车站附近逮捕那名嫌疑人。

entries.meaning: 傲慢无礼的；傲慢的，自大的
entries.example: His arrogant tone surprised everyone at the small office meeting.
entries.exampleZh: 他傲慢的语气让小型办公室会议上的每个人都感到惊讶。

entries.example: The main artery through the city was closed after the accident.
entries.exampleZh: 事故发生后，穿过城市的主干道被封闭了。

entries.meaning: 善于表达的，发音清晰的；表达得清楚有力的；明确有力地表达；清楚地吐，清晰地发
entries.example: She can articulate her ideas clearly during difficult group discussions.
entries.exampleZh: 她能在困难的小组讨论中清楚地表达自己的想法。

entries.meaning: 人造的，虚伪的；人工的，人为的；矫揉造作的；模拟的
entries.example: The artificial lights made the small room feel bright and cheerful.
entries.exampleZh: 人造灯光让这个小房间显得明亮又欢快。

entries.example: The distant artillery shook the windows of our old farmhouse.
entries.exampleZh: 远处的炮火震动了我们那座旧农舍的窗户。

entries.meaning: 上升；攀登，登高；渐渐上升，升高；攀登，登上
entries.example: The hikers slowly ascend the steep path before sunrise.
entries.exampleZh: 徒步者在日出前缓慢地登上陡峭的小路。

entries.meaning: 查明，确定，弄清；弄清，查明；确定
entries.example: We must ascertain the facts before making any final decision.
entries.exampleZh: 我们在做出任何最终决定之前必须查明事实。

entries.meaning: 把…归于；把…归因于，把…归属于
entries.example: Experts ascribe the sudden decline to poor weather and weak demand.
entries.exampleZh: 专家把这一突然下降归因于恶劣天气和疲软需求。

entries.example: The sailors finally came ashore after three long weeks at sea.
entries.exampleZh: 水手们在海上度过了漫长的三周后终于上岸。

entries.meaning: 方面；方面；朝向、方向；样子，外表
entries.example: Safety is one important aspect of this new design.
entries.exampleZh: 安全是这个新设计的一个重要方面。

entries.example: Her greatest aspiration is to open a small school in her village.
entries.exampleZh: 她最大的志向是在自己的村庄里开办一所小学校。

entries.example: The magazine shows aspirational homes that few readers can afford.
entries.exampleZh: 这本杂志展示了一些很少有人买得起的令人向往的住宅。

entries.example: The stubborn ass refused to move from the narrow bridge.
entries.exampleZh: 那头倔强的驴拒绝从窄桥上挪开。

entries.meaning: 刺杀，暗杀；暗杀，行刺；中伤
entries.example: The police caught a man who planned to assassinate the mayor.
entries.exampleZh: 警方逮捕了一个计划刺杀市长的男子。

entries.example: The assassination of the leader shocked the whole nation.
entries.exampleZh: 这位领导人的遇刺震惊了全国。

entries.example: He was charged with assault after the fight outside the bar.
entries.exampleZh: 酒吧外的那场打斗之后，他被控袭击罪。

entries.meaning: 收集，组装；集合，召集；集合，聚集；装配
entries.example: We need to assemble the bookshelf before the guests arrive.
entries.exampleZh: 我们需要在客人到来之前把书架组装好。

entries.meaning: 主张，断言；断言，宣称；维护；肯定地说，断言；维护，坚持；坚持己见
entries.example: She will assert her opinion during the meeting tomorrow.
entries.exampleZh: 她将在明天的会议上坚持自己的观点。

entries.example: His assertive manner sometimes makes other team members uneasy.
entries.exampleZh: 他过分自信的态度有时让其他队员感到不安。

entries.example: Teachers assess our progress through weekly tests and projects.
entries.exampleZh: 老师通过每周的测验和课题来评估我们的进步。

entries.example: The final assessment will cover all the topics we studied.
entries.exampleZh: 期末评估将涵盖我们学过的所有主题。

entries.meaning: 资产，财产；有价值的特性或技能，优点
entries.example: A good reputation is the most valuable asset for any company.
entries.exampleZh: 良好的声誉对任何公司来说都是最宝贵的资产。

entries.example: The manager will assign each new worker a small task.
entries.exampleZh: 经理会给每位新员工分配一项小任务。

entries.meaning: 任务；指定的作业；分配，指派
entries.example: Our teacher gave us a difficult assignment about local history.
entries.exampleZh: 老师给我们布置了一项关于本地历史的难作业。

entries.meaning: 同化；被吸收，被消化；被同化；吸收，消化；使同化
entries.example: Children often assimilate a new language faster than adults do.
entries.exampleZh: 孩子们吸收一门新语言往往比成年人快。

entries.example: The assimilation of new ideas takes time in any culture.
entries.exampleZh: 在任何文化中，吸收新观念都需要时间。

entries.example: If you need assistance, please call the front desk.
entries.exampleZh: 如果您需要协助，请拨打前台电话。

entries.meaning: 把…联系在一起；使联合，结合；交往 [ə'səuʃiət]；副的；伙伴，同事
entries.example: People often associate the color red with danger and warning.
entries.exampleZh: 人们常常把红色与危险和警告联系在一起。

entries.meaning: 联系；协会，团体；联合，交往
entries.example: She joined a local association for people who love birds.
entries.exampleZh: 她加入了一个当地的爱鸟协会。

entries.meaning: 假定，认为；假定，假设；臆断；承担，担任；呈现
entries.example: We should not assume that everyone agrees with our plan.
entries.exampleZh: 我们不应该假定每个人都同意我们的计划。

entries.meaning: 假设；假定；假定，臆断；担任，承担
entries.example: His main assumption about the cost turned out to be wrong.
entries.exampleZh: 他关于成本的主要假设最终被证明是错误的。

entries.meaning: 保证；把握，信心；保证，表示保证的话；保险
entries.example: The doctor gave her assurance that the test results were normal.
entries.exampleZh: 医生向她保证检查结果正常。

entries.example: I can assure you that the package will arrive tomorrow.
entries.exampleZh: 我可以向你保证包裹明天就会送到。

entries.example: She stared at the empty room in complete astonishment.
entries.exampleZh: 她完全惊讶地盯着空荡荡的房间。

entries.example: The cost of the new bridge was absolutely astronomical.
entries.exampleZh: 这座新桥的造价简直是天文数字。

entries.example: He became interested in astronomy during his first year at college.
entries.exampleZh: 他在大学第一年对天文学产生了兴趣。

entries.example: The young athlete trained hard for the national competition.
entries.exampleZh: 这位年轻运动员为全国比赛刻苦训练。

entries.example: She joined an athletic club to improve her running.
entries.exampleZh: 她加入了一个运动俱乐部来提高跑步水平。

entries.example: He won several medals in athletics at the school games.
entries.exampleZh: 他在学校运动会上赢得了好几枚田径奖牌。

entries.example: She opened the atlas to find the small island.
entries.exampleZh: 她打开地图集寻找那个小岛。

entries.meaning: 气氛，空气；大气，空气；气氛，环境
entries.example: The restaurant has a warm and friendly atmosphere.
entries.exampleZh: 这家餐厅有着温暖友好的气氛。

entries.example: Every atom in your body came from ancient stars.
entries.exampleZh: 你身体里的每一个原子都来自古老的恒星。

entries.meaning: 缚，系，贴，附加；使依恋，使喜爱；使附属；认为有
entries.example: Please attach the photo to your application form.
entries.exampleZh: 请把照片附在你的申请表上。

entries.example: She felt a strong attachment to her old school.
entries.exampleZh: 她对母校有一种强烈的依恋。

entries.example: The sudden attack surprised everyone in the small village.
entries.exampleZh: 这次突然袭击让小村庄里的每个人都感到惊讶。

entries.example: She worked hard to attain her goal of becoming a doctor.
entries.exampleZh: 她努力工作以实现成为医生的目标。

entries.example: They will attempt to climb the mountain again next spring.
entries.exampleZh: 他们明年春天将再次尝试攀登这座山。

entries.example: The attendance at the meeting was higher than we expected.
entries.exampleZh: 出席会议的人数比我们预期的要多。

entries.meaning: 服务人员；侍者；（要人的）侍从；（病人的）护理人员；伴随的，随之产生的；服务人员，侍者，随从
entries.example: The flight attendant helped the passenger find his seat.
entries.exampleZh: 空乘人员帮助那位乘客找到了座位。

entries.example: His positive attitude helped the team through a difficult season.
entries.exampleZh: 他积极的态度帮助球队度过了艰难的一个赛季。

entries.example: The attorney asked the witness several careful questions.
entries.exampleZh: 律师向证人问了几个谨慎的问题。

entries.example: Bright colors attract many insects to the garden.
entries.exampleZh: 鲜艳的颜色吸引许多昆虫来到花园。

entries.meaning: 有吸引力的，引起注意的
entries.example: The hotel offers an attractive view of the sea.
entries.exampleZh: 这家酒店提供迷人的海景。

entries.example: Many people attribute their success to hard work and a little luck.
entries.exampleZh: 许多人把他们的成功归因于努力工作和一点运气。

entries.example: The old painting will be sold at auction next Friday evening.
entries.exampleZh: 那幅旧画将于下周五晚上拍卖。

entries.meaning: 正式会见；拜会；听众，观众；读者
entries.example: The singer thanked the audience for their warm applause after the show.
entries.exampleZh: 演出结束后，歌手感谢观众的热烈掌声。

entries.meaning: 真的，真正的；可靠的，可信的
entries.example: This restaurant serves authentic Italian food made with fresh local ingredients.
entries.exampleZh: 这家餐厅供应用新鲜本地食材制作的正宗意大利菜。

entries.meaning: 创造者，创始人；著作家，作者
entries.example: The author will sign copies of her new book this Saturday.
entries.exampleZh: 这位作者将于本周六为她的新书签名。

entries.meaning: 有权威性的，可信的；专断的，命令式的
entries.example: His report offers an authoritative account of the recent economic changes.
entries.exampleZh: 他的报告对近期的经济变化提供了权威性的叙述。

entries.example: Local authorities have promised to repair the damaged road before winter.
entries.exampleZh: 当地当局已承诺在冬季前修好受损的道路。

entries.meaning: 权威；官方；权力；当权者，行政管理机构；权威，专家
entries.example: She speaks with authority on issues related to climate change.
entries.exampleZh: 她在气候变化相关问题上说话很有权威。

entries.example: You need written authorization before you can enter the research laboratory.
entries.exampleZh: 你需要书面授权才能进入研究实验室。

entries.example: The manager can authorize small payments without asking the head office.
entries.exampleZh: 经理无需询问总部就可以批准小额付款。

entries.example: The company plans to automate several tasks in its factory next year.
entries.exampleZh: 公司计划明年将工厂里的几项任务自动化。

entries.meaning: 自动的；自动的；必然发生的；无意识的；自动机械
entries.example: The door has an automatic lock that closes after each visitor leaves.
entries.exampleZh: 这扇门有一个自动锁，每位访客离开后都会关闭。

entries.example: The lights turn off automatically when everyone leaves the office.
entries.exampleZh: 当所有人离开办公室时，灯会自动关闭。

entries.example: The region became autonomous after many years of peaceful political talks.
entries.exampleZh: 经过多年和平政治谈判，该地区实现了自治。

entries.meaning: 自治，自治权；人身自由，自主权
entries.example: Teachers in this school enjoy considerable autonomy when designing their own lessons.
entries.exampleZh: 这所学校的教师在自行设计课程时享有相当大的自主权。

entries.example: The hospital uses an auxiliary power system during unexpected electricity cuts.
entries.exampleZh: 医院在意外停电期间使用辅助电力系统。

entries.meaning: 有益于，有用；效用；有帮助；有益；有用；效用，利益，帮助
entries.example: His efforts to calm the crowd were of little avail.
entries.exampleZh: 他平息人群的努力收效甚微。

entries.example: Please check the availability of seats before booking the train tickets.
entries.exampleZh: 预订火车票前请先查询座位的可用情况。

entries.meaning: 可获得的，可利用的；现成可使用的，通用的；可取的；联系的；可得到的
entries.example: The new study rooms are available to all students after lunch.
entries.exampleZh: 午餐后，新的学习室可供所有学生使用。

entries.example: Quick action by the pilot helped avert a serious accident yesterday.
entries.exampleZh: 飞行员迅速采取行动，帮助避免了一场严重事故。

entries.meaning: 飞行（术）；航空，航空学；飞机制造业
entries.example: She hopes to build a career in aviation after finishing her studies.
entries.exampleZh: 她希望完成学业后从事航空业。

entries.example: Drivers should avoid the busy road during the morning rush hour.
entries.exampleZh: 司机们在早高峰时段应避开繁忙的道路。

entries.example: The public must awake to the danger of fake news.
entries.exampleZh: 公众必须认识到虚假新闻的危险。

entries.meaning: 奖，奖品；判定；授予，给予；判给，裁定
entries.example: The judges will award the top prize to a young local writer.
entries.exampleZh: 评委们将把最高奖颁给一位年轻的当地作家。

entries.example: She was not aware of the hidden costs until the final bill arrived.
entries.exampleZh: 直到最后账单到来，她才知道那些隐藏的费用。

entries.example: Public awareness of air pollution has grown sharply in recent years.
entries.exampleZh: 近年来公众对空气污染的意识急剧增强。

entries.example: The view from the mountain top was truly awesome at sunrise.
entries.exampleZh: 日出时从山顶看到的景色真是令人惊叹。

entries.example: The awful majesty of the storm left everyone silent.
entries.exampleZh: 暴风雨那令人敬畏的威严让每个人都沉默了。

entries.meaning: 尴尬的，棘手的，笨拙的；令人尴尬的；笨拙的，尴尬的；难操纵的，使用不便的；不灵巧的
entries.example: There was an awkward pause before she finally answered my question.
entries.exampleZh: 她最终回答我的问题之前，有一阵尴尬的停顿。

entries.example: The engine's axial movement was measured with a special laser device.
entries.exampleZh: 发动机的轴向运动是用一种特殊激光装置测量的。

entries.meaning: 轴，轴线；轴，轴线，中心线；坐标轴，基准线
entries.example: The planet rotates around an axis that passes through both poles.
entries.exampleZh: 这颗行星绕一条穿过两极的轴旋转。

entries.example: The broken axle kept the truck from moving another mile.
entries.exampleZh: 断裂的车轴使卡车无法再行驶一英里。

entries.example: As the baby of the family, he was often spoiled by everyone.
entries.exampleZh: 作为家里最小的孩子，他常常被每个人宠爱。

entries.example: My uncle remained a bachelor until he met a kind teacher.
entries.exampleZh: 我的叔叔一直单身，直到遇到一位善良的老师。

entries.meaning: 出身背景，经历；背景资料；背景，底子
entries.example: Her background in chemistry helped the team solve the difficult problem.
entries.exampleZh: 她的化学背景帮助团队解决了这个难题。

entries.example: We kept a backup of the files on a separate drive.
entries.exampleZh: 我们把文件的备份保存在一个单独的驱动器上。

entries.example: He cooked bacon and eggs for breakfast while the coffee brewed.
entries.exampleZh: 咖啡煮着的时候，他做了培根和鸡蛋当早餐。

entries.example: Some bacteria can survive in very hot water near deep sea vents.
entries.exampleZh: 有些细菌能在深海热泉附近的极热水中存活。

entries.example: A single bacterium can multiply quickly under the right conditions.
entries.exampleZh: 在合适的条件下，一个细菌能迅速繁殖。

entries.meaning: 标记, 徽章；徽章，像章；标志
entries.example: The officer showed his badge before entering the crowded hall.
entries.exampleZh: 那名警官进入拥挤的大厅前出示了他的徽章。

entries.meaning: 使迷惑，困惑；使挫折；迷惑
entries.example: The complicated instructions on the form baffle most new employees.
entries.exampleZh: 表格上复杂的说明让大多数新员工感到困惑。

entries.example: The old man put fresh bait on his hook before fishing.
entries.exampleZh: 那位老人在钓鱼前把新鲜的鱼饵放在鱼钩上。

entries.example: We drank tea on the balcony and watched the sunset.
entries.exampleZh: 我们在阳台上喝茶，看着日落。

entries.example: The bald man wore a warm hat in the cold wind.
entries.exampleZh: 那个秃头男人在寒风中戴着一顶暖和的帽子。

entries.meaning: 芭蕾；芭蕾舞；芭蕾舞剧；芭蕾舞，芭蕾舞剧；芭蕾舞团
entries.example: She has studied ballet since she was a young girl.
entries.exampleZh: 她从小就学习芭蕾舞。

entries.example: The panda sat quietly and chewed fresh bamboo for hours.
entries.exampleZh: 熊猫安静地坐着，嚼了几个小时的新鲜竹子。

entries.meaning: 乐队；群，伙；带；条纹；波段；用带绑扎
entries.example: The local band played three songs at the school festival.
entries.exampleZh: 当地乐队在学校庆典上演奏了三首歌。

entries.meaning: 绷带，包带；绷带；用绷带绑扎
entries.example: The nurse wrapped a clean bandage around his injured arm.
entries.exampleZh: 护士用干净的绷带包住了他受伤的手臂。

entries.example: A masked bandit escaped with the money before police arrived.
entries.exampleZh: 一名蒙面歹徒在警察到来前带着钱逃走了。

entries.meaning: 猛击，猛撞；发出砰的一声，砰砰地响；砰地敲；巨响；枪声；猛击
entries.example: The door closed with a loud bang and woke the baby.
entries.exampleZh: 门砰的一声关上了，把婴儿吵醒了。

entries.example: I bank at the small branch near my apartment.
entries.exampleZh: 我在公寓附近的那家小分行办理银行业务。

entries.example: The wealthy banker donated a large sum to the hospital.
entries.exampleZh: 那位富有的银行家向医院捐了一大笔钱。

entries.example: Bad investments could bankrupt the small family business.
entries.exampleZh: 糟糕的投资可能会让这家小型家族企业破产。

entries.meaning: 宴会，盛会，酒席；宴会，盛宴
entries.example: The hotel prepared a grand banquet for the visiting guests.
entries.exampleZh: 酒店为来访的客人准备了一场盛大的宴会。

entries.meaning: 几乎不，仅仅；勉强；仅仅；仅仅，只不过，几乎不
entries.example: She could barely hear his voice over the noisy crowd.
entries.exampleZh: 在嘈杂的人群中，她几乎听不见他的声音。

entries.meaning: 讨价还价；特价商品；协议，交易
entries.example: This jacket was a real bargain at half the price.
entries.exampleZh: 这件夹克以半价买到，真是划算。

entries.example: A long barge moved slowly along the quiet river.
entries.exampleZh: 一艘长驳船沿着安静的河慢慢移动。

entries.example: Farmers in this region grow barley for making bread and beer.
entries.exampleZh: 这个地区的农民种植大麦来制作面包和啤酒。

entries.example: The old barometer on the wall predicts rain before noon.
entries.exampleZh: 墙上的旧气压计预测中午前会下雨。

entries.example: The wealthy baron owned several large estates across the country.
entries.exampleZh: 那位富有的男爵在全国拥有几处大庄园。

entries.meaning: 贫瘠的；不孕的；贫瘠的，荒芜的；不结果实的，不育的；无益的，没有结果的
entries.example: The dry, barren land could not support any crops.
entries.exampleZh: 这片干旱贫瘠的土地无法养活任何庄稼。

entries.meaning: 路障，栅栏，障碍；设路障于，挡住
entries.example: The police built a barricade across the narrow street.
entries.exampleZh: 警察在这条狭窄的街道上设置了路障。

entries.meaning: 障碍，阻碍；栅栏；检票口；屏障；障碍，隔阂
entries.example: Language can be a serious barrier when you work abroad.
entries.exampleZh: 在国外工作时，语言可能成为一个严重的障碍。

entries.example: My brother plays baseball every Saturday with his friends.
entries.exampleZh: 我哥哥每周六都和朋友一起打棒球。

entries.example: We keep old furniture in the cold basement.
entries.exampleZh: 我们把旧家具存放在寒冷的地下室里。

entries.example: The Amazon basin covers a huge area of South America.
entries.exampleZh: 亚马孙河流域覆盖了南美洲的一大片地区。

entries.example: We meet on a regular basis to discuss our progress.
entries.exampleZh: 我们定期见面讨论进展情况。

entries.meaning: 一批，一组，一群；一批生产量
entries.example: She baked a fresh batch of cookies for the guests.
entries.exampleZh: 她为客人们烤了一批新鲜的饼干。

entries.example: Pour the batter into the pan and bake it.
entries.exampleZh: 把面糊倒进烤盘里，然后烘烤。

entries.example: My phone battery died during the long journey.
entries.exampleZh: 我的手机电池在漫长的旅途中没电了。

entries.example: The soldiers fought a fierce battle near the river.
entries.exampleZh: 士兵们在河边打了一场激烈的战斗。

entries.example: We bought fresh spices at the busy local bazaar.
entries.exampleZh: 我们在热闹的当地集市上买了新鲜的香料。

entries.example: A single bead of sweat rolled down his forehead.
entries.exampleZh: 一颗汗珠从他的额头上滚落下来。

entries.meaning: 发光，发热；开怀大笑；面露喜色；定向发出，播送；梁，横梁；束，柱；笑容，喜色
entries.example: A bright beam of light came through the window.
entries.exampleZh: 一道明亮的光束从窗户照了进来。

entries.meaning: 方位；（机器的）承座；轴承；忍受
entries.example: The loud noise had no bearing on our final decision.
entries.exampleZh: 那声巨响对我们的最终决定没有影响。

entries.example: The river bed was completely dry after the long summer.
entries.exampleZh: 漫长的夏天过后，河床完全干涸了。

entries.example: A small black beetle crawled across the kitchen floor.
entries.exampleZh: 一只黑色的小甲虫爬过厨房的地板。

entries.example: Please tell me beforehand if you plan to visit.
entries.exampleZh: 如果你打算来访，请提前告诉我。

entries.meaning: 表现，举止；运转，做出反应；检点自己的行为
entries.example: Please behave politely during the whole school visit.
entries.exampleZh: 在整次学校参观期间请举止礼貌。

entries.example: His rude behavior surprised everyone at the dinner table.
entries.exampleZh: 他粗鲁的举止让餐桌上的每个人都很吃惊。

entries.example: The little boy lay on his belly to watch the ants.
entries.exampleZh: 小男孩趴在地上，肚子贴着地面看蚂蚁。

entries.example: Many farmers bemoan the lack of rain this summer.
entries.exampleZh: 许多农民抱怨今年夏天雨水太少。

entries.example: The workers refused to bend to the manager's unfair demands.
entries.exampleZh: 工人们拒绝屈从于经理不公平的要求。

entries.example: Regular exercise is beneficial for both body and mind.
entries.exampleZh: 经常锻炼对身体和心理都有益。

entries.meaning: 得益；利益，恩惠；救济金，保险金，津贴；有益于
entries.example: The new policy will benefit thousands of families in the region.
entries.exampleZh: 新政策将使该地区成千上万的家庭受益。

entries.example: The queen decided to bestow a special honour on the young soldier.
entries.exampleZh: 女王决定授予那位年轻士兵一项特殊的荣誉。

entries.meaning: 背叛，出卖；失信于，辜负；泄露；暴露，显露
entries.example: He would never betray a friend for money or power.
entries.exampleZh: 他绝不会为了金钱或权力而背叛朋友。

entries.example: The two houses are close together, with a garden between.
entries.exampleZh: 两栋房子靠得很近，中间隔着一个花园。

entries.example: The waiter asked which beverage I would like with my meal.
entries.exampleZh: 服务员问我想配餐喝什么饮料。

entries.example: Beware of dogs that guard this narrow path at night.
entries.exampleZh: 当心夜里看守这条小路的狗。

entries.meaning: 迷惑，把…弄糊涂；使迷惑；使难住
entries.example: The complicated instructions bewilder most of the new employees.
entries.exampleZh: 复杂的说明让大多数新员工感到困惑。

entries.meaning: 在更远处，再往后；在…的那边，远于；迟于；越出
entries.example: The forest continues far beyond, reaching the edge of the map.
entries.exampleZh: 森林一直延伸到远处，直到地图的边缘。

entries.example: The judge showed no bias during the long and difficult trial.
entries.exampleZh: 法官在漫长而艰难的审判中没有表现出任何偏见。

entries.example: Her essay ends with a short bibliography of useful sources.
entries.exampleZh: 她的论文结尾附有一份简短的参考书目。

entries.example: Several companies will bid for the contract next Monday.
entries.exampleZh: 几家公司将在下周一为这份合同报价。

entries.example: She studied biochemistry at university and now works in a lab.
entries.exampleZh: 她在大学学习生物化学，现在在一家实验室工作。

entries.example: Cutting down the forest threatens the biodiversity of this whole region.
entries.exampleZh: 砍伐森林威胁着整个地区的生物多样性。

entries.example: He is writing a biography of a famous local painter.
entries.exampleZh: 他正在为一位著名的本地画家写传记。

entries.example: The new law received strong bipartisan support in both houses.
entries.exampleZh: 这项新法律在参众两院都获得了两党的强烈支持。

entries.example: The bishop gave a short speech after the Sunday service.
entries.exampleZh: 主教在周日礼拜后作了简短的讲话。

entries.example: Losing the final match was a bitter experience for the whole team.
entries.exampleZh: 输掉决赛对全队来说是一次痛苦的经历。

entries.example: She hid her bitterness behind a cheerful smile at the party.
entries.exampleZh: 在聚会上，她用快乐的微笑掩盖了内心的辛酸。

entries.meaning: 古怪的；奇怪的；奇形怪状的，怪诞的
entries.example: His bizarre behavior at dinner surprised everyone at the table.
entries.exampleZh: 他在晚餐时的古怪举动让桌旁所有人都很吃惊。

entries.example: The village blacksmith repaired our broken gate in one afternoon.
entries.exampleZh: 村里的铁匠在一个下午就修好了我们损坏的大门。

entries.example: Please do not blame me for the mistake in the report.

entries.exampleZh: 他试着为女儿创作一首短歌。

entries.example: Her conception of justice changed after studying the case.
entries.exampleZh: 她研究此案后对正义的理解发生了变化。

entries.meaning: 所关切的事；商行；关切的事，有关的事；关心，挂念；关系，关联；公司，企业；涉及，有关；使关心，使担心
entries.example: Your health is my main concern at the moment.
entries.exampleZh: 目前你的健康是我最关心的事。

entries.example: The two teams acted in concert to finish the project early.
entries.exampleZh: 两个团队协同行动，提前完成了项目。

entries.example: The company made a small concession to the workers' demands.
entries.exampleZh: 公司对工人的要求作出了小幅让步。

entries.example: Please give a concise answer instead of a long explanation.
entries.exampleZh: 请给出简明的答案，而不是冗长的解释。

entries.meaning: 结束，终了；推断出，推论出；缔结，议定
entries.example: The meeting will conclude with a short question and answer session.
entries.exampleZh: 会议将以简短的问答环节结束。

entries.meaning: 得出结论的；确实的；最后的；决定性的
entries.example: The new evidence was conclusive, so the judge closed the case quickly.
entries.exampleZh: 新证据是决定性的，因此法官迅速结了案。

entries.example: We need a concrete plan before we start the project next week.
entries.exampleZh: 我们需要一个具体的计划，然后下周开始这个项目。

entries.meaning: 谴责，指责；判…刑，宣告…有罪
entries.example: World leaders quickly condemn any attack on innocent civilians.
entries.exampleZh: 世界各国领导人迅速谴责任何针对无辜平民的袭击。

entries.meaning: 使冷凝，使凝结；浓缩，压缩，简缩
entries.example: Please condense your report into two pages for the meeting.
entries.exampleZh: 请把你的报告压缩成两页，供会议使用。

entries.meaning: 引导，管理；举止，行为；指导；管理，实施 [kən'dʌkt]；进行；管理，指挥，引导；传输，传导
entries.example: Her conduct during the interview impressed everyone in the room.
entries.exampleZh: 她在面试中的举止让在场的每个人都很赞赏。

entries.meaning: 授予；商谈，商议；授予，赋予
entries.example: The university will confer an honorary degree on her next month.
entries.exampleZh: 大学将在下个月授予她荣誉学位。

entries.example: She will present her research at the international conference in June.
entries.exampleZh: 她将在六月的国际会议上介绍自己的研究。

entries.example: I must confess that I forgot about our appointment yesterday.
entries.exampleZh: 我必须承认，我忘了昨天我们的约定。

entries.meaning: 私房话，秘密，机密；信任，信赖；信心，自信
entries.example: Her confidence grew as she practiced speaking in front of others.
entries.exampleZh: 随着她在众人面前练习发言，她的信心增强了。

entries.example: I feel confident that we can finish the task on time.
entries.exampleZh: 我相信我们能按时完成任务。

entries.meaning: 机密的；秘密的；亲信的；秘密的，机密的；表示信任的；担任机密工作的
entries.example: Please keep this report confidential until the board makes a decision.
entries.exampleZh: 在董事会做出决定之前，请对这份报告保密。

entries.example: The technician changed the configuration of the network to improve speed.
entries.exampleZh: 技术员改动了网络的配置以提高速度。

entries.meaning: 限制；限制，使局限；使不外出，禁闭
entries.example: Please confine your comments to the topic we are discussing.
entries.exampleZh: 请把你的评论限制在我们正在讨论的话题上。

entries.example: Could you confirm the date of our flight before booking the hotel?
entries.exampleZh: 你能在订酒店之前确认我们航班的日期吗？

entries.example: We received confirmation that the parcel will arrive on Friday.
entries.exampleZh: 我们收到了确认，包裹将在周五送达。

entries.meaning: 冲突；冲突，抵触；冲突，抵触；争论；战斗，战争
entries.example: There is a serious conflict between the two departments over budget.
entries.exampleZh: 两个部门在预算问题上存在严重冲突。

entries.meaning: 使遵守；一致；遵守，适应；顺从；相似，一致，符合
entries.example: All new buildings must conform to the latest safety standards.
entries.exampleZh: 所有新建筑都必须符合最新的安全标准。

entries.example: Their strict conformity to the rules annoyed some younger members.
entries.exampleZh: 他们对规则的严格遵守让一些年轻成员感到不快。

entries.meaning: 使面对；使对证；迎面遇到，遭遇；勇敢地面对，正视；使对质，使当面对证
entries.example: She had to confront her fear of speaking in public.
entries.exampleZh: 她不得不正视自己在公开场合发言的恐惧。

entries.example: His confrontational tone made the discussion far more difficult.
entries.exampleZh: 他那种对抗性的语气让讨论变得困难得多。

entries.example: There was some confusion about the new timetable at first.
entries.exampleZh: 起初，大家对新的时间表有些困惑。

entries.example: She attended a medical congress in Berlin last week.
entries.exampleZh: 她上周在柏林参加了一个医学代表大会。

entries.meaning: 连接；联系；连接物，连接点；亲戚
entries.example: There is a clear connection between smoking and heart disease.
entries.exampleZh: 吸烟与心脏病之间有明显的联系。

entries.example: It took the team three years to conquer the local market.
entries.exampleZh: 这支团队花了三年时间才征服当地市场。

entries.example: The famous conqueror built a huge empire in only ten years.
entries.exampleZh: 这位著名的征服者仅用十年就建立了一个庞大的帝国。

entries.meaning: 有良心的，认真负责的；认真的，勤勤恳恳的
entries.example: She is a conscientious worker who checks every detail twice.
entries.exampleZh: 她是个认真负责的员工，每个细节都要检查两遍。

entries.meaning: 意识到的，自觉的；神志清醒的；有意的，存心的
entries.example: He was conscious of a slight pain in his knee.
entries.exampleZh: 他感觉到膝盖有轻微的疼痛。

entries.example: The patient lost consciousness for a few minutes after the fall.
entries.exampleZh: 跌倒后，那位病人失去了几分钟的知觉。

entries.example: Our team won five consecutive games before the final match.
entries.exampleZh: 在决赛之前，我们队连赢了五场比赛。

entries.meaning: 共识，一致；一致，一致同意
entries.example: After a long discussion, the group reached a consensus.
entries.exampleZh: 经过长时间的讨论，小组达成了共识。

entries.example: Her parents gave their consent to the school trip.
entries.exampleZh: 她的父母同意了她参加学校旅行。

entries.meaning: 重要（性），重大意义；结果，后果；重要，重大
entries.example: He never thought about the consequence of his careless words.
entries.exampleZh: 他从未想过自己轻率的话会带来什么后果。

entries.meaning: 作为结果的；必然的；作为结果的，随之发生的
entries.example: The heavy rain and the consequent floods closed many roads.
entries.exampleZh: 大雨以及随之而来的洪水使许多道路封闭。

entries.example: He missed the bus and consequently arrived late for work.
entries.exampleZh: 他错过了公交车，因此上班迟到了。

entries.meaning: 保护；保存，保护，避免浪费；守恒
entries.example: The group works hard on wildlife conservation in this area.
entries.exampleZh: 这个团体在这一地区努力从事野生动物保护工作。

entries.meaning: 保守的；保守的，守旧的；保守的，守旧的；不时兴的，传统的；保守的人
entries.example: My uncle is quite conservative about clothes and music.
entries.exampleZh: 我叔叔在衣着和音乐方面相当保守。

entries.meaning: 保留，保护；保护，保藏，保存
entries.example: We should conserve water during the hot summer months.
entries.exampleZh: 在炎热的夏季，我们应该节约用水。

entries.meaning: 相当多的；相当大的；重要的
entries.example: The project required a considerable amount of time and money.
entries.exampleZh: 这个项目需要相当多的时间和金钱。

entries.meaning: 考虑周到的，体贴的，体谅的
entries.example: It was very considerate of you to call my mother.
entries.exampleZh: 你打电话给我母亲，真是太体贴了。

entries.example: The team will consist of six players and a coach.
entries.exampleZh: 这支队伍将由六名队员和一名教练组成。

entries.meaning: 一致的；前后一致的，连贯的；坚持的，一贯的；一致的，符合的
entries.example: Her story remained consistent every time the police asked her about that night.
entries.exampleZh: 每次警察询问她那晚的情况，她的说法都始终一致。

entries.meaning: 安慰；悬臂，肘托；控制台；安慰，慰问；控制台，操纵台
entries.example: She tried to console her friend after the disappointing exam results.
entries.exampleZh: 考试成绩令人失望，她试着安慰她的朋友。

entries.meaning: 巩固；合并；巩固，加强；联为一体，合并
entries.example: The team hopes to consolidate its gains before the new season starts.
entries.exampleZh: 球队希望在新赛季开始前巩固已有的成果。

entries.example: His bright red jacket made him conspicuous in the quiet grey crowd.
entries.exampleZh: 他那件鲜红的夹克让他在安静的灰色人群中十分显眼。

entries.meaning: 不断的；经常的，不断的，连续发生的；永恒的；忠实的，忠诚的；常数，恒量
entries.example: The constant noise from the street kept me awake all night.
entries.exampleZh: 街上不断的噪音让我整夜都没睡着。

entries.meaning: 构成的；选民；组成的，构成的；选民，选区居民；成分，组成；配料
entries.example: Water is the most important constituent of the human body.
entries.exampleZh: 水是人体最重要的组成成分。

entries.meaning: 构成，组成；组成，形成；设立；任命
entries.example: Three small islands together constitute the whole of that new country.
entries.exampleZh: 三个小岛共同构成了那个新国家的全部领土。

entries.meaning: （人的）体格，素质；宪法，章程；组成；设立
entries.example: Regular exercise improved his constitution and helped him recover from illness.
entries.exampleZh: 经常锻炼改善了他的体质，也帮助他病后康复。

entries.meaning: 限制；限制，约束；克制，抑制
entries.example: A tight budget will constrain what the team can do this year.
entries.exampleZh: 紧张的预算将限制团队今年能做的事情。

entries.example: Time is the biggest constraint on our plan to rebuild the bridge.
entries.exampleZh: 时间是我们重建这座桥的计划面临的最大限制。

entries.meaning: 建造；构思；建筑物；构想；观念
entries.example: Engineers plan to construct a new bridge across the wide river.
entries.exampleZh: 工程师们计划在这条宽阔的河上建造一座新桥。

entries.example: The construction of the new hospital will take about two years.
entries.exampleZh: 新医院的建设将耗时约两年。

entries.example: She asked the British consul for help after losing her passport.
entries.exampleZh: 她在丢失护照后向英国领事寻求帮助。

entries.example: Please consult your doctor before you start taking these new pills.
entries.exampleZh: 在开始服用这些新药片之前，请咨询你的医生。

entries.meaning: 咨询；顾问；顾问服务公司
entries.example: He works for a small consultancy that advises local farming businesses.
entries.exampleZh: 他在一家为当地农业企业提供建议的小型咨询公司工作。

entries.meaning: 顾问；会诊医师，专科医生
entries.example: The company hired a consultant to improve its online sales.
entries.exampleZh: 公司聘请了一位顾问来改善其线上销售。

entries.example: After a long consultation, the doctors decided to operate on Monday.
entries.exampleZh: 经过长时间的商议，医生们决定在星期一动手术。

entries.meaning: 消灭，毁灭；消费；吃完，喝光
entries.example: These old machines consume far too much electricity for a small shop.
entries.exampleZh: 对一家小店来说，这些旧机器耗电太多了。

entries.meaning: 消费者，用户；消费者，用户，消耗者
entries.example: The new law gives every consumer more information about product safety.
entries.exampleZh: 新法律让每位消费者获得更多关于产品安全的信息。

entries.meaning: 消费, 消耗；消费（量）；消耗，消费；肺病
entries.example: The consumption of sugary drinks has fallen among teenagers in recent years.
entries.exampleZh: 近年来，青少年中含糖饮料的消费量有所下降。

entries.meaning: 接触，联系，交往；与…接触，与…取得联系
entries.example: Please contact the office if you need any further help.
entries.exampleZh: 如果你需要更多帮助，请与办公室联系。

entries.example: Waste from the factory could contaminate the river near our town.
entries.exampleZh: 工厂排出的废物可能会污染我们镇附近的河流。

entries.example: Tests showed serious contamination in the soil around the old factory.
entries.exampleZh: 检测显示，那座旧工厂周围的土壤受到了严重污染。

entries.meaning: 盘算，计议；思量，对…周密考虑；注视，凝视
entries.example: She sat by the window to contemplate her next move.
entries.exampleZh: 她坐在窗边，盘算着下一步该怎么走。

entries.meaning: 现代的，当代的；同时代的
entries.example: The museum holds a fine collection of contemporary art.
entries.exampleZh: 这家博物馆收藏了一批精美的当代艺术作品。

entries.example: She felt nothing but contempt for people who lie.
entries.exampleZh: 她对撒谎的人只有蔑视。

entries.meaning: 竞争；坚决主张；争夺，竞争；搏斗，争斗；声称，主张
entries.example: Both teams will contend for the title this season.
entries.exampleZh: 两支队伍将在本赛季争夺冠军。

entries.example: She was quite content with her simple life in the village.
entries.exampleZh: 她对自己在乡村的简朴生活相当满意。

entries.example: His main contention is that the plan costs too much.
entries.exampleZh: 他的主要论点是这个计划花费太高。

entries.meaning: 竞赛，争夺；争夺，与…竞争；对…提出质疑，辩驳
entries.example: She won the swimming contest by a narrow margin.
entries.exampleZh: 她以微弱优势赢得了那场游泳比赛。

entries.example: Each contestant had three minutes to answer the questions.
entries.exampleZh: 每位参赛者有三分钟时间来回答问题。

entries.example: You can guess the meaning of the word from its context.
entries.exampleZh: 你可以从上下文猜出这个词的意思。

entries.example: The continental climate here brings hot summers and cold winters.
entries.exampleZh: 这里的大陆性气候带来炎热的夏天和寒冷的冬天。

entries.example: His continual questions made it hard to finish the report.
entries.exampleZh: 他不停地提问，让人很难完成报告。

entries.example: The new manager promised continuity in the company's daily work.
entries.exampleZh: 新经理承诺公司日常工作将保持连续性。

entries.meaning: 缩小；订合同；感染，染上；契约，合同
entries.example: She signed a two-year contract with the local newspaper.
entries.exampleZh: 她与当地报纸签订了一份为期两年的合同。

entries.meaning: 反驳，否认；反驳，否认…的真实性；与…发生矛盾，与…抵触
entries.example: I don't want to contradict you, but the facts look different.
entries.exampleZh: 我不想反驳你，但事实看起来并非如此。

entries.example: There is a clear contradiction between his words and actions.
entries.exampleZh: 他的言行之间存在明显的矛盾。

entries.example: The results were contrary to everything we had expected.
entries.exampleZh: 结果与我们原先预想的完全相反。

entries.meaning: 使对比；形成对比；形成对比，对比之下显出区别；对比，对照；反差[kən'trɑːst]；对比，对照
entries.example: In contrast to his brother, Tom enjoys quiet evenings at home.
entries.exampleZh: 与他哥哥不同，汤姆喜欢在家安静地度过夜晚。

entries.example: Everyone can contribute a small amount to the local charity.
entries.exampleZh: 每个人都可以为当地的慈善机构捐献一点钱。

entries.meaning: 贡献；贡献；促成作用；捐款，捐献物；稿件
entries.example: Her contribution to the project was praised by the whole team.
entries.exampleZh: 她对这个项目的贡献受到了整个团队的赞扬。

entries.meaning: 谋划，策划；设法做到；设计，想出
entries.example: They contrive to finish the work despite the limited time.
entries.exampleZh: 尽管时间有限，他们还是设法完成了工作。

entries.meaning: 受到争议的；引起争论的，有争议的
entries.example: The new policy on taxes proved highly controversial among local farmers.
entries.exampleZh: 这项新的税收政策在当地农民中引起了很大争议。

entries.meaning: 争议；争论，辩论，争吵；争论，辩论
entries.example: The decision caused a heated controversy across the entire country.
entries.exampleZh: 这一决定在全国引起了激烈的争论。

entries.example: The board will convene next Monday to discuss the budget.
entries.exampleZh: 董事会将于下周一开会讨论预算。

entries.example: Please reply at your earliest convenience so we can plan ahead.
entries.exampleZh: 请尽早回复，以便我们提前安排。

entries.meaning: 公约，（换俘等）协定；习俗，惯例；公约；会议
entries.example: By convention, guests usually bring a small gift to the host.
entries.exampleZh: 按照惯例，客人通常会给主人带一份小礼物。

entries.meaning: 传统的；普通的；习惯的，常规的；因循守旧的
entries.example: She prefers conventional methods rather than risky modern experiments.
entries.exampleZh: 她更喜欢传统的方法，而不是有风险的现代实验。

entries.meaning: 会合，互相靠拢；聚集，集中；趋近
entries.example: Two rivers converge just outside the small mountain village.
entries.exampleZh: 两条河流就在那个小山村的郊外汇合。

entries.meaning: 转变；转变，变换；改变信仰，皈依
entries.example: The conversion of the old factory into flats took two years.
entries.exampleZh: 把旧工厂改建成公寓花了两年时间。

entries.meaning: 转换，改变；转变，改变，变换；转变，转化；改变
entries.example: They plan to convert the barn into a cozy guest house.
entries.exampleZh: 他们打算把谷仓改造成一间舒适的客房。

entries.meaning: 传达；传播；转让；表达；传递；运送，输送
entries.example: Words cannot fully convey how grateful we are for your help.
entries.exampleZh: 言语无法完全表达我们对你的帮助有多么感激。

entries.meaning: 证明……有罪；证明…有罪，宣判…有罪['kɒnvɪkt]；囚犯
entries.example: The jury may convict him if the evidence is strong enough.
entries.exampleZh: 如果证据足够有力，陪审团可能会判他有罪。

entries.example: She spoke with deep conviction about the need for change.
entries.exampleZh: 她带着坚定的信念谈到变革的必要性。

entries.meaning: 使……相信；使确信，使信服，说服
entries.example: It took hours to convince him that the plan was safe.
entries.exampleZh: 花了几个小时才使他相信这个计划是安全的。

entries.example: His explanation sounded convincing, so nobody asked any further questions.
entries.exampleZh: 他的解释听起来令人信服，所以没有人再提问。

entries.meaning: 合作的；合作社；有合作意向的，乐意合作的；合作的，协作的；合作社，合作商店
entries.example: The staff were friendly and cooperative throughout our entire visit.
entries.exampleZh: 在我们整个参观过程中，员工们都很友好并且乐于合作。

entries.example: In this system, both partners enjoy coordinate authority over decisions.
entries.exampleZh: 在这个体系中，双方在决策上享有同等的权力。

entries.example: Good coordination between the teams made the rescue operation a success.
entries.exampleZh: 各团队之间的良好协调使这次救援行动取得了成功。

entries.example: Many families struggle to cope with rising food prices these days.
entries.exampleZh: 如今许多家庭难以应付不断上涨的食品价格。

entries.example: He tied the old box with a strong cord before moving it.
entries.exampleZh: 他在搬动旧箱子之前用一根结实的绳子把它捆好了。

entries.example: Our host gave us a cordial welcome and offered fresh tea.
entries.exampleZh: 主人热情友好地欢迎我们，并端上了新泡的茶。

entries.meaning: 软木，软木塞；用瓶塞塞住
entries.example: Please push the cork firmly back into the bottle after pouring.
entries.exampleZh: 倒完后请把软木塞牢牢地塞回瓶口。

entries.example: Trust is the cornerstone of every strong friendship and healthy team.
entries.exampleZh: 信任是每一段牢固友谊和健康团队的基石。

entries.meaning: 法人团体的，公司的；全体的，共同的
entries.example: She joined a large corporate team after finishing her business degree.
entries.exampleZh: 她完成商科学位后加入了一个大型公司团队。

entries.example: The company will deduct the tax from your monthly salary.
entries.exampleZh: 公司将从你的月薪中扣除税款。

entries.example: Her monthly deduction for health insurance seems rather small.
entries.exampleZh: 她每月用于健康保险的扣款似乎相当少。

entries.meaning: 认为；认为，相信，想；认为，视为

entries.exampleZh: 许多专家认为这项新政策对小公司来说过于严格。

entries.example: Add another layer to deepen the blue in this painting.
entries.exampleZh: 再加一层，把这幅画中的蓝色加深。

entries.meaning: 不履行义务；不履行义务，拖欠；违约，拖欠；弃权；预设，缺省
entries.example: The default on the loan worried the small business owner.
entries.exampleZh: 贷款违约让小企业主感到担忧。

entries.example: The team's unexpected defeat shocked their loyal fans.
entries.exampleZh: 球队出人意料的失利让忠实球迷感到震惊。

entries.meaning: 缺点；变节，叛变；缺点，缺陷，欠缺[dI'fekt]

entries.exampleZh: 工程师发现汽车刹车系统存在严重缺陷。

entries.exampleZh: 被告在漫长的审判中平静地回答了每个问题。

entries.example: The coach chose a more defensive plan for the final match.
entries.exampleZh: 教练为决赛选择了更偏防守的方案。

entries.example: The young assistant spoke in a deferential tone to the manager.
entries.exampleZh: 这位年轻助手用恭敬的语气对经理说话。

entries.example: Her open defiance of the rules surprised even close friends.
entries.exampleZh: 她对规则公开的违抗甚至让密友都感到惊讶。

entries.meaning: 缺乏；不足；缺乏，不足；缺点，缺陷
entries.example: A vitamin deficiency can cause serious health problems over time.
entries.exampleZh: 维生素缺乏长期可能导致严重健康问题。

entries.meaning: 不足的，缺乏的；缺乏的；欠缺的
entries.example: The diet was deficient in iron and several important vitamins.
entries.exampleZh: 这种饮食缺乏铁和几种重要维生素。

entries.example: The government promised to reduce the budget deficit next year.
entries.exampleZh: 政府承诺明年减少预算赤字。

entries.meaning: 规定；立（界限）；给…下定义，限定
entries.example: Please define the main problem before we discuss possible solutions.
entries.exampleZh: 请在我们讨论可能的解决方案之前明确主要问题。

entries.example: We need a definite answer before Friday afternoon.
entries.exampleZh: 我们需要在周五下午之前得到一个明确的答复。

entries.example: I will definitely finish the report before the meeting starts.
entries.exampleZh: 我一定会在会议开始前完成报告。

entries.meaning: 定义，释义，定界；清晰，鲜明
entries.example: The teacher gave a clear definition of the difficult term.
entries.exampleZh: 老师对这个难懂的术语给出了清晰的定义。

entries.meaning: 最可靠的，权威性的；决定性的
entries.example: The report offers a definitive answer to our most urgent question.
entries.exampleZh: 这份报告对我们最紧迫的问题给出了权威的答案。

entries.example: Good defenders deflect criticism with calm and careful explanations.
entries.exampleZh: 优秀的辩护者会用冷静而谨慎的解释转移批评。

entries.example: The slight deflection of the beam saved the bridge from damage.
entries.exampleZh: 横梁的轻微偏斜使桥梁免于受损。

entries.example: Rapid deforestation threatens countless species in this tropical region.
entries.exampleZh: 快速的森林砍伐威胁着这个热带地区无数的物种。

entries.example: Strong heat can deform the plastic frame of the device.
entries.exampleZh: 高温会使该设备的塑料框架变形。

entries.example: The engineers measured the deformation of the metal after the crash.
entries.exampleZh: 工程师测量了碰撞后金属的变形程度。

entries.meaning: 违背，违抗；向…挑战；蔑视；违抗，蔑视；使成为不可能；惹，激
entries.example: Some teenagers defy their parents simply to prove their independence.
entries.exampleZh: 有些青少年违抗父母只是为了证明自己的独立。

entries.meaning: 衰退，堕落，蜕化；衰退的，堕落的；堕落者
entries.example: Lack of sleep can degenerate into serious health problems.
entries.exampleZh: 缺乏睡眠可能恶化为严重的健康问题。

entries.example: The doctor warned that nerve degeneration could affect his balance.
entries.exampleZh: 医生警告说神经退化可能影响他的平衡。

entries.example: Soil degradation has reduced the harvest in many farming villages.
entries.exampleZh: 土壤退化减少了许多农业村庄的收成。

entries.meaning: 使降低；使堕落；降低…的身份，有辱…的人格；使降解，使退化
entries.example: Plastic waste can degrade slowly and harm marine life.
entries.exampleZh: 塑料垃圾会缓慢降解并危害海洋生物。

entries.example: Each delegate received a folder before the opening speech.
entries.exampleZh: 每位代表在开幕演讲前都收到了一份文件夹。

entries.meaning: 故意的；深思熟虑的；审慎的；故意的，蓄意的；慎重的，深思熟虑的；仔细考虑，思考
entries.example: Her deliberate choice of words calmed the angry crowd.
entries.exampleZh: 她审慎的用词安抚了愤怒的人群。

entries.example: He deliberately ignored the warning signs on the wet road.
entries.exampleZh: 他故意无视了湿滑道路上的警告标志。

entries.meaning: 精细的，细微的；纤细的；易碎的；微妙的；精美的
entries.example: The delicate glass vase needs careful handling during the move.
entries.exampleZh: 这个易碎的玻璃花瓶在搬运时需要小心处理。

entries.example: She will deliver the final report before noon tomorrow.
entries.exampleZh: 她将在明天中午前提交最终报告。

entries.example: His belief that everyone admires him is a harmless delusion.
entries.exampleZh: 他相信人人都钦佩他，这是一种无害的错觉。

entries.meaning: 要求，需要；询问；要求，需要
entries.example: The sudden demand for tickets surprised the concert organizers.
entries.exampleZh: 对门票的突然需求让音乐会组织者感到惊讶。

entries.example: A healthy democracy depends on informed citizens and fair elections.
entries.exampleZh: 健康的民主取决于知情的公民和公平的选举。

entries.example: The teacher used simple models to demonstrate the water cycle.
entries.exampleZh: 老师用简单的模型演示了水循环。

entries.example: The students held a peaceful demonstration outside the town hall.
entries.exampleZh: 学生们在市政厅外举行了一场和平的游行。

entries.example: The new government plans to denationalize several large state-owned factories.
entries.exampleZh: 新政府计划使几家大型国有工厂非国有化。

entries.meaning: 否定；拒绝相信；否认；拒绝，拒绝给予
entries.example: His denial of the accident surprised everyone in the room.
entries.exampleZh: 他对这起事故的否认让房间里的每个人都感到惊讶。

entries.meaning: 指示，意味着；意思是；表示，是…的标志
entries.example: In this chart, red lines denote areas of serious danger.
entries.exampleZh: 在这张图表中，红线表示严重危险的区域。

entries.meaning: 谴责，声讨；告发；谴责，指责；告发
entries.example: Several leaders publicly denounce the new tax as unfair.
entries.exampleZh: 几位领导人公开谴责这项新税不公平。

entries.example: The population density in this coastal city keeps rising fast.
entries.exampleZh: 这座沿海城市的人口密度持续快速上升。

entries.example: I have to see the dentist about my broken tooth.
entries.exampleZh: 我得去看牙医，处理我那颗坏掉的牙。

entries.example: She continues to deny any knowledge of the missing money.
entries.exampleZh: 她仍然否认知道那笔失踪的钱的任何情况。

entries.example: Every dependant must be listed on this official application form.
entries.exampleZh: 每位受赡养者都必须列在这份正式申请表上。

entries.example: These old photos depict life in a farming village.
entries.exampleZh: 这些老照片描绘了一个农耕村庄的生活。

entries.example: The court decided to deport him after his visa expired.
entries.exampleZh: 在他的签证到期后，法院决定将他驱逐出境。

entries.example: She paid a deposit of two hundred pounds on the flat.
entries.exampleZh: 她为这套公寓付了两百英镑的押金。

entries.example: The deposition of the old king shocked the whole country.
entries.exampleZh: 老王被罢免一事震惊了全国。

entries.example: Long rainy weeks always depress me and my younger brother.
entries.exampleZh: 漫长的雨季总是让我和弟弟感到沮丧。

entries.meaning: 消沉；不景气萧条期；抑郁，沮丧；不景气，萧条；洼地，凹陷
entries.example: The Great Depression left millions of families without work or hope.
entries.exampleZh: 大萧条让数百万家庭失去了工作和希望。

entries.example: Years of deprivation had left the children weak and thin.
entries.exampleZh: 多年的匮乏使孩子们变得虚弱消瘦。

entries.meaning: 剥夺；夺去；使（人）失去；剥夺，使丧失
entries.example: The new law could deprive thousands of citizens of their homes.
entries.exampleZh: 这项新法律可能使数千名公民失去家园。

entries.example: The deputy manager will handle all complaints while she is away.
entries.exampleZh: 她外出期间，副经理将处理所有投诉。

entries.example: Heavy snow could derail the train somewhere near the border.
entries.exampleZh: 大雪可能使火车在边境附近某处脱轨。

entries.example: The derivation of this word remains unclear to most scholars.
entries.exampleZh: 这个词的起源对大多数学者来说仍不清楚。

entries.meaning: 获得；起源，衍生；取得，得到；追溯…的起源或来由
entries.example: Many English words derive from Latin and Greek roots.
entries.exampleZh: 许多英语单词源自拉丁语和希腊语词根。

entries.example: We watched the plane descend slowly through the thick clouds.
entries.exampleZh: 我们看着飞机缓缓穿过厚厚的云层下降。

entries.meaning: 子孙后代；子孙，后裔；后裔，后代
entries.example: She claims to be a direct descendant of the famous poet.
entries.exampleZh: 她声称自己是那位著名诗人的直系后裔。

entries.meaning: 血统, 后裔；下降；出身；斜坡；下降，下倾；斜坡，坡道；血统，世系
entries.example: The hikers began their long descent before sunset.
entries.exampleZh: 徒步者们在日落前开始了漫长的下坡。

entries.example: Could you describe the man you saw last night?
entries.exampleZh: 你能描述一下你昨晚看见的那个男人吗？

entries.example: Her essay contains many descriptive passages about the old town.
entries.exampleZh: 她的文章里有很多关于老城的描写性段落。

entries.meaning: 放弃，抛弃；遗弃；擅离（职守）
entries.example: He would never desert his friends in a crisis.
entries.exampleZh: 他绝不会在危难时抛弃朋友。

entries.example: After such hard work, you deserve a long holiday.
entries.exampleZh: 经过这么辛苦的工作，你应该好好休个长假。

entries.meaning: 设计；预定，指定；设计，构想；图样；企图
entries.example: The new design saves space and looks quite modern.
entries.exampleZh: 这个新设计节省空间，看起来相当现代。

entries.meaning: 指定，委派；指定；指示；指明；指派，委任；标出；把…定名为
entries.example: The council will designate this area as a nature park.
entries.exampleZh: 委员会将指定这一区域为自然公园。

entries.example: A quiet neighborhood is highly desirable for young families.
entries.exampleZh: 安静的社区对年轻家庭来说非常理想。

entries.example: She had a strong desire to travel around the world.
entries.exampleZh: 她有一个强烈的愿望，要环游世界。

entries.example: The village looked desolate after everyone had moved away.
entries.exampleZh: 所有人搬走之后，这个村庄显得荒凉冷清。

entries.example: He was desperate for money and took a second job.
entries.exampleZh: 他急需用钱，于是又接了一份工作。

entries.example: I despise people who are cruel to animals.
entries.exampleZh: 我鄙视那些虐待动物的人。

entries.example: Despite the heavy rain, the match went on as planned.
entries.exampleZh: 尽管下着大雨，比赛仍按计划进行。

entries.example: We had chocolate cake for dessert after the meal.
entries.exampleZh: 饭后我们吃了巧克力蛋糕作为甜点。

entries.meaning: 目的地；目的地，终点；目标
entries.example: The train finally arrived at its destination two hours late.
entries.exampleZh: 火车终于晚了两个小时抵达目的地。

entries.example: They believe fate will destine their child for greatness.
entries.exampleZh: 他们相信命运会注定他们的孩子成就非凡。

entries.meaning: 命中注定的，预定的；以…为目的地的
entries.example: She always believed she was destined for great things.
entries.exampleZh: 她一直相信自己注定会有所成就。

entries.meaning: 命运，天数；命运；定数，天命
entries.example: She believed that meeting him was destiny, not a coincidence.
entries.exampleZh: 她相信遇见他是命运，而不是巧合。

entries.example: The storm caused terrible destruction across the small coastal village.
entries.exampleZh: 那场风暴给沿海小村庄造成了严重的破坏。

entries.meaning: 破坏性的，毁灭性的；破坏（性）的，危害的；破坏的，毁灭的
entries.example: Gossip can be destructive to trust within a close team.
entries.exampleZh: 流言蜚语会对亲密团队中的信任造成破坏。

entries.meaning: 分开；派遣（军队）；拆卸；使分开，使分离
entries.example: Please detach the coupon and keep it for your records.
entries.exampleZh: 请撕下优惠券并保留作为记录。

entries.example: He seemed strangely detached during the emotional family discussion.
entries.exampleZh: 在情绪激动的家庭讨论中，他显得异常冷漠。

entries.meaning: 琐碎，小事；细节，枝节；零件；详细说明
entries.example: She described every detail of the accident to the police.
entries.exampleZh: 她向警方描述了事故的每一个细节。

entries.meaning: 扣押，拘留；耽搁；拘留，扣留；留住，耽搁
entries.example: The police may detain the suspect for up to twenty-four hours.
entries.exampleZh: 警方最多可将嫌疑人拘留二十四小时。

entries.example: Sensors can detect even a tiny amount of smoke in the air.
entries.exampleZh: 传感器能检测到空气中哪怕微量的烟雾。

entries.example: Early detection of the disease greatly improves the patient's chances.
entries.exampleZh: 疾病的早期发现大大提高了患者的康复机会。

entries.meaning: 侦探；侦探，警探；私人侦探，私家侦探；侦探，私人侦探
entries.example: The detective asked us to repeat exactly what we had seen.
entries.exampleZh: 侦探让我们准确重复我们所看到的一切。

entries.example: A smoke detector began beeping loudly in the middle of the night.
entries.exampleZh: 半夜里，一个烟雾探测器开始大声鸣叫。

entries.example: Without regular maintenance, the old bridge will deteriorate very quickly.
entries.exampleZh: 如果不定期维护，这座老桥的状况会迅速恶化。

entries.example: The report notes a serious deterioration in air quality last year.
entries.exampleZh: 报告指出去年空气质量严重恶化。

entries.example: Scientists are trying to determine the cause of the sudden illness.
entries.exampleZh: 科学家们正试图确定这种突发疾病的病因。

entries.example: He used special chemicals to develop the old photographs.
entries.exampleZh: 他用特殊的化学药水使旧照片显影。

entries.meaning: 偏离；（使）背离，偏离；背离，偏离
entries.example: The pilot must not deviate from the approved flight path.
entries.exampleZh: 飞行员不得偏离批准的飞行路线。

entries.example: Any deviation from the recipe may change the cake's taste.
entries.exampleZh: 任何偏离食谱的做法都可能改变蛋糕的味道。

entries.meaning: 器械，装置；设计；手段，策略
entries.example: This small device helps blind users read printed text aloud.
entries.exampleZh: 这个小型装置帮助盲人用户朗读印刷文本。

entries.example: We need to devise a better plan before the deadline.
entries.exampleZh: 我们需要在截止日期前想出一个更好的计划。

entries.example: She decided to devote her free time to helping animals.
entries.exampleZh: 她决定把业余时间用来帮助动物。

entries.example: Her devotion to the project impressed every member of the team.
entries.exampleZh: 她对项目的热诚让团队里的每个人都印象深刻。

entries.example: The hungry children devour the fresh bread within minutes.
entries.exampleZh: 饥饿的孩子们几分钟内就把新鲜面包吃光了。

entries.meaning: 诊断；诊断（疾病）；诊断；判断
entries.example: Doctors can diagnose the illness early with a simple blood test.
entries.exampleZh: 医生可以通过简单的血液检查及早诊断这种疾病。

entries.example: The manager will dictate a short letter to his assistant.
entries.exampleZh: 经理将向他的助理口授一封简短的信。

entries.example: The cruel dictator ignored the needs of ordinary citizens.
entries.exampleZh: 那个残酷的独裁者无视普通公民的需求。

entries.example: The truck runs on diesel and carries heavy loads.
entries.exampleZh: 这辆卡车使用柴油并运载重物。

entries.example: A balanced diet helps you stay healthy throughout the year.
entries.exampleZh: 均衡的饮食帮助你全年保持健康。

entries.meaning: 区分，区别；区分，区别；使不同，使有差异
entries.example: Good teachers differentiate between honest mistakes and careless errors.
entries.exampleZh: 优秀的老师会区分诚实的错误和粗心的错误。

entries.example: Clear differentiation between the two products helps customers choose wisely.
entries.exampleZh: 两种产品之间的清晰区分有助于顾客明智地选择。

entries.example: The difficult customer demanded a full refund immediately.
entries.exampleZh: 这位难以满足的顾客立刻要求全额退款。

entries.meaning: 扩散，弥漫；传播，散布；冗长的，漫无边际的；四散的，弥漫的
entries.example: The scent will diffuse through the room within a few minutes.
entries.exampleZh: 香味会在几分钟内扩散到整个房间。

entries.example: Some people cannot digest milk easily after childhood.
entries.exampleZh: 有些人成年后不能轻易消化牛奶。

entries.meaning: 庄重；尊严；体面；庄严，端庄；尊严，高贵

entries.exampleZh: 她以平静的尊严和勇气面对不公平的批评。

entries.example: He faced a real dilemma when both job offers arrived.
entries.exampleZh: 当两份工作邀请同时到来时，他面临一个真正的困境。

entries.example: Her diligence at work earned her a well-deserved promotion.
entries.exampleZh: 她在工作中的勤奋为她赢得了一次当之无愧的晋升。

entries.example: The diligent student reviewed her notes every evening before bed.
entries.exampleZh: 那个勤奋的学生每天晚上睡觉前都会复习笔记。

entries.meaning: 稀释，冲淡；稀释的，冲淡的
