entries.example: The old church was built with solid granite blocks.
entries.exampleZh: 这座古老的教堂是用坚固的花岗岩石块建成的。

entries.example: The city gave the museum a large grant for repairs.
entries.exampleZh: 市政府给了博物馆一大笔维修拨款。

entries.meaning: 生动的，形象的；绘画的，文字的，图表的
entries.example: Her report included a graphic account of the accident.
entries.exampleZh: 她的报告对这场事故作了生动形象的描述。

entries.example: The artist sketched the portrait with a soft graphite pencil.
entries.exampleZh: 画家用一支软石墨铅笔画了这幅肖像。

entries.example: I could not grasp the main idea of his lecture.
entries.exampleZh: 我无法理解他讲座的主要观点。

entries.example: A green grasshopper jumped onto a leaf near the garden gate.
entries.exampleZh: 一只绿色的蚱蜢跳到了花园大门附近的一片叶子上。

entries.example: We had a picnic on a grassy hill beside the river.
entries.exampleZh: 我们在河边一座长满草的小山上野餐。

entries.example: I am grateful for all the help you gave me.
entries.exampleZh: 我很感激你给予我的所有帮助。

entries.example: She expressed her gratitude with a handwritten thank-you note.
entries.exampleZh: 她用一封手写的感谢信表达了感激之情。

entries.meaning: 严重的；严重的，严肃的；坟墓
entries.example: The doctor said the patient was in grave danger.
entries.exampleZh: 医生说这位病人处境非常危险。

entries.example: A path of loose gravel leads to the front door.
entries.exampleZh: 一条铺着松散砂砾的小路通向前门。

entries.meaning: 喂草；放牧（牲畜）；吃青草；放牧；擦伤；擦过，掠过；擦破
entries.example: Cows graze peacefully in the field behind our house.
entries.exampleZh: 牛群在我们屋后的田野里安静地吃草。

entries.meaning: 动物脂，脂肪；油脂；润滑脂，润滑油；用油脂涂，给…加润滑油
entries.example: He wiped the thick grease off the old car parts.
entries.exampleZh: 他擦掉了旧汽车零件上厚厚的油脂。

entries.example: His greed for money finally destroyed his friendship with us.
entries.exampleZh: 他对金钱的贪婪最终毁掉了他与我们的友谊。

entries.example: The greedy boy took the biggest piece of cake.
entries.exampleZh: 那个贪心的男孩拿了最大的一块蛋糕。

entries.meaning: 悲哀，悲痛，悲伤；悲伤，悲痛；悲伤的事，悲痛的缘由
entries.example: Her face showed deep grief when she heard the news.
entries.exampleZh: 听到这个消息时，她脸上露出了深深的悲痛。

entries.meaning: 感到悲痛，伤心；使伤心，为…而伤心
entries.example: We still grieve for our grandfather many years later.
entries.exampleZh: 多年以后，我们仍在为祖父的离去而伤心。

entries.meaning: 严厉的；讨厌的，糟糕的；严厉的；冷酷的，无情的
entries.example: The weather looked grim, so we cancelled our picnic.
entries.exampleZh: 天气看起来很糟糕，所以我们取消了野餐。

entries.example: She gave me a big grin when she heard the good news.
entries.exampleZh: 听到这个好消息时，她冲我咧嘴大笑。

entries.example: Please grind the coffee beans finely before you start the machine.
entries.exampleZh: 请在启动机器之前把咖啡豆磨细。

entries.meaning: 抓住；握紧，抓牢；吸引住…的注意力；紧握
entries.example: He kept a firm grip on the rope while crossing the bridge.
entries.exampleZh: 过桥时他紧紧抓住绳子。

entries.meaning: 呻吟，抱怨；发出呻吟般的声音；呻吟，抱怨；呻吟般的声音
entries.example: The injured man let out a loud groan as he stood up.
entries.exampleZh: 那个受伤的男人站起来时发出一声痛苦的呻吟。

entries.example: I stopped at the grocery to buy milk and fresh bread.
entries.exampleZh: 我在杂货店停下来买了牛奶和新鲜面包。

entries.example: The wooden door slides along a deep groove in the floor.
entries.exampleZh: 这扇木门沿着地板上的一道深槽滑动。

entries.meaning: （暗中）摸索，探索；暗中摸索，搜索；探索，搜寻；摸索
entries.example: She had to grope for the light switch in the dark.
entries.exampleZh: 她不得不在黑暗中摸索电灯开关。

entries.meaning: （语言、举止）粗俗的；总的；严重的；粗俗的；臃肿的
entries.example: He told a gross joke that made everyone at the table uncomfortable.
entries.exampleZh: 他讲了一个粗俗的笑话，让桌上的每个人都感到不舒服。

entries.example: Her fear of flying turned out to be completely groundless.
entries.exampleZh: 她对飞行的恐惧后来证明完全没有根据。

entries.example: We rested in a quiet grove of tall trees near the river.
entries.exampleZh: 我们在河边一片高大的树林里休息。

entries.example: The dog began to growl when the stranger approached the gate.
entries.exampleZh: 当陌生人走近大门时，那条狗开始低声咆哮。

entries.example: The workers continued to grumble about the long hours and low pay.
entries.exampleZh: 工人们继续抱怨工作时间长、工资低。

entries.example: He gave a short grunt and continued to lift the heavy box.
entries.exampleZh: 他咕哝了一声，继续搬那个沉重的箱子。

entries.meaning: 保证；保证，担保物；保证，担保
entries.example: The shop offers a full guarantee on every watch it sells.
entries.exampleZh: 这家店对售出的每一块手表都提供完整的保修。

entries.example: Two soldiers guard the entrance to the palace day and night.
entries.exampleZh: 两名士兵日夜守卫着宫殿的入口。

entries.example: Her aunt became her legal guardian after the accident.
entries.exampleZh: 事故之后，她的姑妈成了她的法定监护人。

entries.example: The final cost was only a rough guesstimate, not an exact figure.
entries.exampleZh: 最终费用只是一个粗略的估计，并不是确切的数字。

entries.example: He felt a deep sense of guilt after breaking his promise.
entries.exampleZh: 违背诺言后，他感到深深的内疚。

entries.example: My brother plays the guitar in a small jazz band.
entries.exampleZh: 我哥哥在一个小型爵士乐队里弹吉他。

entries.example: A sudden gust of wind blew my hat off.
entries.exampleZh: 一阵突然的狂风把我的帽子吹掉了。

entries.example: Leaves blocked the gutter and rainwater spilled onto the street.
entries.exampleZh: 树叶堵住了排水沟，雨水溢到了街上。

entries.example: His habitual late arrival annoyed the other members of the team.
entries.exampleZh: 他习惯性的迟到让团队其他成员很恼火。

entries.example: Someone tried to hack into the bank's computer system yesterday.
entries.exampleZh: 昨天有人试图侵入银行的计算机系统。

entries.example: Fans gathered outside the theatre to hail the famous actor.
entries.exampleZh: 影迷们聚集在剧院外，向那位著名演员欢呼。

entries.example: We should halve the recipe because only four guests are coming.
entries.exampleZh: 我们应该把食谱分量减半，因为只有四位客人要来。

entries.example: I made a simple sandwich with cheese and ham for lunch.
entries.exampleZh: 我午餐做了一个简单的奶酪火腿三明治。

entries.meaning: 妨碍，阻碍，牵制；妨碍，束缚，限制；大篮子
entries.example: Heavy rain may hamper our plan to hike tomorrow.
entries.exampleZh: 大雨可能会妨碍我们明天徒步的计划。

entries.meaning: 手册，便览，指南；手册，便览
entries.example: The school gave every new student a useful handbook.
entries.exampleZh: 学校给每位新生发了一本实用的手册。

entries.example: The police found a loaded handgun in the empty room.
entries.exampleZh: 警方在空房间里发现了一把装有子弹的手枪。

entries.meaning: 妨碍，使不利；缺陷；障碍，不利条件
entries.example: Lack of sleep can handicap students during important exams.
entries.exampleZh: 睡眠不足会在重要考试中妨碍学生发挥。

entries.example: The handle on the old wooden door feels quite loose.
entries.exampleZh: 那扇旧木门的把手摸起来很松。

entries.example: The charity provided a small handout to every poor family.
entries.exampleZh: 该慈善机构给每个贫困家庭提供了一小份救济品。

entries.example: A small flashlight is handy when the power suddenly goes out.
entries.exampleZh: 突然停电时，小手电很方便。

entries.meaning: 怀着（不好的想法、恐惧或希望）；包含，藏有；窝藏
entries.example: She continued to harbour doubts about his honest explanation.
entries.exampleZh: 她仍然对他的诚实解释心存疑虑。

entries.example: He prefers hard liquor to beer at parties.
entries.exampleZh: 聚会时他更喜欢烈性酒而不是啤酒。

entries.example: The clay will harden quickly if you leave it in the sun.
entries.exampleZh: 如果你把黏土放在太阳下，它很快就会变硬。

entries.example: Many families faced serious hardship during the long economic crisis.
entries.exampleZh: 在漫长的经济危机期间，许多家庭面临严重困难。

entries.meaning: 强壮的，耐劳的；能吃苦耐劳的，坚强的；耐寒的
entries.example: These hardy plants survive cold winters without any special care.
entries.exampleZh: 这些耐寒植物无需特别照料就能熬过寒冬。

entries.example: The choir produced a harmonious sound that pleased the whole audience.
entries.exampleZh: 合唱团发出了和谐的声音，令全场观众感到满意。

entries.example: The two neighbors live in perfect harmony despite their very different daily habits.
entries.exampleZh: 尽管日常习惯截然不同，这两位邻居仍相处得十分和谐。

entries.example: We must harness the power of the wind to produce clean electricity.
entries.exampleZh: 我们必须驾驭风的力量来生产清洁的电力。

entries.example: She played a gentle tune on the harp at the wedding ceremony.
entries.exampleZh: 她在婚礼上用竖琴弹奏了一首轻柔的乐曲。

entries.meaning: 严酷的，严峻的；粗糙的；严厉的
entries.example: The harsh winter weather made travel across the mountains extremely dangerous.
entries.exampleZh: 严酷的冬季天气使穿越山区的旅行变得极其危险。

entries.example: Heavy rain will hasten the growth of these young plants.
entries.exampleZh: 大雨会加速这些幼苗的生长。

entries.meaning: 匆忙的；草率的，轻率的；急速的，匆忙的，仓促完成的
entries.example: She made a hasty decision and later regretted it deeply.
entries.exampleZh: 她做了一个草率的决定，后来深感后悔。

entries.meaning: 孵化；策划；密谋；孵出；筹划，；舱门；开口；孵化
entries.example: The crew opened the hatch and climbed onto the deck.
entries.exampleZh: 船员打开舱门，爬上了甲板。

entries.example: His deep hatred of the cold made him move to a warmer city.
entries.exampleZh: 他对寒冷的深深憎恶使他搬到了一座更温暖的城市。

entries.example: The haughty waiter refused to answer our simple questions about the menu.
entries.exampleZh: 那个傲慢的服务员拒绝回答我们关于菜单的简单问题。

entries.meaning: 拖曳；拖运；拖，拉；拖运，运送；拖，拉，托运；一次获得的数量
entries.example: Trucks haul fresh vegetables from the farm to the market every morning.
entries.exampleZh: 每天早晨，卡车把新鲜蔬菜从农场运到市场。

entries.meaning: （鬼魂）经常出没；常出没于；使苦恼，使担忧；萦绕在心头，缠绕；常去的地方
entries.example: Old memories of that summer still haunt her whenever she visits the coast.
entries.exampleZh: 每当她来到海边，那个夏天的旧日回忆仍会萦绕在她心头。

entries.meaning: 鹰，隼；“鹰派”人物；叫卖，兜售
entries.example: A large hawk circled above the field, searching for a small meal.
entries.exampleZh: 一只大鹰在田野上空盘旋，寻找着小小的猎物。

entries.meaning: 危险；使遭危险；危险，公害；尝试着做，冒…风险
entries.example: Loose rocks on this path are a serious hazard for night walkers.
entries.exampleZh: 这条小路上松动的石头对夜间行走的人来说是严重的危险。

entries.example: Driving through thick fog at night can be extremely hazardous.
entries.exampleZh: 夜里驾车穿过浓雾会非常危险。

entries.example: We decided to head north before the storm reached the valley.
entries.exampleZh: 我们决定在暴风雨到达山谷之前向北行进。

entries.example: The heading at the top of the page was printed in bold.
entries.exampleZh: 页面顶部的标题是用粗体印刷的。

entries.example: He rushed headlong into the busy street without looking either way.
entries.exampleZh: 他没看两边就莽撞地冲进了繁忙的街道。

entries.example: The company moved its headquarters to a smaller building near the river.
entries.exampleZh: 公司把总部搬到了河边一栋较小的楼里。

entries.example: A heap of old newspapers sat in the corner of the dusty room.
entries.exampleZh: 那间满是灰尘的房间角落里放着一堆旧报纸。

entries.example: The family gathered around the warm hearth on that cold winter night.
entries.exampleZh: 在那个寒冷的冬夜，一家人围坐在温暖的炉边。

entries.example: We received a hearty welcome from the host family.
entries.exampleZh: 我们受到了寄宿家庭热情的欢迎。

entries.example: The small heater keeps my bedroom warm on cold winter nights.
entries.exampleZh: 这个小加热器在寒冷的冬夜让我的卧室保持温暖。

entries.meaning: （用力地）举起；抛；举起，提起；扔；发出；起伏，隆起；呕吐，恶心；举起，升降
entries.example: They heave the heavy box onto the truck together.
entries.exampleZh: 他们一起把那个重箱子举到卡车上。

entries.example: She whispered a prayer to heaven before the long journey.
entries.exampleZh: 在长途旅行前，她向苍天低声祈祷。

entries.example: A small stone got stuck in my left heel during the run.
entries.exampleZh: 跑步时，一颗小石子卡在了我的左脚后跟里。

entries.meaning: 加高，提高；增加；提高，加强
entries.example: Bright lights can heighten the tension before a stage performance.
entries.exampleZh: 明亮的灯光会在舞台演出前加剧紧张气氛。

entries.example: The old man named his youngest granddaughter as his only heir.
entries.exampleZh: 那位老人指定他最小的孙女为唯一继承人。

entries.example: A rescue helicopter landed on the beach to collect the injured sailors.
entries.exampleZh: 一架救援直升机降落在海滩上接走受伤的水手。

entries.meaning: 半球；地球的半球；大脑半球
entries.example: The northern hemisphere experiences colder winters than the southern one.
entries.exampleZh: 北半球经历的冬天比南半球更冷。

entries.meaning: 今后，从今以后；从今以后，从此以后
entries.example: All members must henceforth sign the attendance book before leaving.
entries.exampleZh: 所有成员从今以后离开前都必须在签到簿上签名。

entries.example: The king sent a herald to announce the new law.
entries.exampleZh: 国王派了一名传令官去宣布新法律。

entries.meaning: 草本植物；香草；药草，香草；草本植物
entries.example: She grows a fresh herb beside the kitchen window every spring.
entries.exampleZh: 她每年春天都在厨房窗边种一种新鲜香草。

entries.example: The farmers herd their sheep into the valley before sunset.
entries.exampleZh: 农民们在日落前把羊群赶进山谷。

entries.example: This ancient temple is an important part of our national heritage.
entries.exampleZh: 这座古庙是我们民族遗产的重要组成部分。

entries.meaning: 犹豫；犹豫；迟疑不决；犹豫，踌躇，含糊；不情愿
entries.example: Do not hesitate to ask for help when you feel lost.
entries.exampleZh: 当你感到迷茫时，不要犹豫寻求帮助。

entries.example: The craftsman used a thick hide to make strong leather boots.
entries.exampleZh: 工匠用一张厚兽皮做了结实的皮靴。

entries.meaning: 等级制度；统治集团，领导层
entries.example: The company follows a strict hierarchy from manager to new staff.
entries.exampleZh: 公司从经理到新员工都遵循严格的等级制度。

entries.meaning: 强调，突出，使显著；最精彩的部分，最重要的事件
entries.example: The final song was the highlight of the whole concert.
entries.exampleZh: 最后一首歌是整场音乐会最精彩的部分。

entries.example: Two strangers tried to hijack the bus near the border.
entries.exampleZh: 两名陌生人在边境附近试图劫持那辆公共汽车。

entries.meaning: 作长途徒步旅行；徒步旅行；徒步旅行；增加，上升；提高
entries.example: We plan a long hike through the forest next Saturday morning.
entries.exampleZh: 我们计划下周六上午穿森林进行长途徒步旅行。

entries.example: Heavy rain may hinder our progress along the muddy mountain path.
entries.exampleZh: 大雨可能会阻碍我们沿着泥泞山路行进。

entries.example: A lack of money was a serious hindrance to the project.
entries.exampleZh: 资金短缺是这个项目的一大障碍。

entries.meaning: 合页，折叶，铰链；以…为转移；铰链；装铰链
entries.example: The old wooden door squeaked on its rusty hinge every morning.
entries.exampleZh: 那扇旧木门每天早上都在生锈的合页上吱吱作响。

entries.example: She hurt her hip while climbing over the garden wall.
entries.exampleZh: 她翻越花园围墙时伤了髋部。

entries.example: We heard a loud hiss as the steam escaped from the pipe.
entries.exampleZh: 蒸汽从管道里漏出时，我们听到一声响亮的嘶嘶声。

entries.meaning: 历史学家；编史家；历史学家，史学工作者
entries.example: A local historian wrote a detailed book about our old town.
entries.exampleZh: 一位当地历史学家写了一本关于我们老镇的详尽著作。

entries.example: The two leaders signed a historic agreement in the great hall.
entries.exampleZh: 两位领导人在大厅里签署了一项历史性协议。

entries.example: Her first song became a huge hit across the whole country.
entries.exampleZh: 她的第一首歌在全国范围内一炮而红。

entries.meaning: 迄今，到目前为止；到目前为止，迄今
entries.example: The plan has hitherto failed to attract any serious support.
entries.exampleZh: 这项计划迄今未能吸引任何认真的支持。

entries.example: After the long concert his voice sounded hoarse and very tired.
entries.exampleZh: 长音乐会结束后，他的嗓子听起来沙哑而疲惫。

entries.example: Every spring the farmers hoe the fields behind the village school.
entries.exampleZh: 每年春天，农民们都会在村小学后面的地里锄地。

entries.meaning: 升起，扯起来；举起，升起，吊起；起重器械；举起，升起，吊起
entries.example: They used a rope to hoist the heavy box onto the truck.
entries.exampleZh: 他们用绳子把那个沉重的箱子吊上了卡车。

entries.example: The children hollow out a pumpkin to make a lantern.
entries.exampleZh: 孩子们把南瓜挖空来做灯笼。

entries.example: The small restaurant serves simple homely food at very fair prices.
entries.exampleZh: 这家小餐馆以非常公道的价格供应简单的家常饭菜。

entries.meaning: 同类的；同种类的，同性质的，有相同特征的
entries.example: The population of the island is remarkably homogeneous in language and custom.
entries.exampleZh: 这个岛上的人口在语言和习俗上非常单一。

entries.example: The university gave her an honorary degree for her charity work.
entries.exampleZh: 这所大学因她的慈善工作而授予她荣誉学位。

entries.example: She used a bent wire to hook the keys out of the drain.
entries.exampleZh: 她用一根弯曲的铁丝把钥匙从下水道里钩了出来。

entries.meaning: （人）单足跳；单足跳跃，单足跳行；齐足跳跃，齐足跳行；跳上；蹦跳；短程航行
entries.example: The little bird would hop from branch to branch in the morning.
entries.exampleZh: 那只小鸟早晨会在树枝间跳来跳去。

entries.example: The sun sank slowly below the horizon as we walked home.
entries.exampleZh: 我们走回家时，太阳慢慢沉到地平线以下。

entries.example: The driver pressed the horn twice before entering the narrow tunnel.
entries.exampleZh: 司机在驶入狭窄的隧道前按了两次喇叭。

entries.meaning: 软管；袜类（包括连裤袜、长筒袜、短袜）；软管，水龙带；用软管淋浇
entries.example: The gardener used a long hose to water the flowers.
entries.exampleZh: 园丁用一根长软管给花浇水。

entries.meaning: 友好；好客，殷勤；友好款待，好客
entries.example: The family showed great hospitality to every guest at dinner.
entries.exampleZh: 这家人对每位晚餐客人都表现出极大的好客。

entries.example: They will host a charity concert in the town hall.
entries.exampleZh: 他们将在市政厅主持一场慈善音乐会。

entries.example: The police hoped to free the hostage without any danger.
entries.exampleZh: 警方希望在不发生任何危险的情况下解救人质。

entries.example: The hostess greeted us warmly and showed us to our seats.
entries.exampleZh: 女主人热情地迎接我们，并带我们到座位上。

entries.meaning: 有敌意的；敌对的；不友好的；敌方的，不友善的
entries.example: The crowd grew hostile when the speaker refused to answer questions.
entries.exampleZh: 当演讲者拒绝回答问题时，人群变得充满敌意。

entries.example: There was clear hostility between the two rival teams.
entries.exampleZh: 两支敌对队伍之间明显存在敌意。

entries.example: The old hound slept quietly beside the warm kitchen fire.
entries.exampleZh: 那只老猎犬安静地睡在温暖的厨房炉火旁。

entries.example: The bill passed the lower house after a long debate.
entries.exampleZh: 经过长时间辩论，该法案在下议院获得通过。

entries.meaning: 家庭，一家人；家庭的，家喻户晓的；家庭，户；家务
entries.example: Every household in the village received a notice about the water supply.
entries.exampleZh: 村里的每一户都收到了关于供水的通知。

entries.meaning: 徘徊；傍徨；翱翔；盘旋；翱翔；逗留在近旁，徘徊；彷徨，犹豫
entries.example: A small drone began to hover above the crowded beach.
entries.exampleZh: 一架小型无人机开始在拥挤的海滩上方盘旋。

entries.meaning: 嚎叫；哀号；吠；嗥叫；呼啸；吼叫，哀号
entries.example: We heard a lonely howl from the hills at midnight.
entries.exampleZh: 午夜时我们听到山间传来一声孤独的嚎叫。

entries.meaning: 聚集在一起，挤作一团；把身子蜷成一团，蜷缩；使聚集在一起；挤在一起的人；一堆杂乱的东西
entries.example: The children huddle together under the blanket during the storm.
entries.exampleZh: 暴风雨期间，孩子们挤在毯子下缩成一团。

entries.meaning: 搂；紧紧拥抱；紧抱在一起，互相拥抱；拥抱；紧抱，怀抱；紧抱，热烈拥抱
entries.example: She gave her little brother a warm hug at the airport.
entries.exampleZh: 她在机场给了小弟弟一个温暖的拥抱。

entries.example: The ship's hull was damaged after hitting a hidden rock.
entries.exampleZh: 船体在撞上一块隐藏的岩石后受损。

entries.meaning: 嗡嗡声；哼曲子；哼曲子；发嗡嗡声；哼；嗡嗡声，营营声，嘈杂声
entries.example: The old machine began to hum softly in the corner.
entries.exampleZh: 那台旧机器开始在角落里轻轻地嗡嗡作响。

entries.example: Her humanistic approach to teaching values curiosity and personal growth.
entries.exampleZh: 她的以人为本的教学方法重视好奇心和个人成长。

entries.example: The charity sends humanitarian aid to families affected by the flood.
entries.exampleZh: 该慈善机构向受洪水影响的家庭提供人道主义援助。

entries.meaning: 人类；人性，人情；人类，人；人性；人道，博爱；人文学科
entries.example: Climate change is a serious threat to all humanity.
entries.exampleZh: 气候变化对全人类构成严重威胁。

entries.meaning: 谦逊的；地位低下的；简陋的；使谦恭；使卑下
entries.example: Despite his success, he remained humble and kind to everyone.
entries.exampleZh: 尽管取得了成功，他对每个人仍然谦逊友善。

entries.meaning: 湿气；湿度；湿度，潮湿，湿气
entries.example: The high humidity made the hot afternoon feel even worse.
entries.exampleZh: 很高的湿度让炎热的下午感觉更加难受。

entries.example: My uncle is a humorous man who loves telling funny stories.
entries.exampleZh: 我叔叔是个幽默的人，喜欢讲有趣的故事。

entries.meaning: 猛投；猛投；猛冲；猛投，狠掷；大声叫骂
entries.example: Do not hurl stones at the birds in the park.
entries.exampleZh: 不要向公园里的鸟儿扔石头。

entries.example: We all shouted hurrah when the team scored the final goal.
entries.exampleZh: 我们队攻入最后一球时，大家都高喊“好哇”。

entries.example: The hurricane destroyed hundreds of homes along the coast last night.
entries.exampleZh: 昨晚的飓风摧毁了沿海数百座房屋。

entries.example: The hurt in his voice was easy to hear.
entries.exampleZh: 他声音中的伤痛很容易听出来。

entries.example: A sudden hush fell over the room when she entered.
entries.exampleZh: 她进来时，房间里突然一片寂静。

entries.meaning: 催促，赶紧做；猛推，挤，强迫；忙碌，奔忙；挤
entries.example: We had to hustle to catch the last bus home.
entries.exampleZh: 我们不得不赶紧跑，才赶上回家的末班公交车。

entries.example: The workers used a hydraulic lift to raise the heavy machine.
entries.exampleZh: 工人们用液压升降机把沉重的机器抬了起来。

entries.example: Burning this hydrocarbon releases a large amount of heat energy.
entries.exampleZh: 燃烧这种碳氢化合物会释放大量热能。

entries.example: The whole village sang a beautiful hymn at the morning service.
entries.exampleZh: 全村人在晨祷时唱了一首优美的赞美诗。

entries.meaning: 假设，假说；假设；前提；假设，假说，前提
entries.example: Our teacher asked us to test the hypothesis with a simple experiment.
entries.exampleZh: 老师让我们用一个简单的实验来检验这个假设。

entries.meaning: 情绪异常激动的，歇斯底里般的
entries.example: She became hysterical when she heard the terrible news.
entries.exampleZh: 听到那个可怕的消息时，她变得歇斯底里。

entries.example: Please ice the cake before you serve it to the guests.
entries.exampleZh: 请在把蛋糕端给客人之前给它抹上糖霜。

entries.example: The icy wind blew through the empty streets all night long.
entries.exampleZh: 冰冷的寒风整夜吹过空荡荡的街道。

entries.meaning: 理想的，观念的，空想的；理想，理想的东西
entries.example: This quiet room is an ideal place for reading and study.
entries.exampleZh: 这间安静的房间是读书学习的理想场所。

entries.example: Her youthful idealism slowly gave way to practical common sense.
entries.exampleZh: 她年轻时的理想主义慢慢让位于务实的常识。

entries.example: The new library should ideally be built close to the main station.
entries.exampleZh: 新图书馆理想上应该建在火车站附近。

entries.meaning: 相同的；同一的；恒等的；完全相同的，同一的
entries.example: The two brothers wore identical shirts to the school party.
entries.exampleZh: 两兄弟穿着完全相同的衬衫去参加学校的聚会。

entries.meaning: 身份证；认出，鉴定；身份证明；鉴定，验明，认出；认同
entries.example: Please bring some form of identification when you come to the office.
entries.exampleZh: 你来办公室时请带上某种身份证明。

entries.meaning: 认出，识别；认出，鉴定；把…等同于
entries.example: The witness could identify the driver from a distant photograph.
entries.exampleZh: 证人能从一张远处的照片中认出那名司机。

entries.example: The two parties hold very different ideological views on public spending.
entries.exampleZh: 两党在公共支出上持有非常不同的意识形态观点。

entries.example: The newspaper described the conflict as ideologically rather than economically motivated.
entries.exampleZh: 该报纸将这场冲突描述为出于意识形态而非经济动机。

entries.meaning: 意识形态；思想，思想意识
entries.example: His political ideology shaped every decision he made as mayor.
entries.exampleZh: 他的政治意识形态影响了他在担任市长期间做出的每一个决定。

entries.example: The phrase is a common idiom among older speakers in that region.
entries.exampleZh: 这个短语是该地区年长说话者中的一个常见习语。

entries.meaning: 白痴；傻子；白痴；傻子，笨蛋
entries.example: Only an idiot would leave the oven on all night.
entries.exampleZh: 只有白痴才会让烤箱整夜开着。

entries.example: Her sudden idleness worried her family after years of hard work.
entries.exampleZh: 她突然的闲散让家人在多年辛苦工作之后感到担忧。

entries.meaning: 引燃，着火；着火；点燃，引发
entries.example: A single spark can ignite the dry grass beside the road.
entries.exampleZh: 一个火星就能点燃路边的干草。

entries.example: His loud confidence only revealed his deep ignorance of the subject.
entries.exampleZh: 他响亮的自信只暴露出他对这个主题的深深无知。

entries.example: Do not ignore the warning signs that your body is giving you.
entries.exampleZh: 不要忽视身体向你发出的警告信号。

entries.example: It is illegal to park your car on this narrow street.
entries.exampleZh: 在这条狭窄的街道上停车是违法的。

entries.example: Many adults in the village remain illiterate despite the new school.
entries.exampleZh: 尽管有了新学校，村里许多成年人仍然是文盲。

entries.meaning: 阐释，阐明；照明，照亮；阐明；照明，照亮；阐明，启发
entries.example: The guide used a simple diagram to illuminate the difficult idea.
entries.exampleZh: 向导用一张简单的示意图阐明这个难懂的想法。

entries.meaning: 幻想；错觉；假象；幻想，错误的观念；错觉，幻觉，假象
entries.example: The mirror creates the illusion that the room is much larger.
entries.exampleZh: 这面镜子造成了房间大得多的错觉。

entries.example: Please illustrate your main point with a clear and simple example.
entries.exampleZh: 请用一个清楚简单的例子来说明你的主要观点。

entries.example: The child described an imaginary friend who lived under her bed.
entries.exampleZh: 那个孩子描述了一个住在她床下的想象中的朋友。

entries.meaning: 富有想象力的，爱想象的
entries.example: Her imaginative story turned a simple walk into a great adventure.
entries.exampleZh: 她富有想象力的故事把一次简单的散步变成了一场伟大的冒险。

entries.example: The report pointed to a serious imbalance between wages and living costs.
entries.exampleZh: 报告指出工资与生活成本之间存在严重的不平衡。

entries.example: Young children often imitate the way their parents speak at dinner.
entries.exampleZh: 幼儿常常模仿父母在晚餐时说话的方式。

entries.meaning: 仿制品，伪制物；模仿；仿制，伪制品；赝品
entries.example: The bag looks like leather, but it is a cheap imitation.
entries.exampleZh: 这个包看起来像皮革，但它是廉价的仿制品。

entries.meaning: 巨大的；广大的，巨大的；无限的
entries.example: The immense desert stretched for miles in every direction.
entries.exampleZh: 那片巨大的沙漠向四面八方延伸数英里。

entries.example: I enjoyed the concert immensely and hope they return soon.
entries.exampleZh: 我非常喜欢那场音乐会，希望他们很快再来。

entries.meaning: 沉浸；给…施洗礼；使浸没；使沉浸在，使专心于
entries.example: She likes to immerse herself in novels every quiet evening.
entries.exampleZh: 她喜欢在每一个安静的夜晚沉浸在小说里。

entries.example: The new video game offers an immersive world for players.
entries.exampleZh: 这款新电子游戏为玩家提供了一个身临其境的世界。

entries.example: My neighbour, a recent immigrant, opened a small bakery downtown.
entries.exampleZh: 我的邻居是位新移民，在市中心开了一家小面包店。

entries.example: Many families immigrate to Canada hoping for better opportunities.
entries.exampleZh: 许多家庭移居加拿大，希望获得更好的机会。

entries.example: The government announced new rules about immigration last week.
entries.exampleZh: 政府上周宣布了关于移民的新规定。

entries.example: Dark clouds suggested that a storm was imminent that afternoon.
entries.exampleZh: 乌云表明那天下午一场暴风雨即将来临。

entries.example: The poet believed his words would make him immortal.
entries.exampleZh: 那位诗人相信他的诗句会让他名垂不朽。

entries.meaning: 免疫的，有免疫力的，不受影响的；免除的，豁免的
entries.example: Children who had the illness are now immune to it.
entries.exampleZh: 得过这种病的孩子现在对它有了免疫力。

entries.example: The heavy rain had a serious impact on the harvest.
entries.exampleZh: 大雨对收成造成了严重的影响。

entries.example: Loud music for hours can impair your hearing over time.
entries.exampleZh: 长时间大声听音乐会损害你的听力。

entries.meaning: 传授，教授；给予；传递；告诉；告知，透露；赋予，给予
entries.example: Good teachers impart knowledge and also inspire curiosity.
entries.exampleZh: 好的老师既传授知识，也激发好奇心。

entries.example: A judge must remain impartial while listening to both sides.
entries.exampleZh: 法官在听取双方陈述时必须保持公正。

entries.meaning: 不耐烦的，急躁的；热切的，急切的
entries.example: The passengers grew impatient as the delayed train arrived.
entries.exampleZh: 列车晚点，乘客们渐渐变得不耐烦。

entries.meaning: 必须的,必要的；必要的；紧急的，极重要的；命令的；必要的事，必须完成的事；【语】祈使语气
entries.example: It is imperative that we finish this report by Friday.
entries.exampleZh: 我们必须在周五之前完成这份报告，这一点至关重要。

entries.meaning: 帝国的；帝国的，帝王的；英制的
entries.example: The museum displays imperial treasures from ancient China.
entries.exampleZh: 博物馆展出中国古代的皇家珍宝。

entries.example: Her success gave fresh impetus to the whole research team.
entries.exampleZh: 她的成功为整个研究团队带来了新的推动力。

entries.meaning: 工具；贯彻；使生效，履行，实施；工具，器具，用具
entries.example: Workers will implement the new safety rules next month.
entries.exampleZh: 工人们将在下个月实施新的安全规定。

entries.meaning: 含意，暗示，暗指；卷入，牵连
entries.example: He did not understand the implication behind her quiet smile.
entries.exampleZh: 他没有理解她浅浅微笑背后的含义。

entries.meaning: 不言明的，含蓄的；内含的，固有的；无疑问的
entries.example: Her silence gave implicit support to the plan.
entries.exampleZh: 她的沉默给了这个计划含蓄的支持。

entries.example: I implore you to reconsider your final decision carefully.
entries.exampleZh: 我恳求你仔细重新考虑你的最终决定。

entries.example: His words imply that he is not satisfied.
entries.exampleZh: 他的话暗示他并不满意。

entries.meaning: 强加于；将（想法、信仰等）强加于（某人）；把…强加；征
entries.example: The government decided to impose new taxes on imported goods.
entries.exampleZh: 政府决定对进口商品征收新税。

entries.example: The official will impress the seal on the document.
entries.exampleZh: 官员将在文件上盖章。

entries.example: The judge decided to imprison the thief for five years.
entries.exampleZh: 法官决定将小偷监禁五年。

entries.example: Using a phone during the exam is improper behavior.
entries.exampleZh: 考试期间使用手机是不适当的行为。

entries.meaning: 冲动；推动；冲动，一时的念头；推动，驱使；脉冲
entries.example: She bought the expensive dress on a sudden impulse.
entries.exampleZh: 她一时冲动买下了那条昂贵的裙子。

entries.example: His impulsive decision to quit his job surprised everyone.
entries.exampleZh: 他冲动辞职的决定让所有人都感到惊讶。

entries.example: The water sample contained a small impurity that caused illness.
entries.exampleZh: 水样中含有一种导致疾病的小杂质。

entries.example: The mountain village remains inaccessible by road during winter.
entries.exampleZh: 那个山村在冬季仍然无法通过公路到达。

entries.example: The report was inaccurate and caused a lot of confusion.
entries.exampleZh: 这份报告不准确，引起了很多混乱。

entries.example: The government's inaction on climate change worries many scientists.
entries.exampleZh: 政府在气候变化上的不作为让许多科学家担忧。

entries.meaning: 不足的；不充足的，不适当的
entries.example: The food supply was inadequate for the growing population.
entries.exampleZh: 食物供应对于不断增长的人口来说是不充足的。

entries.example: A rock is an inanimate object that cannot move by itself.
entries.exampleZh: 石头是无生命的物体，不能自己移动。

entries.example: You might as well help us, inasmuch as you are here.
entries.exampleZh: 既然你在这里，你不妨帮帮我们。

entries.meaning: 使就职；开始；开始，开展；为…举行就职典礼；为…举行开幕式，为…举行落成仪式
entries.example: The city will inaugurate the new library next month.
entries.exampleZh: 该市将于下个月为新图书馆举行落成典礼。

entries.meaning: 不可估量的，无法计算的
entries.example: The storm caused incalculable damage to the coastal towns.
entries.exampleZh: 这场风暴对沿海城镇造成了不可估量的损失。

entries.example: He seems incapable of understanding other people's feelings.
entries.exampleZh: 他似乎无法理解别人的感受。

entries.example: The temple was filled with the smell of burning incense.
entries.exampleZh: 寺庙里充满了燃烧的香的气味。

entries.example: The company offers a cash incentive for employees who finish the course early.
entries.exampleZh: 公司为提前完成课程的员工提供现金奖励。

entries.meaning: 发生率；发生率，影响；入射
entries.example: The incidence of flu usually rises during the colder winter months.
entries.exampleZh: 流感的发生率通常在较冷的冬季月份上升。

entries.example: Police are investigating a strange incident near the train station last night.
entries.exampleZh: 警方正在调查昨晚火车站附近发生的一起奇怪事件。

entries.meaning: 顺便地，附带；附带地；顺便提及；顺便提及地，顺便提一句
entries.example: The meeting, incidentally, has been moved to Friday afternoon.
entries.exampleZh: 顺便提一句，会议已改到周五下午。

entries.example: She has little inclination to attend parties after a long workday.
entries.exampleZh: 长时间工作后，她不太想去参加聚会。

entries.example: The path begins with a steep incline before reaching the lake.
entries.exampleZh: 这条小路在到达湖边之前有一段陡峭的斜坡。

entries.meaning: 包括的；包括一切的，包括一切费用在内的；所有数目包括在内的
entries.example: The tour price is inclusive of meals, tickets, and local transport.
entries.exampleZh: 旅游价格包含餐食、门票和当地交通。

entries.example: The engineers discovered a serious incompatibility between the new software and old printers.
entries.exampleZh: 工程师发现新软件与旧打印机之间存在严重的不兼容问题。

entries.example: This charger is incompatible with my laptop, so I cannot use it.
entries.exampleZh: 这个充电器与我的笔记本电脑不兼容，所以我不能用它。

entries.example: His constant incompetence at work finally led to his dismissal.
entries.exampleZh: 他在工作中一贯无能，最终导致他被解雇。

entries.example: The manager was clearly incompetent and failed to solve simple problems.
entries.exampleZh: 这位经理显然不称职，连简单的问题都解决不了。

entries.example: My application was returned because the attached form was incomplete.
entries.exampleZh: 我的申请被退回了，因为所附表格不完整。

entries.meaning: 合并；体现；结合，合并，收编；包含；加上，吸收；把…合并，使并入
entries.example: We plan to incorporate your suggestions into the final design.
entries.exampleZh: 我们计划把你的建议纳入最终设计。

entries.meaning: 难以置信的，惊人的；不能相信的，不可信的，难以置信的；惊人的
entries.example: The view from the mountain top was truly incredible at sunrise.
entries.exampleZh: 日出时山顶的景色真是令人难以置信。

entries.meaning: 引起，导致；招致，引起；遭受
entries.example: You will incur extra fees if you pay the bill late.
entries.exampleZh: 如果你逾期支付账单，就会产生额外费用。

entries.meaning: 无限期的；无限期的；模糊的，不确定的
entries.example: The project has been delayed for an indefinite period due to funding issues.
entries.exampleZh: 由于资金问题，该项目已被无限期推迟。

entries.example: She moved abroad to gain independence from her parents.
entries.exampleZh: 她搬到国外以摆脱对父母的依赖，获得独立。

entries.example: The consumer price index rose slightly last month, according to official figures.
entries.exampleZh: 据官方数据，上月消费者价格指数略有上升。

entries.example: These results indicate that the new teaching method is working well.
entries.exampleZh: 这些结果表明新的教学方法效果良好。

entries.example: There is no indication that the weather will improve tomorrow.
entries.exampleZh: 没有迹象表明明天天气会好转。

entries.meaning: 指示的；指示的；陈述的；标示的，指示的，象征的；陈述的；【语】陈述语气
entries.example: His silence was indicative of a deeper problem.
entries.exampleZh: 他的沉默暗示着更深层的问题。

entries.meaning: 冷漠的；冷漠的，不积极的；一般的，平平的
entries.example: She seemed indifferent to the criticism from her colleagues.
entries.exampleZh: 她对同事们的批评似乎漠不关心。

entries.example: He was indignant when they blamed him for the delay.
entries.exampleZh: 当他们把延误归咎于他时，他十分愤慨。

entries.example: Her voice shook with indignation as she described the unfair treatment.
entries.exampleZh: 她描述那不公平的待遇时，声音因愤慨而颤抖。

entries.meaning: 不加选择地，不加区分地
entries.example: The factory dumped its waste indiscriminately into the river.
entries.exampleZh: 那家工厂不加区分地把废物倾倒进河里。

entries.meaning: 必不可少的；必不可少的，必需的
entries.example: A good dictionary is indispensable for serious language learners.
entries.exampleZh: 对认真的语言学习者来说，一本好词典是必不可少的。

entries.meaning: 特殊的；个别的；独特的；个人，个体
entries.example: Each individual in the group had a different opinion.
entries.exampleZh: 小组里的每个人都有不同的看法。

entries.example: We moved the party to an indoor space because of rain.
entries.exampleZh: 因为下雨，我们把聚会移到了室内场地。

entries.meaning: 劝诱；引起；引导，劝；引起，导致
entries.example: Nothing could induce him to change his mind about the trip.
entries.exampleZh: 什么也无法劝他改变关于这次旅行的主意。

entries.example: The new professor gave a short speech at his induction.
entries.exampleZh: 这位新教授在就职仪式上作了简短的发言。

entries.meaning: 放纵；放纵（感情），纵情；沉溺，纵容自己，肆意从事；使沉溺于，满足；纵容，迁就
entries.example: She rarely allows herself to indulge in expensive desserts.
entries.exampleZh: 她很少容许自己尽情享用昂贵的甜点。

entries.example: The city grew quickly during the industrial revolution of the 1800s.
entries.exampleZh: 这座城市在十九世纪的工业革命期间迅速发展。

entries.example: The industrious student finished all her assignments before dinner.
entries.exampleZh: 那个勤奋的学生在晚饭前完成了所有作业。

entries.example: This medicine proved ineffective against the stubborn cough.
entries.exampleZh: 这种药对这种顽固的咳嗽证明无效。

entries.meaning: 惯性；无力；不活动，惰性；惯性
entries.example: The car kept moving forward because of its inertia.
entries.exampleZh: 由于惯性，汽车继续向前移动。

entries.example: The conclusion was inescapable once all the evidence was examined.
entries.exampleZh: 一旦审查了所有证据，这个结论就不可避免。

entries.meaning: 不可避免的；不可避免的，必然的
entries.example: A small delay was inevitable given the heavy traffic today.
entries.exampleZh: 鉴于今天交通拥堵，一点小延误是不可避免的。

entries.example: Such mistakes will inevitably happen when people work under pressure.
entries.exampleZh: 人们在压力下工作时，这类错误不可避免地会发生。

entries.example: Her patience with young children seemed almost inexhaustible.
entries.exampleZh: 她对小孩子的耐心似乎几乎无穷无尽。

entries.example: The infant slept quietly in her mother's arms.
entries.exampleZh: 婴儿在母亲怀里安静地睡着了。

entries.example: A single sick patient can infect many people in a crowded room.
entries.exampleZh: 一个生病的人就能在拥挤的房间里感染很多人。

entries.meaning: 感染的，传染的；传染的；感染性的；传染的，有传染性的；有感染力的
entries.example: Her laughter was so infectious that the whole room began to smile.
entries.exampleZh: 她的笑声极具感染力，整个房间的人都笑了起来。

entries.example: From these figures we can infer that sales have fallen sharply.
entries.exampleZh: 从这些数字我们可以推断出销售额已经大幅下降。

entries.example: The detective drew a careful inference from the muddy footprints near the door.
entries.exampleZh: 侦探根据门边泥泞的脚印得出了一个谨慎的推论。

entries.meaning: 比……差；下级；晚辈；次品；下等的，劣等的；下级，下属
entries.example: This cheap model is clearly inferior to the one we bought last year.
entries.exampleZh: 这款便宜的型号明显不如我们去年买的那一款。

entries.example: Constant criticism gave the boy a deep sense of inferiority.
entries.exampleZh: 不断的批评使这个男孩产生了深深的自卑感。

entries.meaning: 无限；无穷（大）；无限的，无数的
entries.example: The desert seemed to stretch out in an infinite expanse of sand.
entries.exampleZh: 沙漠似乎延伸成一片无边无际的沙地。

entries.example: Space is infinitely large, which is hard for the human mind to grasp.
entries.exampleZh: 宇宙无限广大，这是人类头脑难以把握的。

entries.example: The stars seemed to reach out toward infinity on that clear night.
entries.exampleZh: 那个晴朗的夜晚，星星仿佛一直延伸到无穷远处。

entries.meaning: 通货膨胀；通货膨胀，物价飞涨
entries.example: Rising inflation has made basic food much more expensive for ordinary families.
entries.exampleZh: 不断上涨的通货膨胀使普通家庭的基本食品贵了很多。

entries.meaning: 把…强加给；使…遭受，使…承担
entries.example: The storm will inflict serious damage on coastal villages tonight.
entries.exampleZh: 这场风暴今晚将给沿海村庄造成严重破坏。

entries.example: He used his influence to get his son into a top school.
entries.exampleZh: 他利用自己的权势把儿子送进了一所顶尖学校。

entries.example: She became one of the most influential writers of her generation.
entries.exampleZh: 她成为她那一代最有影响力的作家之一。

entries.meaning: 精巧制成的；机灵的；设计独特的，别致的，巧妙的；灵巧的，善于创造发明的
entries.example: The engineer found an ingenious way to cool the building without electricity.
entries.exampleZh: 这位工程师找到了一种巧妙的方法，不用电就能给大楼降温。

entries.example: Solving this puzzle requires patience and a good deal of ingenuity.
entries.exampleZh: 解开这个谜题需要耐心和相当多的巧思。

entries.meaning: 配料，成分；组成部分，原料；要素
entries.example: Fresh ginger is the secret ingredient in my grandmother's soup.
entries.exampleZh: 新鲜的姜是我奶奶的汤里的秘密配料。

entries.example: Rare birds inhabit the marshes along this quiet stretch of coast.
entries.exampleZh: 珍稀鸟类栖息在这段宁静海岸边的沼泽地里。

entries.example: Every inhabitant of the island knows the old lighthouse keeper.
entries.exampleZh: 岛上的每一位居民都认识那位老灯塔看守人。

entries.example: Do not inhale the fumes while you are painting the walls.
entries.exampleZh: 刷墙的时候不要吸入那些气体。

entries.meaning: 固有的；固有的，生来的；内在的；固有的，生来就有的
entries.example: There is an inherent risk in climbing that mountain in winter.
entries.exampleZh: 冬季攀登那座山存在固有的风险。

entries.example: She will inherit her grandmother's small house next spring.
entries.exampleZh: 明年春天她将继承祖母的小房子。

entries.example: The old farm was his only inheritance from his parents.
entries.exampleZh: 那座旧农场是他从父母那里得到的唯一遗产。

entries.example: Cold weather can inhibit the growth of these tropical plants.
entries.exampleZh: 寒冷的天气会抑制这些热带植物的生长。

entries.meaning: 初步的，最初的；词首的；最初的，开始的；首字母
entries.example: My initial reaction to the news was complete surprise.
entries.exampleZh: 我对这个消息的最初反应是完全惊讶。

entries.example: Initially the team planned to leave, but the storm changed everything.
entries.exampleZh: 起初团队打算离开，但暴风雨改变了一切。

entries.meaning: 开始，创始；启蒙；开始，创造，发起；使初步了解；接纳，让…加入；新加入组织的人
entries.example: The club will initiate new members during a short ceremony.
entries.exampleZh: 俱乐部将在简短的仪式上接纳新成员。

entries.meaning: 主动性；倡议；新方案；主动性，首创精神；主动的行动，倡议；主动权
entries.example: She took the initiative and called the hospital herself.
entries.exampleZh: 她主动采取行动，亲自给医院打了电话。

entries.meaning: 注射；注满；喷射；注射，给…注射；注入，引入，投入
entries.example: The nurse will inject the medicine into his left arm.
entries.exampleZh: 护士会把药注射进他的左臂。

entries.example: The workers protested against the injustice of the new rules.
entries.exampleZh: 工人们抗议新规定的不公正。

entries.meaning: 国内的；内地的；在内地，向内地；内陆的，内地的
entries.example: They drove inland to visit a quiet village in the hills.
entries.exampleZh: 他们向内陆行驶，去参观山间一个安静的村庄。

entries.meaning: 水湾；进口；小湾，水湾；进口，入口
entries.example: A small boat rested in the quiet inlet near the rocks.
entries.exampleZh: 一条小船停在岩石附近安静的水湾里。

entries.meaning: 创新，革新；创新，改革；新设施；新方法，新事物；革新，创新
entries.example: This new phone is a real innovation in battery design.
entries.exampleZh: 这款新手机在电池设计上是一项真正的创新。

entries.example: Innumerable stars filled the sky above the sleeping village.
entries.exampleZh: 无数的星星布满了沉睡村庄上方的天空。

entries.example: Rocks and metals are inorganic materials found in nature.
entries.exampleZh: 岩石和金属是自然界中的无机材料。

entries.meaning: 输入；输入；投入的资金，输入的数据；把…输入计算机
entries.example: We need your input before we finalize the travel plan.
entries.exampleZh: 在我们最终确定旅行计划之前，需要你的意见。

entries.example: I will inquire about the train times at the desk.
entries.exampleZh: 我会在服务台询问火车时刻。

entries.meaning: 极蠢的，荒唐的；精神病的，精神失常的，疯狂的
entries.example: It seems insane to swim in such cold water.
entries.exampleZh: 在这么冷的水里游泳似乎太荒唐了。

entries.example: A tiny insect landed on my hand during the walk.
entries.exampleZh: 散步时一只小昆虫落在了我的手上。

entries.meaning: 插入，放进；插入，嵌入；登载
entries.example: Please insert your card and wait for the machine.
entries.exampleZh: 请插入你的卡，然后等待机器。

entries.meaning: 洞察力；洞悉，见识；洞察力；洞悉，深刻的见解
entries.example: Her book offers useful insight into modern family life.
entries.exampleZh: 她的书对现代家庭生活提供了有用的见解。

entries.example: The small mistake seemed insignificant at the time, but it caused trouble later.
entries.exampleZh: 那个小错误当时似乎无关紧要，但后来却引起了麻烦。

entries.meaning: 坚持；坚持要求；坚决认为
entries.example: I insist that you take a break before we continue this difficult work.
entries.exampleZh: 我坚持要你在我们继续这项困难工作之前休息一下。

entries.example: Her insistent questions made it clear that she wanted the whole truth.
entries.exampleZh: 她一再追问，显然她想知道全部真相。

entries.example: The inspector checked every room carefully before signing the final report.
entries.exampleZh: 检查员在签署最终报告前仔细检查了每个房间。

entries.meaning: 灵感；妙想；鼓舞；灵感；鼓舞人心的人
entries.example: The quiet forest gave her the inspiration she needed for a new painting.
entries.exampleZh: 安静的森林给了她创作新画所需的灵感。

entries.example: Good teachers inspire their students to ask better questions and think deeply.
entries.exampleZh: 好老师激励学生提出更好的问题并深入思考。

entries.example: The political instability in the region has made travel plans difficult.
entries.exampleZh: 该地区的政治不稳定使旅行计划变得困难。

entries.example: We plan to install a new printer beside the main office desk.
entries.exampleZh: 我们计划在主办公桌旁安装一台新打印机。

entries.meaning: 分期付款；分期付款，分期交付；部分
entries.example: She pays for the car in one monthly installment over five years.
entries.exampleZh: 她每月分期付款，五年内付清这辆车的钱。

entries.example: This is one clear instance of how teamwork can solve a problem.
entries.exampleZh: 这是一个团队合作如何解决问题的明显例子。

entries.example: The new phone app gives instant answers to almost any simple question.
entries.exampleZh: 这款新手机应用能对几乎任何简单问题给出即时答案。

entries.meaning: 即时的，瞬间的；瞬间的，即刻的
entries.example: The camera provides almost instantaneous results, so we can check each shot.
entries.exampleZh: 相机几乎能即时显示结果，因此我们可以检查每张照片。

entries.example: His first instinct was to run, but he stayed and helped.
entries.exampleZh: 他的第一本能是逃跑，但他留下来帮忙了。

entries.example: She instinctively stepped back when the dog began to bark loudly.
entries.exampleZh: 当狗开始大声吠叫时，她本能地后退了一步。

entries.meaning: 研究所，学会，学院；研究所，学院；建立，设立
entries.example: The institute offers free evening classes to local students every year.
entries.exampleZh: 该研究所每年为当地学生提供免费夜校课程。

entries.example: The old library is an important institution in our small town.
entries.exampleZh: 这座古老的图书馆是我们小镇上的重要机构。

entries.example: The coach will instruct the team on safety before the match starts.
entries.exampleZh: 比赛开始前，教练将指导队伍注意安全。

entries.example: The teacher shared an instructional video to explain the difficult science project.
entries.exampleZh: 老师分享了一段教学视频来解释这个困难的科学项目。

entries.example: Our driving instructor remained calm even when I made a serious mistake.
entries.exampleZh: 即使我犯了一个严重错误，我们的驾驶教练仍然保持冷静。

entries.example: The doctor used a small instrument to check the patient's sore throat.
entries.exampleZh: 医生用一个小仪器检查病人疼痛的喉咙。

entries.meaning: 器乐的；有帮助的；起作用的，有帮助的；用乐器演奏的
entries.example: Her support was instrumental in helping the team finish the project on time.
entries.exampleZh: 她的支持对团队按时完成项目起了关键作用。

entries.example: The evidence was insufficient to support the serious claim made by the witness.
entries.exampleZh: 证据不足以支持证人提出的严肃说法。

entries.meaning: 使绝缘，使绝热；使绝缘，使隔热，使隔音；隔离，使隔绝
entries.example: Workers insulate the pipes to keep the building warm during winter.
entries.exampleZh: 工人们给管道隔热，以便让这栋楼在冬天保持温暖。

entries.example: Good insulation helps keep the house warm and lowers our heating bills.
entries.exampleZh: 良好的隔热层有助于让房子保持温暖，并降低我们的取暖费用。

entries.example: Rubber is a poor insulator, so it cannot stop heat very well.
entries.exampleZh: 橡胶是不良绝缘体，所以它不能很好地阻止热量传递。

entries.example: She bought travel insurance before her long trip to Asia.
entries.exampleZh: 她在去亚洲的长途旅行前买了旅行保险。

entries.example: The insurer refused to pay for the damage caused by the storm.
entries.exampleZh: 保险公司拒绝为暴风雨造成的损失赔付。

entries.meaning: 完整无缺的；未经触动的；未受损伤的
entries.example: Despite the crash, the small glass vase remained completely intact.
entries.exampleZh: 尽管发生了碰撞，那个小玻璃花瓶仍然完好无损。

entries.example: Doctors advised him to reduce his daily intake of salt and sugar.
entries.exampleZh: 医生建议他减少每日盐和糖的摄入量。

entries.meaning: 完整的；作为组成部分的；内置的；构成整体所必需的，基本的
entries.example: Regular practice is an integral part of learning any new language.
entries.exampleZh: 定期练习是学习任何新语言不可或缺的一部分。

entries.example: The school tries to integrate new students into its daily activities quickly.
entries.exampleZh: 学校努力让新生迅速融入日常活动。

entries.meaning: 正直；诚实，正直；正直，诚实，诚恳；完整，完全，完善
entries.example: Her honesty and integrity made her a trusted leader in the company.
entries.exampleZh: 她的诚实和正直使她成为公司里值得信赖的领导者。

entries.meaning: 理智，智力，才智；智力，理解力；才智非凡的人
entries.example: The professor admired the young student's sharp intellect and curiosity.
entries.exampleZh: 教授很欣赏这位年轻学生敏锐的才智和好奇心。

entries.example: The intellectual gave a talk about art and modern society.
entries.exampleZh: 这位知识分子作了一场关于艺术与现代社会的演讲。

entries.example: She is an intelligent woman who solves problems with great care.
entries.exampleZh: 她是一位聪慧的女性，处理问题非常谨慎。

entries.meaning: 可理解的，明白易懂的，清楚的
entries.example: His explanation was clear and intelligible to everyone in the room.
entries.exampleZh: 他的解释清晰易懂，房间里的每个人都能明白。

entries.meaning: 激烈的，强烈的；强烈的；紧张的；认真的；热情的
entries.example: The intense heat forced the workers to take frequent breaks outside.
entries.exampleZh: 强烈的酷热迫使工人们在户外频繁休息。

entries.example: She stared intensely at the painting, trying to understand its hidden meaning.
entries.exampleZh: 她专注地盯着那幅画，试图理解其中隐藏的含义。

entries.example: The company plans to intensify its efforts to reach new customers abroad.
entries.exampleZh: 公司计划加大努力以接触海外新客户。

entries.example: He took an intensive course to improve his English before the exam.
entries.exampleZh: 他在考试前参加了一门强化课程来提高英语。

entries.meaning: 目不转睛的，热切的；专心的，专注的；急切的；意图，意向，目的
entries.example: She listened with intent to every word the teacher said.
entries.exampleZh: 她专注地听老师说的每一个字。

entries.meaning: 互动；相互作用；相互作用，相互影响
entries.example: Children learn social skills when they interact with others during group games.
entries.exampleZh: 孩子们在集体游戏中与他人互动时学习社交技能。

entries.example: Good interaction between team members makes difficult projects much easier to finish.
entries.exampleZh: 团队成员之间良好的互动使困难的项目更容易完成。

entries.meaning: 互相作用的，互相影响的
entries.example: The museum offers an interactive exhibit where visitors can touch and explore.
entries.exampleZh: 博物馆提供一个互动展览，参观者可以触摸并探索。

entries.example: These two systems interconnect through a shared network and exchange data safely.
entries.exampleZh: 这两个系统通过共享网络互连并安全地交换数据。

entries.meaning: 交际，往来，交流；性交；交流，交往，交际
entries.example: Regular social intercourse helps newcomers feel welcome in a small community.
entries.exampleZh: 经常性的社交往来能帮助新来者在小社区中感到受欢迎。

entries.example: The new software interface is simple enough for older users to understand.
entries.exampleZh: 新的软件界面足够简单，年长用户也能理解。

entries.meaning: 干涉，妨碍；干涉，干预，妨碍
entries.example: Please do not interfere with the machine while it is running.
entries.exampleZh: 机器运行时请不要干扰它。

entries.example: The radio signal was weak because of interference from nearby buildings.
entries.exampleZh: 由于附近建筑的干扰，无线电信号很弱。

entries.meaning: 暂时的，临时的；间歇，过渡期间
entries.example: An interim manager will lead the team until a permanent one is hired.
entries.exampleZh: 在正式经理受聘之前，一位临时经理将带领团队。

entries.example: The interior of the old house was cool and surprisingly quiet.
entries.exampleZh: 这栋老房子的内部凉爽且出奇地安静。

entries.example: The chemical intermediate is unstable and must be stored at low temperatures.
entries.exampleZh: 这种化学中间体不稳定，必须在低温下储存。

entries.example: The patient complained of intermittent pain in his left knee all week.
entries.exampleZh: 病人抱怨左膝整个星期都有间歇性疼痛。

entries.example: The company launched an internal review after several customers reported serious problems.
entries.exampleZh: 在几位顾客报告严重问题后，公司启动了内部审查。

entries.meaning: 人与人之间的，关于人与人之间关系的
entries.example: Strong interpersonal skills are important when you work closely with many people.
entries.exampleZh: 当你与许多人密切合作时，良好的人际交往能力很重要。

entries.meaning: 解释；口译；口译；解释；解释，说明；口译
entries.example: Can you interpret this difficult passage for the new students?
entries.exampleZh: 你能为新学生解释这段难懂的段落吗？

entries.example: Her interpretation of the poem surprised even the most experienced teacher.
entries.exampleZh: 她对这首诗的解读甚至让最有经验的老师都感到惊讶。

entries.example: The school encourages interracial friendship through shared projects and cultural events.
entries.exampleZh: 学校通过共同项目和文化活动鼓励种族间的友谊。

entries.example: Sorry to interrupt, but I need to ask you a quick question.
entries.exampleZh: 抱歉打扰一下，但我需要问你一个简短的问题。

entries.example: Turn left at the next intersection and you will see the library.
entries.exampleZh: 在下一个十字路口左转，你就会看到图书馆。

entries.example: Their lives began to intertwine after they joined the same local choir.
entries.exampleZh: 他们加入同一个本地合唱团后，生活开始交织在一起。

entries.meaning: 干涉；干涉，干预；干涉，干预；干扰，阻挠
entries.example: The teacher had to intervene when two students started shouting at each other.
entries.exampleZh: 两名学生开始互相大喊时，老师不得不介入。

entries.example: Quick medical intervention saved the injured climber before the storm arrived.
entries.exampleZh: 及时的医疗干预在暴风雨来临前救了受伤的登山者。

entries.example: The reporter will interview the mayor about the new housing plan tomorrow.
entries.exampleZh: 记者明天将就新的住房计划采访市长。

entries.meaning: 亲密的；亲密的，个人的；至交，密友；暗示，提示
entries.example: She shared an intimate story with only her closest friends.
entries.exampleZh: 她只向最亲密的朋友分享了一个私密的故事。

entries.example: Loud threats should never intimidate a witness into changing their statement.
entries.exampleZh: 大声威胁绝不应吓得证人改变陈述。

entries.example: He is intolerant of rude behavior, even when he is very tired.
entries.exampleZh: 即使非常疲倦，他也无法容忍粗鲁的行为。

entries.example: Her gentle intonation made the difficult question sound less threatening.
entries.exampleZh: 她柔和的语调让这个难题听起来没那么有威胁。

entries.example: The intricacy of the old clock amazed every visitor in the museum.
entries.exampleZh: 这座旧钟的错综复杂让博物馆里的每位参观者惊叹。

entries.meaning: 错综复杂的，复杂精细的
entries.example: The artist drew an intricate pattern across the entire wooden door.
entries.exampleZh: 艺术家在整扇木门上画了一个复杂精细的图案。

entries.meaning: 耍阴谋，施诡计；激起…的好奇心，迷住；阴谋，诡计，密谋
entries.example: The strange letter began to intrigue everyone in the quiet office.
entries.exampleZh: 这封奇怪的信开始引起安静办公室里每个人的好奇。

entries.example: She found the old map's puzzling symbols deeply intriguing.
entries.exampleZh: 她觉得那张旧地图上令人费解的符号非常有趣。

entries.meaning: 本质的，固有的；固有的；本质的；内在的
entries.example: Curiosity seems intrinsic to young children who explore every corner.
entries.exampleZh: 好奇心似乎是探索每个角落的幼儿所固有的。

entries.example: The senator plans to introduce a new bill about clean water.
entries.exampleZh: 参议员计划提出一项关于清洁用水的新法案。

entries.meaning: 直觉；由直觉获知的信息
entries.example: Her intuition told her that the calm stranger was hiding something.
entries.exampleZh: 她的直觉告诉她，那个平静的陌生人正在隐瞒什么。

entries.example: His intuitive guess about the hidden door turned out to be correct.
entries.exampleZh: 他对那扇暗门的直觉猜测结果是对的。

entries.meaning: 病人；无效的，作废的；无可靠根据的，站不住脚的；病弱者，残疾者
entries.example: The ticket became invalid after the concert date had already passed.
entries.exampleZh: 音乐会日期过去后，这张票就失效了。

entries.meaning: 非常宝贵的，极为贵重的，无价的
entries.example: Her advice proved invaluable during our first week in the new city.
entries.exampleZh: 在我们到新城市的头一周，她的建议非常宝贵。

entries.meaning: 不变地，永恒地；不变地，始终如一地，总是
entries.example: He invariably arrives early and checks every detail before the meeting.
entries.exampleZh: 他总是很早到达，并在会议前检查每个细节。

entries.example: The sudden invasion of tiny insects ruined the farmer's young crops.
entries.exampleZh: 微小昆虫的突然入侵毁了农民的幼嫩庄稼。

entries.example: The lake is now threatened by an invasive plant from another country.
entries.exampleZh: 这个湖目前正受到一种来自其他国家的入侵植物的威胁。

entries.example: The manager checked the inventory before placing a new order.
entries.exampleZh: 经理在下新订单之前核对了存货清单。

entries.example: Their stress levels are inversely related to the hours they sleep.
entries.exampleZh: 他们的压力水平与睡眠时间成反比。

entries.example: Please invert the bowl so the water can drain out.
entries.exampleZh: 请把碗倒过来，好让水流出去。

entries.example: They plan to invest a large sum in the new factory.
entries.exampleZh: 他们计划向这家新工厂投入一大笔资金。

entries.example: The police came to investigate the strange noise last night.
entries.exampleZh: 警察昨晚来调查那阵奇怪的声音。

entries.example: The tiny crack is almost invisible from a normal distance.
entries.exampleZh: 从正常距离看，这道细缝几乎看不见。

entries.example: Please send the invoice to our office by Friday.
entries.exampleZh: 请在周五之前把发票寄到我们办公室。

entries.example: This project will involve a lot of travel abroad.
entries.exampleZh: 这个项目将涉及大量出国旅行。

entries.example: Her involvement in the charity brought her great satisfaction.
entries.exampleZh: 她参与这项慈善活动给她带来了极大的满足感。

entries.example: The scientist measured one ion moving slowly through the salty water.
entries.exampleZh: 科学家测量了一个离子在盐水中缓慢移动。

entries.meaning: 讽刺；反话，冷嘲，嘲弄；具有讽刺意味的事
entries.example: The irony is that the fire station itself burned down.
entries.exampleZh: 具有讽刺意味的是，消防站本身被烧毁了。

entries.example: His fear of cats is completely irrational, as they are harmless.
entries.exampleZh: 他对猫的恐惧完全没有道理，因为猫是无害的。

entries.example: The doctor noticed a slight irregularity in her heartbeat.
entries.exampleZh: 医生注意到她的心跳有轻微的不规则。

entries.example: Your personal opinion is irrelevant to this scientific discussion.
entries.exampleZh: 你的个人意见与这次科学讨论无关。

entries.meaning: 不考虑的，不顾的；不考虑的，不顾及的
entries.example: Irrespective of the weather, the match will go ahead.
entries.exampleZh: 不管天气如何，比赛都将照常进行。

entries.example: The damage to the ancient painting is sadly irreversible.
entries.exampleZh: 这幅古画的损坏令人遗憾地不可逆转。

entries.example: Modern irrigation has turned this dry land into fertile fields.
entries.exampleZh: 现代灌溉已使这片干旱的土地变成了肥沃的田野。

entries.meaning: 激怒；激怒；引起不愉快；使恼怒，使烦躁；使不适，使疼痛
entries.example: Loud music late at night tends to irritate the neighbors.
entries.exampleZh: 深夜的喧闹音乐容易惹恼邻居。

entries.example: She studied the history of islam during her university years.
entries.exampleZh: 她在大学期间研究了伊斯兰教的历史。

entries.example: The small isle lies far from the busy mainland coast.
entries.exampleZh: 这座小岛远离繁忙的大陆海岸。

entries.example: Doctors must isolate the sick patient to protect other people.
entries.exampleZh: 医生必须隔离这名病人以保护其他人。

entries.example: The old man lived in complete isolation after retiring from work.
entries.exampleZh: 那位老人退休后过着完全与世隔绝的生活。

entries.meaning: 发行；分发，发出；问题；发行；分发
entries.example: The company will issue a new statement tomorrow morning.
entries.exampleZh: 公司将于明天上午发布一份新声明。

entries.example: Please list every item you need before going to the store.
entries.exampleZh: 去商店之前请列出你需要的每一样东西。

entries.meaning: 象牙（质）；乳白色；象牙；象牙色，乳白色
entries.example: The museum displayed an ancient ivory comb beside the pottery.
entries.exampleZh: 博物馆在陶器旁边展出了一把古老的象牙梳子。

entries.example: He used a heavy jack to lift the broken car.
entries.exampleZh: 他用一个沉重的千斤顶抬起了那辆坏掉的汽车。

entries.example: The thief spent three years in jail for stealing cars.
entries.exampleZh: 那个小偷因偷车在监狱里待了三年。

entries.example: A traffic jam kept us on the road for hours.
entries.exampleZh: 交通堵塞使我们在路上耽搁了几个小时。

entries.example: Her constant jealousy damaged their friendship over the years.
entries.exampleZh: 她不断的嫉妒多年来损害了他们的友谊。

entries.example: He wore a blue jean jacket to the concert last night.
entries.exampleZh: 他昨晚穿了一件蓝色牛仔布夹克去听音乐会。

entries.example: She made a bright red jelly for the party dessert.
entries.exampleZh: 她为聚会甜点做了一份鲜红色的果冻。

entries.example: Missing too many classes may jeopardize your final exam results.
entries.exampleZh: 缺课太多可能会危及你的期末考试结果。

entries.meaning: 猛地一拉，急拉；猝然一动，猛拉；急推，急拉，急扭
entries.example: He gave the rope a sharp jerk to free it.
entries.exampleZh: 他猛拉了一下绳子把它解开。

entries.example: The painting shows Jesus teaching a crowd beside the lake.
entries.exampleZh: 这幅画描绘了耶稣在湖边教导人群。

entries.example: She kept her gold jewellery in a small wooden box.
entries.exampleZh: 她把她的金首饰放在一个小木盒里。

entries.example: The small bells jingle softly whenever the door opens.
entries.exampleZh: 每当门打开时，那些小铃铛就会轻轻地丁当作响。

entries.meaning: 慢跑（尤作为锻炼）；慢跑；轻轻碰撞
entries.example: I like to jog along the river before breakfast.
entries.exampleZh: 我喜欢在早餐前沿着河边慢跑。

entries.example: The judicial system must protect both fairness and public trust.
entries.exampleZh: 司法制度必须保护公平和公众信任。

entries.example: She filled the clay jug with fresh water from the well.
entries.exampleZh: 她把那个陶罐装满了井里的清水。

entries.meaning: 连接点，汇合处；联结点，交叉点，枢纽
entries.example: Turn left at the next junction and follow the signs to the station.
entries.exampleZh: 在下一个交叉路口左转，然后按路标前往车站。

entries.example: Many rare animals survive in this thick jungle despite the changing climate.
entries.exampleZh: 尽管气候不断变化，许多稀有动物仍在这片茂密的丛林中生存。

entries.example: She joined the company as a junior and learned quickly from her manager.
entries.exampleZh: 她以初级职员的身份加入公司，并很快从经理那里学到了东西。

entries.meaning: 废旧物品，破烂；丢弃，废弃
entries.example: We cleared the junk out of the garage last Saturday morning.
entries.exampleZh: 上周六上午我们把车库里的废旧物品清理出去了。

entries.example: The planet jupiter is named after a powerful Roman god.
entries.exampleZh: 木星是以一位强大的罗马神命名的。

entries.example: The jury reached a unanimous decision after two hours of discussion.
entries.exampleZh: 陪审团经过两小时的讨论后达成了一致裁决。

entries.example: The community demanded justice after the unfair trial ended last week.
entries.exampleZh: 那场不公正的审判上周结束后，社区要求伸张正义。

entries.example: Her anger was justifiable, but shouting at the staff solved nothing.
entries.exampleZh: 她的愤怒是合理的，但对工作人员大喊大叫并不能解决问题。

entries.example: There is no justification for treating loyal customers so rudely.
entries.exampleZh: 没有任何正当理由这样粗鲁地对待忠实顾客。

entries.example: She felt justified in asking for a refund after the long delay.
entries.exampleZh: 经过漫长的延误后，她觉得自己要求退款是正当的。

entries.example: You cannot justify such rude behavior in front of the children.
entries.exampleZh: 你无法在孩子们面前为如此无礼的行为辩解。

entries.meaning: 少年的，少年特有的；幼稚的，不成熟的；未成年人，少年
entries.example: The court treated the young offender as a juvenile, not an adult.
entries.exampleZh: 法院将这名年轻违法者作为未成年人而非成年人处理。

entries.meaning: 浓厚的；敏锐的；热心的；激烈的；敏锐的，敏捷的
entries.example: She is keen to improve her spoken English before the exam.
entries.exampleZh: 她渴望在考试前提高英语口语。

entries.example: He cracked the hard shell and removed the small kernel inside.
entries.exampleZh: 他敲开坚硬的外壳，取出里面小小的果仁。

entries.meaning: 绑架；诱拐，绑架；绑架，诱拐
entries.example: The gang tried to kidnap the wealthy businessman for a huge ransom.
entries.exampleZh: 该团伙试图绑架这位富商以索取巨额赎金。

entries.example: The doctor said a kidney transplant could save the patient's life.
entries.exampleZh: 医生说肾脏移植可以挽救这名病人的生命。

entries.example: This small heater uses only one kilowatt of electricity each hour.
entries.exampleZh: 这个小加热器每小时只消耗一千瓦电。

entries.example: A single spark can kindle a fire in this dry forest.
entries.exampleZh: 一颗火星就能在这片干燥的森林里点燃大火。

entries.example: The moving car has kinetic energy that increases with its speed.
entries.exampleZh: 行驶中的汽车具有动能，其动能随速度增加。

entries.meaning: 成套工具；用具包；成套工具，成套用品；配套元件；装备
entries.example: She packed a first-aid kit before leaving for the long hike.
entries.exampleZh: 她在出发进行长途徒步前打包了一个急救包。

entries.example: The brave knight rode his horse across the narrow bridge at dawn.
entries.exampleZh: 勇敢的骑士在黎明时骑马穿过那座窄桥。

entries.meaning: 编结，编织；愈合；编结，编织；使紧密地结合，使紧凑；皱紧，皱
entries.example: My grandmother can knit a warm scarf in just two days.
entries.exampleZh: 我祖母能在短短两天内织出一条温暖的围巾。

entries.meaning: 球形把手，球形柄；旋钮；小块
entries.example: He turned the small knob on the radio to make the sound louder.
entries.exampleZh: 他转动收音机上的小旋钮，把声音调大。

entries.meaning: 标签，标记，符号；贴标签于；把…称为
entries.example: Please read the label on the bottle before you take any medicine.
entries.exampleZh: 请在你服用任何药物之前阅读瓶子上的标签。

entries.meaning: 系带，用带子束紧；网眼花边，透孔织品；鞋带，系带；用系带束紧
entries.example: She tied the lace on her left shoe and hurried out.
entries.exampleZh: 她系好左脚鞋上的鞋带，匆匆出去了。

entries.example: Many small towns lack enough doctors to treat their older residents.
entries.exampleZh: 许多小城镇缺少足够的医生来治疗年长的居民。

entries.example: Some students lag behind because they rarely review their lessons at home.
entries.exampleZh: 有些学生落后，因为他们很少在家复习功课。

entries.meaning: 跛的，瘸的；站不住脚的，差劲的；蹩脚的
entries.example: The horse was lame and could not carry the heavy load.
entries.exampleZh: 那匹马瘸了，无法驮运沉重的货物。

entries.example: The court made a landmark decision that changed the country's labor laws.
entries.exampleZh: 法院作出了一项具有重大意义的裁决，改变了该国的劳动法。

entries.example: The mountain landscape looked peaceful under the soft evening light.
entries.exampleZh: 山峦景色在柔和的晚光下显得宁静。

entries.example: The cyclist stayed in the narrow lane beside the busy road.
entries.exampleZh: 骑自行车的人待在繁忙道路旁的窄道上。

entries.example: The success of the project depended largely on careful planning and teamwork.
entries.exampleZh: 该项目的成功主要取决于周密的计划和团队合作。

entries.meaning: 将系牢；鞭打，抽打；猛烈打击；猛烈抨击，严厉斥责；鞭打；假睫毛；鞭梢
entries.example: The strong wind began to lash the windows with heavy rain.
entries.exampleZh: 强风开始夹着大雨猛烈拍打窗户。

entries.example: Her late father was a respected teacher in the small village.
entries.exampleZh: 她已故的父亲曾是这个小村庄里一位受人尊敬的老师。

entries.meaning: 存在但看不见的；潜在的，隐伏的，不易察觉的
entries.example: The teacher helped him discover his latent talent for public speaking.
entries.exampleZh: 老师帮助他发现了自己在公开演讲方面的潜在才能。

entries.example: The worker used a lathe to shape the metal bar smoothly.
entries.exampleZh: 那名工人用车床把金属棒加工得光滑。

entries.meaning: 纬度；黄纬；纬度；纬度地区；回旋余地，自由
entries.example: The teacher gave us considerable latitude in choosing our research topics.
entries.exampleZh: 老师在选择研究课题方面给了我们相当大的自由。

entries.example: A wooden lattice covered the small window above the garden door.
entries.exampleZh: 一扇木制格子结构遮住了花园门上方的窗户。

entries.example: The company plans to launch its new phone next month.
entries.exampleZh: 公司计划下个月推出它的新手机。

entries.example: She carried the dirty laundry downstairs and put it in the machine.
entries.exampleZh: 她把脏衣物搬到楼下，放进机器里。

entries.example: Our neighbor cuts the lawn every Saturday morning before breakfast.
entries.exampleZh: 我们的邻居每周六早上早饭前都会修剪草坪。

entries.example: The company faces a serious lawsuit over the polluted river near its factory.
entries.exampleZh: 这家公司因工厂附近受污染的河流而面临一场严重的诉讼。

entries.example: A thin layer of dust covered the old books on the shelf.
entries.exampleZh: 一层薄薄的灰尘覆盖着书架上的旧书。

entries.example: As a layman, I found the doctor's explanation quite hard to follow.
entries.exampleZh: 作为一个门外汉，我觉得医生的解释很难听懂。

entries.meaning: 解雇；裁员；歇工期，停工期
entries.example: The sudden layoff of fifty staff shocked the whole department.
entries.exampleZh: 突然解雇五十名员工让整个部门都震惊了。

entries.example: The layout of the new office makes good use of natural light.
entries.exampleZh: 新办公室的布局很好地利用了自然光。

entries.meaning: 传单；散发传单；传单，散页印刷品，小册子
entries.example: A volunteer handed me a leaflet about saving water at home.
entries.exampleZh: 一位志愿者递给我一份关于家庭节水的传单。

entries.example: Engineers found a small leakage in the pipe under the kitchen sink.
entries.exampleZh: 工程师在厨房水槽下面的管道里发现了一处小泄漏。

entries.meaning: 租约，契约，租契；租约，租契；出租；租得，租有
entries.example: We signed a two-year lease for the apartment near the park.
entries.exampleZh: 我们签了公园附近那套公寓的两年租约。

entries.example: She bought a soft leather jacket at the market yesterday.
entries.exampleZh: 她昨天在市场上买了一件柔软的皮夹克。

entries.example: You should ask a lawyer whether this contract is legal.
entries.exampleZh: 你应该问问律师这份合同是否合法。

entries.example: Some countries have chosen to legalize the sale of cannabis.
entries.exampleZh: 一些国家已选择将大麻的销售合法化。

entries.meaning: 传奇；传说，传奇故事；传奇人物
entries.example: An old legend says a dragon once lived in this lake.
entries.exampleZh: 一个古老的传说称这条湖里曾经住着一条龙。

entries.meaning: 立法；立法；法规；法律，法规；立法，法律的制定
entries.example: New legislation will protect workers from unfair treatment at work.
entries.exampleZh: 新的法规将保护员工免受工作中的不公平对待。

entries.example: The legislator promised to support farmers in her next speech.
entries.exampleZh: 这位立法者承诺在下一次演讲中支持农民。

entries.meaning: 合情合理的；合理的，法律认可的；使合法
entries.example: The manager had a legitimate reason for cancelling the meeting.
entries.exampleZh: 经理有正当理由取消这次会议。

entries.example: He spends his leisure time reading novels in the garden.
entries.exampleZh: 他把空闲时间用来在花园里读小说。

entries.example: Please measure the length of the table before we buy it.
entries.exampleZh: 买之前请量一下桌子的长度。

entries.example: We hope these small changes will lessen the pressure on busy workers.
entries.exampleZh: 我们希望这些小改变会减轻忙碌工人的压力。

entries.meaning: 途径，工具，手段；杠，杠杆；途径，手段，工具；撬动，撬起

entries.meaning: 责任；债务；责任；负债，债务；不利条件，起妨碍作用的人

entries.exampleZh: 公司对其卡车造成的任何损坏承担全部责任。

entries.exampleZh: 如果你开得太快，就容易失去控制。

entries.meaning: 心胸宽大的，慷慨的；自由的，自由主义的

entries.exampleZh: 她在教育上的开明观点使她受到年轻教师的欢迎。

entries.example: The people celebrated the liberation of their city with music and dancing.
entries.exampleZh: 人们用音乐和舞蹈庆祝他们城市的解放。

entries.example: The lieutenant gave clear orders to every soldier in the small unit.
entries.exampleZh: 中尉向这个小分队的每名士兵下达了明确的命令。

entries.example: He reached for his lighter, but the strong wind blew it out.
entries.exampleZh: 他伸手去拿打火机，但强风把它吹灭了。

entries.example: There is little likelihood of rain during our trip next week.
entries.exampleZh: 我们下周旅行期间下雨的可能性很小。

entries.exampleZh: 这幅画与那位著名作家有惊人的相似之处。

entries.example: A single white lily stood in a glass vase by the window.
entries.exampleZh: 一朵白百合立在窗边的玻璃花瓶里。

entries.example: The doctor said the injured limb would heal within a few weeks.
entries.exampleZh: 医生说受伤的肢体会在几周内痊愈。

entries.example: The old church was built with pale limestone from a nearby hill.
entries.exampleZh: 这座古老的教堂是用附近山丘的浅色石灰石建造的。

entries.example: The main limitation of this plan is its high cost.
entries.exampleZh: 这个计划的主要局限是成本很高。

entries.meaning: 蹒跚，跛行；跛行；一瘸一拐地走，蹒跚；软弱的，无生气的，无精神的；软的，松沓的

entries.example: Please line the drawer with clean paper before you put the tools inside.
entries.exampleZh: 请在你把工具放进去之前，用干净的纸给抽屉加衬里。

entries.meaning: 线的；长度的；线的，直线的，线状的；长度的；线性的

entries.meaning: 日用织品；亚麻织品，亚麻布

entries.exampleZh: 她洗了亚麻窗帘，然后把它们挂到外面晾干。

entries.meaning: 教育；文化；识字，有文化，读写能力

entries.exampleZh: 这个项目帮助成年人提高读写能力和基础数学技能。

entries.meaning: 字面的；文字（上）的；字面的；照字面的，原义的；逐字的

entries.exampleZh: 直译对母语者来说常常听起来很奇怪。

entries.exampleZh: 听到那个消息后，他真的一路跑回了家。

entries.meaning: 文学的；文学的；文人的，书卷气的

entries.exampleZh: 这本杂志发表文学评论，也刊登短篇小说和诗歌。

entries.meaning: 文学，文学作品；文献，图书资料

entries.exampleZh: 她在大学学习英国文学，后来成为了一名教师。

entries.exampleZh: 我们在酒店前厅等候，直到房间准备好。

entries.example: A lobbyist for the industry met several senators yesterday afternoon.
entries.exampleZh: 一位代表该行业的游说者昨天下午会见了几位参议员。

entries.meaning: 位置，地点，发生地；地区，地点

entries.exampleZh: 这种植物在这个温暖多雨的地区生长良好。

entries.exampleZh: 地图显示了那处隐藏泉水的位置。

entries.example: The old steam locomotive pulled six carriages through the mountain valley.
entries.exampleZh: 那辆老式蒸汽机车拉着六节车厢穿过山谷。

entries.exampleZh: 日落时，一只蝗虫落在了麦田里。

entries.exampleZh: 我们在车站附近找到了两晚便宜的住处。

entries.exampleZh: 船长在午夜前把每个细节写进了航海日志。

entries.exampleZh: 她对这个问题合乎逻辑的处理方式让会上所有人都印象深刻。

entries.example: Regular exercise and a healthy diet may increase your longevity.
entries.exampleZh: 经常锻炼和健康饮食或许能延长你的寿命。

entries.example: After years abroad, she felt a deep longing for her hometown.
entries.exampleZh: 在国外多年后，她对家乡怀有深深的渴望。

entries.example: The ship's captain recorded its latitude and longitude every morning.
entries.exampleZh: 船长每天早上都记录下船所处的纬度和经度。

entries.meaning: 阴森地逼近，隐现；即将来临；织布机

entries.exampleZh: 整个冬天他都在脖子上松松地围着一条围巾。

entries.exampleZh: 我们在旅馆的休息室里一直等到出租车来。

entries.exampleZh: 尽管有了新的名气，她对老朋友依然忠诚。

entries.exampleZh: 在那些艰难的岁月里，他对球队的忠诚从未消退。

entries.exampleZh: 我们的行李在我们到达两天后才送到旅馆。

entries.exampleZh: 钟上发光的指针在黑暗中柔和地亮着。

entries.exampleZh: 月球表面覆盖着尘埃和小石块。

entries.exampleZh: 公司为即将退休的董事举办了一场正式的午宴。

entries.exampleZh: 明亮的灯光会在夜里把昆虫引诱进陷阱。

entries.exampleZh: 他们在海边的一家旅馆度过了豪华的一周。

entries.exampleZh: 下班后洗个热水澡是我享受的一点小小的奢侈。

entries.exampleZh: 工厂用更快、更安全的设备替换了旧机器。

entries.exampleZh: 那位魔术师从黑帽子里变出一只白兔。

entries.exampleZh: 地方法官在作出裁决前仔细听取了双方的陈述。

entries.exampleZh: 好老师就像吸引好奇学生的磁铁。

entries.exampleZh: 这个小盒子有一个能自动合上的磁盖。

entries.exampleZh: 她沉静的自信赋予她一种个人魅力。

entries.example: We enjoyed a magnificent view of the mountains from our hotel window.
entries.exampleZh: 我们从酒店窗户欣赏到了壮丽的山景。

entries.meaning: 放大；放大，扩大；放大，扩大；夸大，夸张

entries.exampleZh: 这个简单的镜片能把小字放大，方便阅读。

entries.exampleZh: 科学家们正在研究珊瑚礁受损的严重程度。

entries.exampleZh: 那位年轻少女穿着简朴的连衣裙，手里拿着花。

entries.exampleZh: 经常锻炼有助于你多年保持健康。

entries.exampleZh: 大多数学生投票支持推迟午休时间。

entries.exampleZh: 她在重要的求职面试前化了淡妆。

entries.exampleZh: 他说话没有恶意，尽管她的话伤害了他。

entries.exampleZh: 该网站因向访客传播恶意软件而被关闭。

entries.example: We spent the whole afternoon shopping at the new mall.
entries.exampleZh: 我们在新购物中心逛了一下午。

entries.example: A whale is a large mammal that lives in the ocean.
entries.exampleZh: 鲸鱼是一种生活在海洋中的大型哺乳动物。

entries.meaning: 管理；处理；管理部门，管理人员

entries.exampleZh: 良好的时间管理能帮助学生完成作业而不会有太大压力。

entries.meaning: 表明；明显的；明显的，显然的，明了的；显示，表明，证明；使显现，使显露
entries.example: Her smile can manifest the quiet confidence she feels before every performance.
entries.exampleZh: 她的微笑能显示出她在每次演出前所感到的那份沉静自信。

entries.exampleZh: 一些应用程序通过反复展示某些广告来试图操纵我们的选择。

entries.meaning: 大厦，大楼；宅第；大厦，宅邸

entries.exampleZh: 路尽头的那座老宅有一个美丽的花园。

entries.meaning: 手工的；体力的；用手的，手工做的；手册，指南

entries.exampleZh: 请在使用新咖啡机前阅读手册。

entries.meaning: 生产，制造；制造，加工；制造，制造业

entries.exampleZh: 这家公司计划为城市司机生产小型电动汽车。

entries.exampleZh: 这家制造商为其所有厨房机器提供两年保修。

entries.meaning: 手稿；手稿，底稿，原稿；手稿，原稿，底稿；手写本

entries.exampleZh: 她把她的手稿寄给了三家出版社，最后才有一家接受。

entries.example: A bright red maple stands beside the small lake in the park.
entries.exampleZh: 一棵鲜红的枫树矗立在公园的小湖边。

entries.example: The floor of the hall was made of smooth white marble.
entries.exampleZh: 大厅的地面是用光滑的白色大理石铺成的。

entries.meaning: 利润；余地；（获胜者在时间或票数上领先的）幅度，差额；利润；赚头；页边空白；差数，差额；余地；边缘

entries.exampleZh: 老师在我文章的页边空白处写了一句简短的评语。

entries.exampleZh: 自从加入学习小组以来，她的英语进步显著。

entries.exampleZh: 他们计划今年春天向年轻家庭推销这款新应用。

entries.exampleZh: 科学家希望在未来二十年内把人类送上火星。

entries.meaning: 男性的；男性的，男子的；男子气的
