entries.exampleZh: 农民在夏末收割小麦，赶在寒冷的雨季到来之前。

entries.example: They rear sheep on the hills near their small stone cottage.
entries.exampleZh: 他们在小石屋附近的山坡上养羊。

entries.example: The judge asked the lawyer to reason clearly before the jury.
entries.exampleZh: 法官要求律师在陪审团面前清晰地论证。

entries.example: After the loss, the coach decided to reassess his entire training plan.
entries.exampleZh: 失利之后，教练决定重新评估他的整个训练计划。

entries.example: The doctor tried to reassure her before the operation began.
entries.exampleZh: 手术开始前，医生试图让她放心。

entries.meaning: 反叛，造反；反对，不服从；反叛分子，反对者
entries.example: The young rebel refused to follow any of the village rules.
entries.exampleZh: 那个年轻的反叛者拒绝遵守村里的任何规矩。

entries.example: The government crushed the rebellion within three weeks of its start.
entries.exampleZh: 政府在叛乱开始后的三周内将其镇压。

entries.example: Her father would rebuke her whenever she came home late.
entries.exampleZh: 每当她回家晚了，父亲都会斥责她。

entries.meaning: 回忆起，想起；回忆；召回，叫回；收回，撤销
entries.example: I cannot recall the exact name of that small restaurant.
entries.exampleZh: 我想不起那家小餐馆的确切名字了。

entries.meaning: 退，退去，渐渐远去；向后倾斜，缩进
entries.example: As the tide began to recede, the children ran toward the rocks.
entries.exampleZh: 潮水开始退去时，孩子们朝岩石跑去。

entries.meaning: 发票；发票，收据；收入，进款；收到，接到
entries.example: Please keep the receipt in case you need to return the shoes.
entries.exampleZh: 请保留收据，以备你需要退鞋。

entries.example: The receiver of the letter never replied to my message.
entries.exampleZh: 那封信的收件人从未回复我的消息。

entries.meaning: 接待；招待会，欢迎会；接受，接纳；接待，迎接；接收效果
entries.example: The hotel reception was crowded when we arrived on Friday evening.
entries.exampleZh: 我们周五晚上到达时，酒店前台很拥挤。

entries.example: The receptionist handed me a key and smiled politely.
entries.exampleZh: 接待员递给我一把钥匙，礼貌地笑了笑。

entries.example: Many small shops closed during the long recession that followed.
entries.exampleZh: 在随后漫长的经济衰退期间，许多小商店关门了。

entries.meaning: 秘方，食谱；菜谱，烹饪法；烹饪法，食谱；方法，秘诀，诀窍
entries.example: My grandmother gave me her secret recipe for apple cake.
entries.exampleZh: 奶奶把她的苹果蛋糕秘方给了我。

entries.example: The recipient of the award gave a short speech to the crowd.
entries.exampleZh: 获奖者向人群做了简短的发言。

entries.meaning: 相互的；互利的；相互的；互惠的
entries.example: Their partnership was based on reciprocal trust and honest communication.
entries.exampleZh: 他们的合作关系建立在相互信任和坦诚沟通的基础上。

entries.meaning: 背诵，朗诵；列举，一一说出
entries.example: Students must recite the poem in front of the whole class.
entries.exampleZh: 学生们必须在全班面前背诵这首诗。

entries.meaning: 鲁莽的；粗心大意的；鲁莽的；鲁莽的，不考虑后果的
entries.example: His reckless driving on the icy road caused a serious accident.
entries.exampleZh: 他在结冰的路面上鲁莽驾驶，酿成了严重的事故。

entries.meaning: 认为，评价；计算；认为；认为，估计；指望，盼望；测算，测量
entries.example: I reckon the meeting will end before noon today.
entries.exampleZh: 我估计会议会在今天中午之前结束。

entries.meaning: 开垦，开拓；回收；要回；开垦；回收
entries.example: Farmers worked hard to reclaim the land from the sea.
entries.exampleZh: 农民们努力把这片土地从海中开垦出来。

entries.meaning: 认出，识别；认出，识别；承认，确认，认可；赏识，表彰，报偿
entries.example: Her work finally received the recognition it truly deserved.
entries.exampleZh: 她的工作终于得到了它真正应得的认可。

entries.meaning: 认出，识别；承认，确认，认可；赏识，表彰，报偿
entries.example: I did not recognize him after so many years.
entries.exampleZh: 这么多年过去，我没认出他来。

entries.example: Can you recommend a good hotel near the train station?
entries.exampleZh: 你能推荐一家火车站附近的好酒店吗？

entries.example: My teacher wrote a strong recommendation letter for my application.
entries.exampleZh: 我的老师为我的申请写了一封有力的推荐信。

entries.meaning: 使和解，使一致；调解；使和好；调停；使协调；使和解；使顺从，使甘心
entries.example: It is hard to reconcile these two conflicting views.
entries.exampleZh: 很难把这两种相互冲突的观点协调起来。

entries.example: After long talks, the two families reached a full reconciliation.
entries.exampleZh: 经过长时间的商谈，两家人达成了全面和解。

entries.example: She needs time to recover from the terrible shock.
entries.exampleZh: 她需要时间从这次可怕的打击中恢复过来。

entries.meaning: 恢复，痊愈；追回，寻回，收复
entries.example: The doctor expects a full recovery within two weeks.
entries.exampleZh: 医生预计两周内可以完全康复。

entries.meaning: 消遣，娱乐活动；娱乐活动，消遣
entries.example: Swimming remains his favorite form of recreation during the summer.
entries.exampleZh: 游泳仍然是他在夏天最喜欢的消遣方式。

entries.example: The company plans to recruit twenty new engineers this year.
entries.exampleZh: 公司计划今年招聘二十名新工程师。

entries.example: The recruiter asked several questions about my previous job.
entries.exampleZh: 招聘人员问了我几个关于上一份工作的问题。

entries.example: She drew a long rectangle on the board with chalk.
entries.exampleZh: 她用粉笔在黑板上画了一个长方形。

entries.example: They placed a large rectangular mirror above the old fireplace.
entries.exampleZh: 他们在旧壁炉上方挂了一面大长方形镜子。

entries.example: We must rectify these errors before the report goes out.
entries.exampleZh: 我们必须在报告发出之前纠正这些错误。

entries.example: Old problems may recur if we ignore the warning signs.
entries.exampleZh: 如果我们忽视这些警示信号，老问题可能会再次发生。

entries.example: Doctors worry about the recurrence of the disease after surgery.
entries.exampleZh: 医生们担心手术后疾病会再次复发。

entries.example: Please put recyclable bottles into the green bin outside.
entries.exampleZh: 请把可回收的瓶子放进外面的绿色垃圾桶里。

entries.example: Our school will recycle paper and plastic every single week.
entries.exampleZh: 我们学校每周都会回收纸张和塑料。

entries.example: The new manager wants to redefine success in our department.
entries.exampleZh: 新经理想要重新定义我们部门的成功。

entries.meaning: 过剩的；失业的，被解雇的；多余的，过剩的
entries.example: The company made two hundred workers redundant last month.
entries.exampleZh: 公司上个月裁掉了两百名多余的员工。

entries.example: He carved a small flute from a hollow reed.
entries.exampleZh: 他用一根空心的芦苇削出了一支小笛子。

entries.example: Divers explored the colourful coral reef near the island.
entries.exampleZh: 潜水员探索了岛屿附近色彩斑斓的珊瑚礁。

entries.meaning: 卷，绕；摇摇晃晃地移动，蹒跚；眩晕，发昏；卷轴，卷筒，卷盘
entries.example: She began to reel from the sudden bad news.
entries.exampleZh: 听到这个突如其来的坏消息，她开始感到一阵眩晕。

entries.meaning: （足球等）裁判员；当裁判；裁判员；证明人，推荐人；仲裁者，调解者
entries.example: The referee stopped the match after a serious injury.
entries.exampleZh: 裁判在有人严重受伤后中止了比赛。

entries.meaning: 参考文献；参照物；提到，论及；参考，查阅；引文；参考书目；证明书，推荐信
entries.example: Please include a reference for each fact in your essay.
entries.exampleZh: 请在你的文章中为每一个事实注明参考文献。

entries.example: We need more time to refine our plan before Friday.
entries.exampleZh: 我们需要更多时间来完善周五之前的计划。

entries.example: A large oil refinery stands beside the river near town.
entries.exampleZh: 一座大型炼油厂坐落在城边的那条河旁。

entries.meaning: 思考，反映，反射；反映，显示；反射，映现；深思，考虑，反省
entries.example: The lake can reflect the mountains on a calm day.
entries.exampleZh: 在平静的日子里，湖面能映出群山。

entries.meaning: 深思熟虑的；反映的，反射的
entries.example: He wrote a reflective essay about his childhood summers.
entries.exampleZh: 他写了一篇关于童年夏天的深思文章。

entries.meaning: 改革，改良，改造；改正，改过自新
entries.example: The government promised a serious reform of the tax system.
entries.exampleZh: 政府承诺对税收制度进行认真的改革。

entries.meaning: 抑制，避免；抑制，制止，忍住；抑制，克制，戒除；叠句，副歌
entries.example: Please refrain from using your phone during the lecture.
entries.exampleZh: 讲座期间请避免使用手机。

entries.example: A short walk can refresh your mind after long study.
entries.exampleZh: 长时间学习后，短暂散步能让你的头脑恢复清醒。

entries.example: Nothing is more refreshing than a cold drink on hot days.
entries.exampleZh: 在炎热的日子里，没有什么比一杯冷饮更让人清爽。

entries.meaning: （精力的）恢复，爽快；茶点，点心；恢复，精神爽快
entries.example: Light refreshment will be served after the morning meeting.
entries.exampleZh: 上午的会议结束后会供应简单的茶点。

entries.example: The hikers found refuge in a small cabin during the storm.
entries.exampleZh: 徒步者们在暴风雨中找到了一间小木屋避难。

entries.example: The refugee families received warm clothes and food from local volunteers.
entries.exampleZh: 难民家庭从当地志愿者那里收到了保暖衣物和食物。

entries.example: The shop promised a full refund for the damaged bicycle.
entries.exampleZh: 商店承诺为损坏的自行车全额退款。

entries.example: His refusal to answer the simple question surprised everyone in the room.
entries.exampleZh: 他拒绝回答这个简单问题，让房间里的每个人都很惊讶。

entries.example: The scientist used clear evidence to refute the false claim.
entries.exampleZh: 科学家用明确的证据驳斥了这个虚假的说法。

entries.example: She slowly began to regain her strength after the long illness.
entries.exampleZh: 长期患病后，她慢慢开始恢复体力。

entries.example: I have a few questions regarding the new schedule.
entries.exampleZh: 关于新日程，我有几个问题。

entries.example: She went for a run regardless of the heavy rain.
entries.exampleZh: 尽管下着大雨，她还是去跑步了。

entries.meaning: 新生，再生，起革新作用；使新生，重建，改革，革新
entries.example: Some lizards can regenerate their tails after losing them.
entries.exampleZh: 有些蜥蜴失去尾巴后能够再生。

entries.example: The doctor praised the regenerative power of the new treatment.
entries.exampleZh: 医生称赞了这种新疗法的再生能力。

entries.meaning: 制度，管理体制；政权，政体；制度；政治制度，政权
entries.example: The old regime collapsed after months of peaceful protests.
entries.exampleZh: 旧政权在数月和平抗议后倒台了。

entries.meaning: 团，军团；一大群；团；大量；严格地管制，严密地编组
entries.example: A whole regiment of soldiers marched through the narrow street.
entries.exampleZh: 一整团士兵穿过狭窄的街道。

entries.meaning: 地区，地带，区域；范围，幅度
entries.example: This region is famous for its fresh fruit and mild winters.
entries.exampleZh: 这个地区以新鲜水果和温和的冬季闻名。

entries.meaning: 登记，注册；指示，自动记下；表示，表达；注意到，记住；把挂号；登记，注册；登记表，注册簿
entries.example: Please sign the register before you enter the main hall.
entries.exampleZh: 请在进入大厅前在登记簿上签名。

entries.example: Online registration for the summer course closes at noon tomorrow.
entries.exampleZh: 暑期课程的在线注册明天中午截止。

entries.example: The regularity of his morning walks surprised all his neighbors.
entries.exampleZh: 他晨间散步的规律性让所有邻居都很惊讶。

entries.example: New laws aim to regulate the use of plastic packaging.
entries.exampleZh: 新法律旨在规范塑料包装的使用。

entries.meaning: 管理，规则；规章，规则；规章，规则；管理，控制，调节
entries.example: Every worker must follow the safety regulation posted near the door.
entries.exampleZh: 每位工人都必须遵守门附近张贴的安全规定。

entries.example: The final rehearsal will start at seven in the evening.
entries.exampleZh: 最后一次排练将在晚上七点开始。

entries.meaning: （某君主的）统治时期；当政，统治；占主导地位；君主的统治，君主的统治时期
entries.example: The queen's reign lasted more than forty peaceful years.
entries.exampleZh: 女王的统治持续了四十多个和平年头。

entries.example: Please keep all receipts so the company can process your reimbursement quickly.
entries.exampleZh: 请保留所有收据，以便公司能尽快处理你的报销。

entries.meaning: 缰绳；勒缰使停步；控制，约束
entries.example: The rider pulled the rein gently and the horse slowed down.
entries.exampleZh: 骑手轻轻拉了一下缰绳，马便慢了下来。

entries.meaning: 增强，提高；增强，加强，增援
entries.example: These new findings reinforce our belief that regular exercise improves memory.
entries.exampleZh: 这些新发现强化了我们的信念：经常锻炼能改善记忆力。

entries.meaning: 舍弃，抛弃；排斥；拒绝；拒纳，退回，摈弃；被拒货品，不合格产品
entries.example: The committee may reject our proposal if the budget seems too high.
entries.exampleZh: 如果预算显得太高，委员会可能会拒绝我们的提案。

entries.example: Her rejection of the offer surprised everyone at the meeting.
entries.exampleZh: 她对那份提议的拒绝让会上所有人都感到意外。

entries.example: We all rejoice when the first warm days of spring arrive.
entries.exampleZh: 当春天最初温暖的日子到来时，我们都会感到高兴。

entries.meaning: 有关系的，相对的；亲属，亲戚
entries.example: A distant relative of mine sent us a lovely gift last week.
entries.exampleZh: 我的一位远房亲戚上周给我们寄来了一份可爱的礼物。

entries.meaning: 接替，转播；分程传递；使接替；转播；接力赛；中继转播；传送，传达，转述；中继转播
entries.example: Could you relay this message to the manager before noon?
entries.exampleZh: 你能在中午之前把这条消息转达给经理吗？

entries.meaning: 释放，发布；释放，排放；解除，解脱；放开，松开；发布；发行
entries.example: The band will release their new album at the end of May.
entries.exampleZh: 这支乐队将在五月底发行他们的新专辑。

entries.meaning: 使降位，使降级；把…委托给
entries.example: The coach decided to relegate him to the second team.
entries.exampleZh: 教练决定把他降级到二队。

entries.example: Please include only the relevant details in your final report.
entries.exampleZh: 请在最终报告中只包含相关的细节。

entries.meaning: 可靠的；可靠的，可依赖的
entries.example: She is a reliable colleague who always finishes her work on time.
entries.exampleZh: 她是一位可靠的同事，总是按时完成工作。

entries.example: Our reliance on plastic has caused serious damage to the oceans.
entries.exampleZh: 我们对塑料的依赖已经对海洋造成了严重损害。

entries.meaning: 轻松，宽慰；缓解，减轻，解除；使得到调剂；接替，替下
entries.example: To my great relief, the exam turned out to be quite easy.
entries.exampleZh: 让我大为宽慰的是，这次考试结果相当容易。

entries.meaning: 减轻，缓解；使轻松，使宽慰；缓解，减轻，解除；使得到调剂；接替，替下
entries.example: The doctor gave him some medicine to relieve the pain in his back.
entries.exampleZh: 医生给了他一些药来减轻他背部的疼痛。

entries.example: I felt relieved when I heard that everyone was safe.
entries.exampleZh: 听到大家都平安无事，我感到松了一口气。

entries.example: Freedom of religion is protected by the law in many countries.
entries.exampleZh: 在许多国家，宗教信仰自由受到法律保护。

entries.meaning: 宗教的；笃信宗教的，虔诚的
entries.example: Her family follows strict religious rules during the holiday season.
entries.exampleZh: 她的家庭在节日期间遵守严格的宗教规矩。

entries.meaning: 享受，从…中获得乐趣；享受，滋味，乐趣；调味品
entries.example: She did not relish the idea of speaking in front of strangers.
entries.exampleZh: 她并不喜欢在陌生人面前讲话这个主意。

entries.example: He agreed to help with obvious reluctance and said very little.
entries.exampleZh: 他显然很不情愿地答应帮忙，话也说得很少。

entries.example: She was reluctant to leave the party before midnight.
entries.exampleZh: 她不愿意在午夜前离开聚会。

entries.example: You can rely on me to finish the task today.
entries.exampleZh: 你可以依靠我今天完成这项任务。

entries.meaning: 剩下，余留，保持；仍然是；残余；残骸；遗迹
entries.example: The old walls remain standing after many years.
entries.exampleZh: 那些古老的城墙多年后仍然矗立着。

entries.meaning: 剩余（物）；余数；余下的部分，剩下的人数
entries.example: The remainder of the cake was saved for tomorrow.
entries.exampleZh: 蛋糕剩下的部分留到了明天。

entries.example: Her remarkable memory helped her pass every exam easily.
entries.exampleZh: 她非凡的记忆力帮助她轻松通过了每一场考试。

entries.meaning: 补救办法，纠正办法；药品，治疗法；补救，纠正；医治，治疗
entries.example: A warm drink can remedy a mild sore throat.
entries.exampleZh: 一杯热饮可以缓解轻微的喉咙痛。

entries.example: Only a small remnant of the ancient forest still survives.
entries.exampleZh: 古老森林只剩下一小片残存。

entries.meaning: 遥远的，偏僻的；关系疏远的；脱离的；绝少的；微乎其微的；孤高的，冷淡的
entries.example: They live in a remote village far from the city.
entries.exampleZh: 他们住在远离城市的一个偏僻村庄里。

entries.example: Please remove your shoes before entering the clean room.
entries.exampleZh: 进入洁净室前请脱鞋。

entries.meaning: 文艺复兴，文艺复兴时期；复兴，再生
entries.example: Scholars studied the renaissance with great interest last term.
entries.exampleZh: 学者们上学期怀着极大兴趣研究了文艺复兴。

entries.meaning: 给予；使得，致使；给予，提供；翻译
entries.example: The new law will render many old rules useless.
entries.exampleZh: 新法律将使许多旧规则变得毫无用处。

entries.example: Solar power is a clean and renewable source of energy.
entries.exampleZh: 太阳能是一种清洁的可再生能源。

entries.example: I promise to repay the money by next Friday.
entries.exampleZh: 我保证下周五前还这笔钱。

entries.example: Lawmakers voted to repeal the outdated tax rule yesterday.
entries.exampleZh: 议员们昨天投票废除了那条过时的税收规定。

entries.meaning: 使厌恶；拒绝；使厌恶；击退，逐回，驱除；排斥
entries.example: This spray can repel insects from our picnic area.
entries.exampleZh: 这种喷雾能驱赶我们野餐区的昆虫。

entries.example: The pianist added a new piece to her repertoire.
entries.exampleZh: 这位钢琴家在她的曲目中增加了一首新作品。

entries.example: The job was repetitive and soon became rather boring.
entries.exampleZh: 这份工作重复性很强，很快就变得相当无聊。

entries.example: Please replace the book on the shelf after reading.
entries.exampleZh: 读完后请把书放回书架上。

entries.example: We need a replacement for the broken office chair.
entries.exampleZh: 我们需要一把新椅子来替换坏掉的办公椅。

entries.example: There is a report that the old house is haunted.
entries.exampleZh: 有传闻说那座老房子闹鬼。

entries.meaning: 作为…的代表，表示，象征；描绘，表现
entries.example: These five stars represent the five largest cities in the country.
entries.exampleZh: 这五颗星代表全国最大的五座城市。

entries.example: The painting is a fine representation of country life.
entries.exampleZh: 这幅画是对乡村生活的精彩描绘。

entries.meaning: 代表；代表性的；代议制的
entries.example: She works as a sales representative for a large company.
entries.exampleZh: 她在一家大公司做销售代表。

entries.example: The government's repression of free speech angered many voters.
entries.exampleZh: 政府对言论自由的压制激怒了许多选民。

entries.example: His voice was full of reproach when he spoke about the delay.
entries.exampleZh: 他谈到延误时，语气里充满了责备。

entries.example: Modern printers can reproduce these old photos quite clearly.
entries.exampleZh: 现代打印机能够相当清晰地复制这些老照片。

entries.example: This painting is a faithful reproduction of the original.
entries.exampleZh: 这幅画是对原作忠实的复制品。

entries.example: A small reptile moved slowly across the warm rocks.
entries.exampleZh: 一只小爬行动物慢慢爬过温暖的岩石。

entries.example: The school has a good reputation in the local area.
entries.exampleZh: 这所学校在当地名声很好。

entries.example: Please bring all the requisite documents to the interview.
entries.exampleZh: 请把所有必需的文件带到面试现场。

entries.example: There is a clear resemblance between the two brothers.
entries.exampleZh: 这两兄弟之间有明显的相似之处。

entries.meaning: 对…不满，怨恨；对…表示愤恨，怨恨
entries.example: I resent the way he treats his loyal staff.
entries.exampleZh: 我对他对待忠实员工的方式感到不满。

entries.meaning: 预定；预定，预订；保留意见；预订；保留；犹豫；居留地
entries.example: I made a reservation for two at the new restaurant.
entries.exampleZh: 我在那家新餐厅订了两个人的位子。

entries.meaning: 缄默，自我克制；保留，留存；预订；储备；保留；拘谨，矜持；替补队员；后备部队；自然保护区
entries.example: He decided to reserve two seats near the window.
entries.exampleZh: 他决定预订靠窗的两个座位。

entries.example: She is quite reserved and seldom talks about herself.
entries.exampleZh: 她相当矜持，很少谈论自己。

entries.meaning: 居住，驻扎；属于；居住，定居；存在，在于
entries.example: They reside in a quiet village near the coast.
entries.exampleZh: 他们住在海岸附近一个安静的村庄里。

entries.meaning: 居民；常住者；居住的，定居的；住校的，住院的；居民，定居者；住院医生
entries.example: A local resident showed us the way to the station.
entries.exampleZh: 一位当地居民给我们指了去车站的路。

entries.meaning: 居住的，住宅的；寄宿的，住在住所的
entries.example: This residential area is calm and close to the park.
entries.exampleZh: 这个住宅区很安静，而且离公园很近。

entries.example: There is some residual water at the bottom of the glass.
entries.exampleZh: 杯底还有一些残余的水。

entries.meaning: 辞职；使顺从，使听任于；辞职；听任；辞去，放弃；使顺从
entries.example: He plans to resign from the board next month.
entries.exampleZh: 他打算下个月从董事会辞职。

entries.example: He accepted his failure with quiet resignation and moved on.
entries.exampleZh: 他以平静的顺从接受了自己的失败，然后继续前行。

entries.example: She could not resist laughing at his silly joke.
entries.exampleZh: 她忍不住对他那个愚蠢的笑话笑了起来。

entries.example: This new fabric is resistant to water and easy to clean.
entries.exampleZh: 这种新面料耐水，而且容易清洁。

entries.example: She remained resolute despite the many difficulties ahead of her.
entries.exampleZh: 尽管前方困难重重，她依然坚定不移。

entries.example: They hope to resolve the conflict through peaceful talks.
entries.exampleZh: 他们希望通过和平谈判解决这场冲突。

entries.meaning: 度假胜地；求助，凭借，诉诸；求助，凭借，诉诸；求助的对象，采用的手段；常去之地，胜地
entries.example: The seaside resort is crowded with tourists every summer.
entries.exampleZh: 这个海滨度假胜地每年夏天都挤满了游客。

entries.example: He is a respectable man who always keeps his promises.
entries.exampleZh: 他是一个总是信守承诺的可敬之人。

entries.meaning: 各自的；各自的，各个的，分别的
entries.example: After the meeting, they returned to their respective offices.
entries.exampleZh: 会议结束后，他们各自回到了自己的办公室。

entries.meaning: 回答，答复；作出反应，响应
entries.example: Please respond to my email before the end of Friday.
entries.exampleZh: 请在周五结束前回复我的邮件。

entries.meaning: 回应；回答，答复；反应，响应
entries.example: Her quick response saved the team from a serious mistake.
entries.exampleZh: 她迅速的反应使团队免于一个严重的错误。

entries.example: Taking care of the children is a serious responsibility.
entries.exampleZh: 照顾这些孩子是一项重大的责任。

entries.meaning: 可靠的；责任重大的；需负责任的，承担责任的；有责任感的，负责可靠的；责任重大的，重要的
entries.example: She is responsible for training all the new staff.
entries.exampleZh: 她负责培训所有新员工。

entries.example: The new manager is very responsive to customer complaints.
entries.exampleZh: 新经理对顾客的投诉反应非常灵敏。

entries.meaning: 恢复，使恢复；修复，整修；归还，交还
entries.example: Workers will restore the old bridge next spring.
entries.exampleZh: 工人们将在明年春天修复这座旧桥。

entries.meaning: 制止；抑制；阻止，控制；抑制，遏制
entries.example: He could hardly restrain his anger during the argument.
entries.exampleZh: 在争论中他几乎无法抑制自己的怒火。

entries.meaning: 抑制，限制，克制；约束措施，约束条件
entries.example: She spoke with great restraint despite the unfair criticism.
entries.exampleZh: 尽管批评并不公正，她说话时仍极为克制。

entries.example: They restrict visitors to two hours per day.
entries.exampleZh: 他们限制访客每天只能待两个小时。

entries.example: The company plans to restructure its sales department this year.
entries.exampleZh: 公司计划今年调整其销售部门。

entries.meaning: 作为结果而发生的；作为结果的，因而发生的
entries.example: The resultant damage from the storm was rather expensive.
entries.exampleZh: 风暴造成的后续损失相当高昂。

entries.meaning: 简历；（谋职者的）个人简历；重新开始，继续，恢复；摘要，概要；简历
entries.example: Please send your resume and a cover letter by Monday.
entries.exampleZh: 请在周一之前寄来你的简历和一封求职信。

entries.example: The retail sector has grown quickly in this city over the past decade.
entries.exampleZh: 过去十年里，这座城市的零售行业迅速发展。

entries.example: The local retailer offers a wide range of fresh food at fair prices.
entries.exampleZh: 这家本地零售商以公道的价格提供种类繁多的新鲜食品。

entries.example: Good teachers help students retain important information long after the lesson ends.
entries.exampleZh: 优秀的老师能帮助学生在课程结束后很久仍保留重要信息。

entries.example: Heavy rain may retard the growth of these young plants.
entries.exampleZh: 大雨可能会阻碍这些幼苗的生长。

entries.example: The school focuses on the retention of basic skills among young learners.
entries.exampleZh: 这所学校注重年幼学习者对基本技能的保持。

entries.example: My grandfather plans to spend his retirement traveling around the country.
entries.exampleZh: 我祖父打算在退休后周游全国。

entries.example: She gave a sharp retort when he questioned her decision.
entries.exampleZh: 当他质疑她的决定时，她尖锐地反驳了一句。

entries.meaning: 重新得到，取回，收回；挽回，补救；检索
entries.example: Divers tried to retrieve the sunken box from the lake.
entries.exampleZh: 潜水员试图从湖里取回那只沉没的箱子。

entries.example: In retrospect, that decision was a serious mistake for the whole team.
entries.exampleZh: 回顾起来，那个决定对整个团队来说是个严重的错误。

entries.meaning: 团聚；重聚，团聚；聚会，联谊活动
entries.example: Our family reunion takes place every summer at my aunt's farm.
entries.exampleZh: 我们家的家庭团聚每年夏天在我姑姑的农场举行。

entries.meaning: 揭露；告诉，揭示，泄露；揭露，泄露；展现，显示
entries.example: The report will reveal several surprising facts about the local market.
entries.exampleZh: 这份报告将揭示有关本地市场的几个令人惊讶的事实。

entries.meaning: 被提示的真相，新发现；揭示，透露，显示
entries.example: The news came as a shocking revelation to everyone in the office.
entries.exampleZh: 这个消息对办公室里的每个人来说都是一个令人震惊的真相。

entries.meaning: 报复，报仇；为…报仇，报…之仇
entries.example: He wanted revenge after his brother was unfairly treated at work.
entries.exampleZh: 在他兄弟在工作中受到不公平对待后，他想要报复。

entries.meaning: 收入；收入；收入数目；收入，收益；税收，岁入
entries.example: The company's revenue grew by ten percent last year.
entries.exampleZh: 这家公司去年的收入增长了百分之十。

entries.meaning: 相反的；背面，反面；反向，倒转；反向的；相反的；颠倒的；撤销，废除；使完全相反，彻底转变；使反转，使次序颠倒；相反情况，对立面；反面，背面，后面；损失，倒退
entries.example: The new policy aims to reverse the decline in local farming.
entries.exampleZh: 新政策旨在扭转本地农业的衰退。

entries.example: The rain helped revive the tired plants in our garden.
entries.exampleZh: 这场雨帮助我家花园里疲惫的植物恢复了生机。

entries.example: She wrote a book about a revolutionary who changed history.
entries.exampleZh: 她写了一本关于一位改变了历史的革命者的书。

entries.example: New machines may revolutionize the way farmers work in this region.
entries.exampleZh: 新机器可能会彻底改变这个地区农民的工作方式。

entries.example: The moon and stars seem to revolve around our planet.
entries.exampleZh: 月亮和星星似乎围绕着我们的星球旋转。

entries.meaning: 报答，奖赏；报酬，酬金；报答，酬谢，奖励
entries.example: Her hard work earned her a generous reward from the manager.
entries.exampleZh: 她的努力让她从经理那里得到了一份慷慨的奖励。

entries.example: Teaching young children can be very rewarding for patient teachers.
entries.exampleZh: 教导幼儿对耐心的老师来说可能非常有成就感。

entries.example: Her rhetorical question made the audience think about the issue.
entries.exampleZh: 她的反问让观众思考这个问题。

entries.example: The drummer kept a steady rhythm throughout the entire performance.
entries.exampleZh: 鼓手在整个表演过程中保持着稳定的节奏。

entries.example: He faced public ridicule after making that careless mistake.
entries.exampleZh: 他犯了那个粗心错误后遭到了公众的嘲弄。

entries.meaning: 滑稽的，可笑的；荒谬的，可笑的
entries.example: That ridiculous hat made everyone laugh during the ceremony.
entries.exampleZh: 那顶可笑的帽子在仪式上让每个人都笑了。

entries.meaning: 操纵，垄断；给装配帆及索具；用临时替代材料迅速搭起；船桅的装置，成套器械
entries.example: They tried to rig the election with false reports.
entries.exampleZh: 他们试图用虚假报道操纵选举。

entries.example: The school follows rigid rules about uniforms and late arrivals.
entries.exampleZh: 这所学校对校服和迟到有严格的规定。

entries.example: The research was praised for its rigor and careful design.
entries.exampleZh: 这项研究因其严谨和周密的设计而受到赞扬。

entries.meaning: 严格的；严密的，缜密的；严格的，严厉的
entries.example: The team carried out a rigorous test of the new system.
entries.exampleZh: 团队对新系统进行了严格的测试。

entries.meaning: 边；边缘，（眼镜）框；边，缘；环绕边缘
entries.example: She wiped the rim of the glass before pouring the juice.
entries.exampleZh: 她倒果汁前擦了擦杯子的边缘。

entries.example: Please rinse the vegetables carefully before you cook them.
entries.exampleZh: 请你在烹饪前仔细冲洗这些蔬菜。

entries.example: A riot broke out after the final decision was announced.
entries.exampleZh: 最终决定宣布后爆发了一场骚乱。

entries.meaning: 撕，扯破，划破；扯破，撕坏；裂口，裂缝
entries.example: There is a small rip in the sleeve of my coat.
entries.exampleZh: 我外套的袖子上有一个小裂口。

entries.example: A gentle ripple spread across the surface of the quiet lake.
entries.exampleZh: 一圈轻柔的涟漪在平静的湖面上扩散开来。

entries.meaning: 仪式；作为仪式一部分的；例行的；仪式；例行公事，老规矩
entries.example: Morning coffee has become an important ritual in our family.
entries.exampleZh: 晨间咖啡已成为我们家的一项重要仪式。

entries.meaning: 对手；竞争的，对抗的；竞争对手，敌手；可与匹敌的人；与…竞争；与…匹敌，比得上
entries.example: The company's main rival opened a new store downtown.
entries.exampleZh: 公司的主要竞争对手在市中心开了一家新店。

entries.example: Their friendly rivalry has lasted since they were in high school.
entries.exampleZh: 他们之间友好的竞争从高中时就一直持续着。

entries.example: Wild horses roam freely across the wide green valley.
entries.exampleZh: 野马在宽阔的绿色山谷中自由漫步。

entries.example: The police are investigating a robbery at the local bank.
entries.exampleZh: 警方正在调查当地银行发生的一起抢劫案。

entries.example: The doctor said her robust health would help her recover quickly.
entries.exampleZh: 医生说她的强健体魄会帮助她很快康复。

entries.example: The painter used a small roller for the ceiling.
entries.exampleZh: 油漆工用一个小滚筒刷天花板。

entries.example: The old story describes a Roman soldier on the wall.
entries.exampleZh: 这个古老的故事描述了一名在城墙上的罗马士兵。

entries.meaning: 传奇；浪漫文学；恋爱，恋爱关系；浪漫气氛，传奇色彩；爱情小说，传奇故事
entries.example: Their romance began during a summer trip to Italy.
entries.exampleZh: 他们的恋情始于一次意大利夏日之旅。

entries.example: They enjoyed a romantic dinner by the river.
entries.exampleZh: 他们在河边享用了一顿浪漫的晚餐。

entries.example: The rooster woke the whole farm before sunrise.
entries.exampleZh: 公鸡在日出前叫醒了整个农场。

entries.example: The old wood began to rot after weeks of rain.
entries.exampleZh: 那块旧木头在数周的雨后开始腐烂。

entries.example: The machine uses a rotary blade to cut the grass.
entries.exampleZh: 这台机器用旋转刀片割草。

entries.example: Please rotate the handle gently until the lid opens.
entries.exampleZh: 请轻轻转动把手，直到盖子打开。

entries.example: He gave a roundabout answer that avoided the main question.
entries.exampleZh: 他给了一个回避主要问题的迂回回答。

entries.meaning: 日常的；常规；例行的，常规的；例行公事，惯例，惯常的程序
entries.example: My morning routine includes coffee and a short walk.
entries.exampleZh: 我的早晨惯例包括喝咖啡和短暂散步。

entries.example: They had a serious row about money last night.
entries.exampleZh: 他们昨晚为钱大吵了一架。

entries.meaning: 皇家，王族，皇族；王族；版税
entries.example: The author receives royalty payments from every book sold.
entries.exampleZh: 作者从每本售出的书中获得版税。

entries.example: She wore a small ruby on her silver ring.
entries.exampleZh: 她在银戒指上镶了一颗小红宝石。

entries.example: The storm will ruin the crops if it continues.
entries.exampleZh: 如果暴风雨持续，就会毁掉庄稼。

entries.example: The judge will rule on the case tomorrow morning.
entries.exampleZh: 法官将在明天上午对此案作出裁定。

entries.example: The court's ruling surprised both the lawyers and the public.
entries.exampleZh: 法院的裁定让律师和公众都感到意外。

entries.meaning: 破裂；破裂，裂开；决裂，断绝
entries.example: A sudden rupture in the pipe caused a major leak.
entries.exampleZh: 管道突然破裂导致了严重漏水。

entries.example: Dry leaves rustle softly whenever the wind blows.
entries.exampleZh: 每当风吹过，干树叶就发出沙沙声。

entries.example: The ruthless manager ignored every request for extra help.
entries.exampleZh: 那位冷酷的经理无视了所有额外帮助的请求。

entries.meaning: 神圣的；宗教的；神圣不可侵犯的
entries.example: This ancient forest is sacred to the local people.
entries.exampleZh: 这片古老的森林对当地人来说是神圣的。

entries.meaning: 牺牲，舍身；献祭，供奉；祭品
entries.example: Her parents made a huge sacrifice so she could study abroad.
entries.exampleZh: 她的父母为了她能出国留学做出了巨大牺牲。

entries.meaning: 保护措施；保护，维护；预防措施；保证条款
entries.example: Strong locks are a useful safeguard against thieves at night.
entries.exampleZh: 坚固的锁是夜间防贼的有效保护措施。

entries.example: For the sake of peace, they agreed to talk again.
entries.exampleZh: 为了和平，他们同意再次交谈。

entries.example: These old chairs are still saleable at a fair price.
entries.exampleZh: 这些旧椅子仍能以公道价格出售。

entries.example: We grilled a fresh salmon with lemon and herbs.
entries.exampleZh: 我们用柠檬和香草烤了一条新鲜鲑鱼。

entries.meaning: （向…）行军礼，（向…）致敬；敬礼，致意；向…敬礼，向…致意；赞扬，颂扬
entries.example: The soldiers gave a respectful salute to the flag.
entries.exampleZh: 士兵们向国旗行了庄重的敬礼。

entries.example: Education was her salvation after years of poverty.
entries.exampleZh: 教育是她摆脱多年贫困的救星。

entries.meaning: 样本，样品；样品，试样，样本；从…抽样；品尝，体验
entries.example: The doctor took a small sample of blood for tests.
entries.exampleZh: 医生取了一小份血样用于化验。

entries.meaning: 批准，认可；批准，认可；约束因素，约束力；国际制裁
entries.example: The committee gave its sanction to the new plan.
entries.exampleZh: 委员会批准了新计划。

entries.example: She tried to sandwich a short meeting between two classes.
entries.exampleZh: 她试图在两节课之间挤进一个短会。

entries.example: Poor sanitation can spread disease quickly in crowded cities.
entries.exampleZh: 在拥挤的城市里，卫生条件差会使疾病迅速传播。

entries.example: He added one small sardine to the salad.
entries.exampleZh: 他在沙拉里加了一条小沙丁鱼。

entries.example: The small country had long been a satellite of its neighbor.
entries.exampleZh: 这个小国长期以来一直是邻国的附属国。

entries.example: She smiled with deep satisfaction after finishing the difficult project.
entries.exampleZh: 完成那个艰难的项目后，她满意地笑了。

entries.example: The machine worked satisfactorily after the mechanic repaired it.
entries.exampleZh: 机械师修好之后，这台机器运转令人满意。

entries.meaning: 使湿透，浸透；使充满，使饱和
entries.example: Heavy rain will saturate the soil and fill the rivers.
entries.exampleZh: 大雨会使土壤湿透，并让河水上涨。

entries.example: The market has reached saturation, so prices may start falling.
entries.exampleZh: 市场已经达到饱和，所以价格可能开始下跌。

entries.example: The planet Saturn is easily seen through a small telescope on clear nights.
entries.exampleZh: 在晴朗的夜晚，通过小型望远镜很容易看到土星。

entries.meaning: 残暴的，凶猛的，粗鲁的；未开化的，野蛮的；野蛮人，粗鲁的人；乱咬；激烈抨击
entries.example: The savage storm destroyed several houses along the coast.
entries.exampleZh: 那场猛烈的风暴摧毁了沿海的几座房屋。

entries.example: Workers put up scaffolding before repairing the front of the building.
entries.exampleZh: 工人在修理大楼正面之前搭起了脚手架。

entries.meaning: 大小，规模；等级，级别；天平，磅秤；比例；刻度，标度；鳞；攀登，爬越
entries.example: The scale of the recent damage surprised all the local farmers.
entries.exampleZh: 最近损失的程度让所有当地农民感到惊讶。

entries.exampleZh: 日落时分，山间的景色十分美妙。

entries.example: We spent the whole day sightseeing around the old town.
entries.exampleZh: 我们花了一整天在古镇四处观光游览。

entries.example: A high fever can be a sign of serious illness.
entries.exampleZh: 高烧可能是重病的征兆。

entries.meaning: 标志；显著的，重大的；信号，暗号；标志，表示；发信号；标志着

entries.exampleZh: 裁判发出信号，示意比赛开始。

entries.meaning: 重要的；重要的，重大的，影响深远的；相当数量的；重要的，意义重大的，意味深长的
entries.example: This discovery is significant for our understanding of the disease.
entries.exampleZh: 这一发现对我们理解这种疾病意义重大。

entries.meaning: 表明，象征；表示，意味着；有重要性；表示…的意思，意味，预示

entries.exampleZh: 乌云常常预示着一场雨即将来临。

entries.example: The new chip contains a thin layer of silicon.
entries.exampleZh: 这种新芯片包含一层薄薄的硅。

entries.example: Your jacket looks very similar to the one I bought last week.
entries.exampleZh: 你的夹克看起来和我上周买的那件非常相似。

entries.example: There is a clear similarity between these two ancient languages.
entries.exampleZh: 这两种古老语言之间有明显的相似之处。

entries.example: The answer to this problem is actually quite simple.
entries.exampleZh: 这个问题的答案其实相当简单。

entries.example: The beauty of this design lies in its simplicity.
entries.exampleZh: 这个设计的美在于其简约。

entries.meaning: 模拟，模仿；模仿，模拟；假装，冒充
entries.example: Engineers use software to simulate the effects of an earthquake.
entries.exampleZh: 工程师使用软件来模拟地震的影响。

entries.meaning: 同步的；同时的，同时存在的；同时发生的，同时存在的；同步的，一齐的

entries.exampleZh: 这两个活动同时进行，所以我无法两个都参加。

entries.example: The two machines started simultaneously and made a loud noise.
entries.exampleZh: 两台机器同时启动，发出了很大的噪音。

entries.example: She spoke with great sincerity about her hopes for the future.
entries.exampleZh: 她非常真诚地谈到了对未来的希望。

entries.example: He showed a singular talent for solving difficult puzzles.
entries.exampleZh: 他展现出解决难题的非凡才能。

entries.example: The kitchen sink is full of dirty dishes after dinner.
entries.exampleZh: 晚饭后厨房的水槽里堆满了脏盘子。

entries.meaning: 小口地喝，抿，呷；小口喝，一小口的量
entries.example: She took a small sip of hot tea before speaking.
entries.exampleZh: 她说话前小口喝了一点热茶。

entries.example: The ambulance siren woke everyone in the building.
entries.exampleZh: 救护车的警报器吵醒了楼里的所有人。

entries.meaning: 位于…的；位于…的，坐落在…的；处于…境地的

entries.exampleZh: 这家酒店位于海滩和车站附近。

entries.example: The situation of the house gives it a fine view.
entries.exampleZh: 这所房子的位置使它拥有极好的视野。

entries.meaning: 骨骼，骷髅；骨架；骨骼；框架，骨干；梗概，提要
entries.example: The skeleton of the old building was still standing.
entries.exampleZh: 那座老建筑的骨架仍然矗立着。

entries.example: I am skeptical about his promise to finish the work on time.
entries.exampleZh: 我对他按时完成工作的承诺表示怀疑。

entries.meaning: 跳过；蹦跳着走；跳绳；略过；跳，蹦跳；跳绳；跳过，略过，漏过；跳，蹦跳
entries.example: We can skip the boring meeting and start work early.
entries.exampleZh: 我们可以跳过无聊的会议，早点开始工作。

entries.example: The museum displayed a human skull beside several ancient stone tools.
entries.exampleZh: 博物馆把一个人头骨放在几件古代石器旁展出。

entries.example: Online sales are expected to skyrocket during the holiday season this year.
entries.exampleZh: 今年节日期间，网上销售额预计会猛增。

entries.example: The new skyscraper will dominate the city skyline when it is finished.
entries.exampleZh: 这座新摩天大楼完工后将主导城市的天际线。

entries.meaning: 疲软的，萧条的；萧条的；懈怠的；懈怠，懒散；懈怠的，马虎的；萧条的，清淡的，不活跃的；松的；松弛部分；宽松裤
entries.example: Business is slack during the coldest weeks of winter.
entries.exampleZh: 在冬季最冷的几周里，生意很萧条。

entries.example: She threatened to sue the magazine for slander after that article.
entries.exampleZh: 那篇文章发表后，她威胁要以诽谤罪起诉那家杂志。

entries.example: Many teenagers use slang that their parents cannot understand at all.
entries.exampleZh: 许多青少年使用父母完全听不懂的俚语。

entries.meaning: 掴；巴掌；掴，掌击，拍；啪的一声放；掴，掌击，拍
entries.example: He gave the table a loud slap to get everyone's attention.
entries.exampleZh: 他用力拍了一下桌子，以引起大家的注意。

entries.meaning: 削减；砍；大幅度削减；砍，砍痕；斜线号
entries.example: The company plans to slash its advertising budget by half next year.
entries.exampleZh: 公司计划明年把广告预算削减一半。

entries.meaning: 屠杀；屠宰；屠杀，杀戮；屠宰
entries.example: The report describes the senseless slaughter of countless wild animals each year.
entries.exampleZh: 这份报告描述了每年对无数野生动物的无谓屠杀。

entries.example: Some workers slave away for hours without any extra pay.
entries.exampleZh: 有些工人辛苦工作数小时却没有任何额外报酬。

entries.example: The museum teaches visitors about the history of slavery in the region.
entries.exampleZh: 博物馆向参观者介绍该地区奴隶制度的历史。

entries.example: Would you like another slice of cake with your tea?
entries.exampleZh: 你想再来一片蛋糕配茶吗？

entries.meaning: 圆滑的，口齿伶俐的；精巧的，巧妙的，灵巧的；光滑的，滑溜的
entries.example: His slick presentation convinced the investors to support the new project.
entries.exampleZh: 他圆滑的陈述说服了投资者支持这个新项目。

entries.meaning: 滑动，滑行；滑；悄悄地移动；滑动；滑道，滑面；幻灯片
entries.example: The children love to slide down the snowy hill on old boxes.
entries.exampleZh: 孩子们喜欢坐在旧箱子上从雪坡上滑下来。

entries.meaning: 轻微的；轻微的，微小的；侮慢；轻视，冷落
entries.example: There is a slight chance of rain later this afternoon.
entries.exampleZh: 今天下午晚些时候有一点下雨的可能。

entries.example: The second room is slightly larger than the first one upstairs.
entries.exampleZh: 楼上的第二个房间比第一个稍大一些。

entries.example: She stays slim by walking to work every morning.
entries.exampleZh: 她每天早上步行上班以保持苗条。

entries.meaning: 滑跤，滑落，溜；下降，跌落；悄悄放进；疏漏，差错
entries.example: Be careful not to slip on the wet kitchen floor.
entries.exampleZh: 小心别在湿滑的厨房地板上滑倒。

entries.example: The icy path was too slippery for the elderly man to cross.
entries.exampleZh: 那条结冰的小路太滑了，那位老人过不去。

entries.example: A narrow slit of light appeared under the closed door.
entries.exampleZh: 关着的门下出现了一道细长的光缝。

entries.example: The company changed its advertising slogan after the public complained.
entries.exampleZh: 公众投诉后，公司更换了广告标语。

entries.example: The garden has a gentle slope down to the river.
entries.exampleZh: 花园里有一个缓缓向下、通向河边的小坡。

entries.meaning: 狭缝，狭槽；位置，空位；把…放入狭长开口中；把…纳入其中，使有位置
entries.example: Put the coin into the slot and press the green button.
entries.exampleZh: 把硬币投进投币口，然后按绿色按钮。

entries.example: He grew up in a crowded slum near the harbour.
entries.exampleZh: 他在港口附近一个拥挤的贫民窟长大。

entries.example: The baby fell into a deep slumber after the long journey.
entries.exampleZh: 长途旅行之后，婴儿进入了沉睡。

entries.meaning: 大幅度下降，暴跌；突然倒下；萧条期，低潮
entries.example: Sales fell into a serious slump during the winter months.
entries.exampleZh: 冬季的几个月里，销量陷入严重下跌。

entries.example: My eyes began to smart in the smoke from the fire.
entries.exampleZh: 火里的烟让我的眼睛开始刺痛。

entries.meaning: 打碎，打破，粉碎；猛撞，猛冲；使粉碎，使打烂；狠打，猛击；使破灭，使失败；破碎；猛击，猛撞；轰动的演出，巨大的成功

entries.exampleZh: 小偷用一块砖砸碎了商店的橱窗。

entries.meaning: 走私；私运，走私；走私，非法私运；偷运，偷带
entries.example: They tried to smuggle rare birds through the busy airport.
entries.exampleZh: 他们试图把珍稀鸟类偷偷运过繁忙的机场。

entries.meaning: 快餐，小吃；快餐，小吃，点心
entries.example: We bought a quick snack before the long train ride.
entries.exampleZh: 在漫长的火车旅程前，我们买了点小吃充饥。

entries.example: A small snail moved slowly across the wet garden path.
entries.exampleZh: 一只小蜗牛慢慢爬过潮湿的花园小路。

entries.example: The dry twig will snap if you pull it hard.
entries.exampleZh: 如果你用力拉，那根干树枝就会折断。

entries.meaning: 一把抓住；夺，夺走，抢走；一下子拉，一把抓住；抓住机会做，抽空做；片断

entries.exampleZh: 一名小偷在繁忙的街上试图抢走她的包。

entries.meaning: 溜走；偷偷地走，溜；偷偷地做

entries.exampleZh: 我们设法悄悄从熟睡的守卫身边溜了过去。

entries.example: His sneer showed exactly what he thought of my old car.
entries.exampleZh: 他的冷笑清楚地表明了他对我那辆旧车的看法。

entries.example: The pepper made him sneeze three times in a row.
entries.exampleZh: 胡椒粉让他一连打了三个喷嚏。

entries.meaning: 用鼻子吸，嗅；以鼻吸气，用力吸入；嗅，闻；吸气；嗅，闻
entries.example: The dog stopped to sniff the flowers by the gate.
entries.exampleZh: 狗停下来闻了闻门边的花。

entries.example: He is such a snob that he ignores his old friends.
entries.exampleZh: 他是个十足的势利眼，连老朋友都不理。

entries.example: Her snobbish remarks about my accent annoyed the whole group.
entries.exampleZh: 她对我口音的那些势利评论让全组人都很恼火。

entries.example: My brother tends to snore loudly after a long day at work.
entries.exampleZh: 我哥哥辛苦工作一天后往往会打呼噜很大声。

entries.meaning: 高飞；猛增，剧增；高飞，升腾；高涨；高耸，屹立
entries.example: Prices soar every winter when fresh vegetables become hard to find.
entries.exampleZh: 每年冬天新鲜蔬菜难找时，价格就会飞涨。

entries.meaning: 未醉的，有节制的；严肃的，持重的；素淡的，暗淡的；醒酒，清醒
entries.example: He stayed sober all evening because he had to drive home.
entries.exampleZh: 他整个晚上都没喝酒，因为他得开车回家。

entries.example: She is writing a paper on the sociology of modern cities.
entries.exampleZh: 她正在写一篇关于现代城市社会学的论文。

entries.example: Too much sodium in your diet can raise your blood pressure.
entries.exampleZh: 饮食中钠摄入过多会使你的血压升高。

entries.example: The cat fell asleep on the sofa beside the window.
entries.exampleZh: 猫在窗边的沙发上睡着了。

entries.example: A warm smile can soften even the strictest teacher's mood.
entries.exampleZh: 一个温暖的微笑甚至能软化最严厉老师的心情。

entries.example: The softness of the blanket made the baby fall asleep.
entries.exampleZh: 毯子的柔软让宝宝睡着了。

entries.example: Our company installed new software to track daily sales figures.
entries.exampleZh: 我们公司安装了新软件来统计每日销售数据。

entries.example: They fitted solar panels on the roof last summer.
entries.exampleZh: 他们去年夏天在屋顶上安装了太阳能板。

entries.example: The judge spoke in a solemn voice before reading the verdict.
entries.exampleZh: 法官在宣读判决前用庄严的声音讲话。

entries.example: You should ask a solicitor to check the contract before signing.
entries.exampleZh: 你应该在签字前请律师检查一下合同。

entries.example: The table feels solid and should last for many years.
entries.exampleZh: 这张桌子感觉很结实，应该能用很多年。

entries.meaning: 团结；休戚相关；团结一致
entries.example: The workers showed solidarity by refusing to leave the factory.
entries.exampleZh: 工人们拒绝离开工厂，以示团结。

entries.example: The melted wax will solidify quickly once it cools down.
entries.exampleZh: 融化的蜡一旦冷却就会很快凝固。

entries.meaning: 单独的，独自的；单个的，唯一的；孤独的，隐居的
entries.example: A solitary figure stood at the end of the empty beach.
entries.exampleZh: 一个孤独的身影站在空荡荡的海滩尽头。

entries.meaning: 独唱，独奏；独唱曲；以独力，单独地；单独的，单独进行的；独奏，独唱，独舞
entries.example: She sang a solo at the school concert last Friday night.
entries.exampleZh: 上周五晚上她在学校音乐会上独唱了一曲。

entries.example: This powder is soluble in warm water, so stir it well.
entries.exampleZh: 这种粉末可溶于温水，所以要好好搅拌。

entries.meaning: 解决，溶液；解决；解决办法；溶液
entries.example: We finally found a simple solution to the noisy neighbour problem.
entries.exampleZh: 我们终于找到了解决邻居吵闹问题的简单办法。

entries.example: Soft music can soothe a crying baby within a few minutes.
entries.exampleZh: 轻柔的音乐能在几分钟内安抚哭闹的婴儿。

entries.meaning: 复杂的，老于世故的；老于世故的；高级的；老于世故的；高级的；精密的，复杂的；高雅的
entries.example: She has sophisticated taste in art and loves modern design.
entries.exampleZh: 她在艺术方面品味高雅，而且喜欢现代设计。

entries.example: His sorrowful voice made everyone in the room feel quiet and sad.
entries.exampleZh: 他悲伤的声音让屋里每个人都安静下来，感到难过。

entries.meaning: 酸的；馊的，酸味的；脾气坏的；变酸，变馊；变得乖戾
entries.example: The milk has gone sour, so we must throw it away.
entries.exampleZh: 牛奶已经变酸了，所以我们必须把它倒掉。

entries.example: The birds flew southwards as the weather turned colder.
entries.exampleZh: 天气变冷时，鸟儿们向南方飞去了。

entries.example: She bought a small souvenir for her brother at the airport shop.
entries.exampleZh: 她在机场商店给弟弟买了一件小纪念品。

entries.meaning: 君主；统治的；拥有最高统治权的，至高无上的；具有独立主权的；君主，元首
entries.example: The young sovereign promised to serve his people with honesty.
entries.exampleZh: 这位年轻的君主承诺以诚实之心服务他的人民。

entries.example: Farmers in this region grow soy and corn on the same land.
entries.exampleZh: 这个地区的农民在同一块土地上种大豆和玉米。

entries.meaning: 宽敞的；广阔的，广大的；宽广的，宽敞的
entries.example: Their new flat is bright and spacious, with room for a large sofa.
entries.exampleZh: 他们的新公寓明亮宽敞，还有地方放一张大沙发。

entries.meaning: （桥墩间的）墩距；跨距，一段时间；持续，贯穿，包括；横跨，跨越
entries.example: Her career will span more than thirty years in the music business.
entries.exampleZh: 她在音乐行业的职业生涯将跨越三十多年。

entries.example: A single spark from the engine started the fire in the dry grass.
entries.exampleZh: 发动机迸出的一点火花点燃了干草中的火。

entries.meaning: 发光，闪耀，闪烁；活跃，焕发；闪光，闪耀，闪烁；活力，生气
entries.example: The little girl's eyes sparkle whenever she sees a puppy.
entries.exampleZh: 这个小女孩每次看到小狗，眼睛都会闪闪发亮。

entries.example: Children often need help to understand basic spatial ideas like left and right.
entries.exampleZh: 孩子们常常需要帮助才能理解像左右这样的基本空间概念。

entries.example: The doctor sent him to a heart specialist in the city hospital.
entries.exampleZh: 医生把他转介给市医院的一位心脏专家。

entries.meaning: 专业从事；使专门化，专业化；专攻，专门研究；使适应特殊目的，使专用于
entries.example: Many young doctors choose to specialize in children's health.
entries.exampleZh: 许多年轻医生选择专攻儿童健康。

entries.meaning: 特产，名产，特色菜；专业，专长
entries.example: This small restaurant is famous for its local specialty, fried fish.
entries.exampleZh: 这家小餐馆以当地特产炸鱼而闻名。

entries.example: Several rare species of birds nest in these quiet mountain forests.
entries.exampleZh: 几种稀有鸟类在这些安静的山林中筑巢。

entries.meaning: 具体的；特有的；明确的；具体的；详情，细节
entries.example: Please give me a specific example so I can understand your point.
entries.exampleZh: 请给我一个具体的例子，这样我才能理解你的观点。

entries.meaning: 说明书；规格；明确说明，详述；规格，规范；明确说明；说明书
entries.example: The engineer checked every specification before the machine was built.
entries.exampleZh: 工程师在机器制造之前核对了每一项规格。

entries.example: The scientist kept each specimen in a small glass box.
entries.exampleZh: 科学家把每个标本都放在一个小玻璃盒里。

entries.meaning: 景象；场面，景象；奇观；演出，场面；景象，壮观；眼镜
entries.example: The fireworks over the lake were a wonderful spectacle for everyone.
entries.exampleZh: 湖面上的烟花对每个人来说都是一场美妙的奇观。

entries.meaning: 参观者，观众；观众，旁观者
entries.example: A single spectator remained in the stadium long after the final whistle.
entries.exampleZh: 终场哨响后很久，一名观众仍留在体育场里。

entries.meaning: 系列，范围；波谱；谱，光谱，频谱；范围，幅度，系列
entries.example: The survey covers a wide spectrum of opinions from young and old.
entries.exampleZh: 这项调查涵盖了年轻人和老年人广泛的意见范围。

entries.meaning: 猜测，推测；投机；推测，推断；投机，做投机买卖
entries.example: Experts speculate that the new policy will lower prices next year.
entries.exampleZh: 专家推测新政策明年会降低价格。

entries.example: The small planet has a nearly spherical shape despite its fast spin.
entries.exampleZh: 这颗小行星尽管自转很快，形状仍近乎球形。

entries.meaning: 香料，调味品；香料，调味品；趣味，情趣，风味；使增添趣味；加香料于
entries.example: A little spice can turn a simple meal into something memorable.
entries.exampleZh: 一点点香料就能把简单的一餐变得令人难忘。

entries.example: The cyclist had a nasty spill on the wet road this morning.
entries.exampleZh: 今天早上，那名骑车人在湿滑的路上重重摔了一跤。

entries.meaning: 微妙的；微妙的；精巧的；微妙的，难以捉摸的；诡秘的，狡诈的；隐约的
entries.example: There was a subtle difference between the two shades of blue.
entries.exampleZh: 这两种蓝色之间有细微的差别。

entries.example: Please subtract the total cost from your monthly budget.
entries.exampleZh: 请从每月预算中减去总费用。

entries.example: They moved to a quiet suburb after their first child was born.
entries.exampleZh: 他们的第一个孩子出生后，他们搬到了一个安静的郊区。

entries.example: She prefers suburban life because it is quieter and less crowded.
entries.exampleZh: 她更喜欢郊区生活，因为那里更安静，也不那么拥挤。

entries.example: The young prince's succession to the throne was announced last week.
entries.exampleZh: 这位年轻王子继承王位的消息于上周宣布。

entries.example: The team won three successive matches before the final defeat.
entries.exampleZh: 该队在最后失利前连续赢了三场比赛。

entries.example: The lights turned on successively as we walked down the hall.
entries.exampleZh: 我们沿走廊走过时，灯一盏接一盏地亮了起来。

entries.meaning: 继承人，继任者；接替的人或事物，继任者
entries.example: The new manager will be the successor to our retiring director.
entries.exampleZh: 新经理将接替我们即将退休的主管。

entries.example: She decided to sue the company for unfair dismissal.
entries.exampleZh: 她决定因不公平解雇起诉那家公司。

entries.example: A brief note should suffice to explain my absence.
entries.exampleZh: 简短的说明应该足以解释我的缺席。

entries.example: The evidence was not sufficient to prove his guilt in court.
entries.exampleZh: 在法庭上，这些证据不足以证明他有罪。

entries.example: The charity runs a hotline to prevent suicide among young adults.
entries.exampleZh: 这家慈善机构开通热线，防止年轻人自杀。

entries.example: Monday morning does not suit me for the meeting.
entries.exampleZh: 周一上午不适合我参加会议。

entries.example: Her suitcase was too heavy to carry up the stairs.
entries.exampleZh: 她的手提箱太重，搬不上楼。

entries.meaning: 套间；一套家具；套，组，系列
entries.example: They booked a hotel suite for their anniversary weekend.
entries.exampleZh: 他们为周年纪念周末预订了一间酒店套房。

entries.example: The laboratory stored sulfur in a sealed glass container.
entries.exampleZh: 实验室把硫储存在一个密封的玻璃容器里。

entries.example: He stayed sullen all evening and refused to speak to anyone.
entries.exampleZh: 他整个晚上都绷着脸，不愿跟任何人说话。

entries.example: The judge gave a summary ruling after hearing both sides.
entries.exampleZh: 法官听取双方陈述后作出了概括性裁决。

entries.meaning: 顶点，最高点；极度；最高点，峰顶；最高级会议
entries.example: The climbers reached the summit just before the storm arrived.
entries.exampleZh: 登山者在暴风雨到来前刚好到达峰顶。

entries.meaning: 召唤；鼓起（勇气）；召唤，传唤；鼓起，振作；召集，召开
entries.example: She had to summon all her courage before entering the room.
entries.exampleZh: 她进房间前不得不鼓起全部勇气。

entries.example: The view from the top of the hill was truly superb.
entries.exampleZh: 山顶上的景色真是壮丽极了。

entries.meaning: 表面的；表面的；肤浅的；表面的，肤浅的
entries.example: His knowledge of the topic remained superficial despite years of study.
entries.exampleZh: 尽管学习了多年，他对这个话题的了解仍然很肤浅。

entries.meaning: 主管人，监管人，负责人；警长
entries.example: The building superintendent fixed the broken pipe before noon.
entries.exampleZh: 大楼管理员在中午前修好了破裂的管道。

entries.meaning: 上级的，较高的；优越的；有优越感的，高傲的；上级，长官
entries.example: She believed her plan was superior to everyone else's idea.
entries.exampleZh: 她认为自己的计划比别人的主意都优越。

entries.example: His constant boasting revealed a deep sense of superiority.
entries.exampleZh: 他不断的吹嘘显露出一种深深的优越感。

entries.meaning: 超声的，超声速的；超声的，超音速的
entries.example: The new jet can travel at supersonic speed across the ocean.
entries.exampleZh: 这种新型喷气机能以超音速飞越海洋。

entries.example: Old superstition still influences some farmers in this village.
entries.exampleZh: 古老的迷信仍然影响着这个村里的一些农民。

entries.meaning: 监督，监视；监督，管理，指导
entries.example: Teachers supervise the students during lunch in the main hall.
entries.exampleZh: 老师们在主厅监督学生吃午饭。

entries.example: My supervisor approved the request after reading my report.
entries.exampleZh: 我的主管读完报告后批准了请求。

entries.meaning: 补角；增补，补充；增刊，副刊；增补，补充
entries.example: This vitamin supplement should be taken with food.
entries.exampleZh: 这种维生素补充剂应随餐服用。

entries.example: The teacher handed out supplementary materials for the advanced class.
entries.exampleZh: 老师给高级班分发了补充材料。

entries.example: The old bridge cannot support the weight of heavy trucks.
entries.exampleZh: 这座老桥承受不住重型卡车的重量。

entries.meaning: 镇压，压制；镇压；抑制；禁止发表；封锁；查禁；压制，镇压；禁止发表，查禁；抑制，忍住；阻止…的生长
entries.example: The government tried to suppress the news for several weeks.
entries.exampleZh: 政府试图封锁这条消息数周。

entries.meaning: 最高的，最大的；极度的，最重要的
entries.example: The supreme court will hear the case next month.
entries.exampleZh: 最高法院将在下个月审理此案。

entries.meaning: 蜂拥而出；洋溢，奔放；汹涌，奔腾；洋溢，奔放；急剧上升，猛增；浪涛般汹涌奔腾
entries.example: Demand for electric cars caused a sudden surge in sales.
entries.exampleZh: 电动汽车的需求导致销量突然激增。

entries.example: The surgeon washed her hands carefully before the operation began.
entries.exampleZh: 外科医生在手术开始前仔细洗了手。

entries.example: The doctor said the surgery would take about two hours tomorrow morning.
entries.exampleZh: 医生说手术明天上午大约需要两个小时。

entries.example: The nurse prepared the surgical tools before the patient entered the room.
entries.exampleZh: 护士在病人进入房间前准备好了手术工具。

entries.meaning: 超过；超过，超越，胜过；超过，优于，多于；超过…的界限，非…所能办到
entries.example: Her latest results surpass all our expectations for this difficult project.
entries.exampleZh: 她最新的成绩超过了我们对这个困难项目的全部预期。

entries.meaning: 过剩，剩余（物资）；过剩的，多余的；过剩，剩余，盈余
entries.example: The company sold its surplus equipment to a smaller local business.
entries.exampleZh: 公司把多余的设备卖给了一家较小的本地企业。

entries.meaning: 俯瞰，眺望；全面审视，调查；测量，勘定；[sə'veɪ]
entries.example: The team will survey local residents about their use of public transport.
entries.exampleZh: 团队将调查当地居民使用公共交通的情况。

entries.meaning: 幸存；残存；幸存者；幸存；幸存者；残存物
entries.example: Clean water is essential for the survival of every living thing here.
entries.exampleZh: 干净的水对这里每一个生物的生存都至关重要。

entries.meaning: 活下来，继续存在；幸免于；从中挺过来；从…逃出；比…活得长
entries.example: These plants can survive long periods without any rain at all.
entries.exampleZh: 这些植物在完全没有雨的情况下也能存活很长时间。

entries.meaning: 易受影响的；过敏的；能经受的，容许的
entries.example: Young children are more susceptible to colds during the winter months.
entries.exampleZh: 幼儿在冬季更容易患感冒。

entries.example: The police have a strong suspect in the robbery case.
entries.exampleZh: 警方在这起抢劫案中有一名重要嫌疑人。

entries.example: The airline may suspend flights to the island during the storm.
entries.exampleZh: 航空公司可能会在暴风雨期间暂停飞往该岛的航班。

entries.meaning: 暂停，中止；暂令停止参加，暂时剥夺；悬架，悬置机构；悬浮液；悬，挂，吊
entries.example: The bridge's suspension design allows it to move safely in strong winds.
entries.exampleZh: 这座桥的悬索设计使它能在强风中安全移动。

entries.meaning: 怀疑，疑心，猜疑；一点儿，少量
entries.example: Her sudden silence raised suspicion among the members of the group.
entries.exampleZh: 她突然的沉默引起了小组成员的怀疑。

entries.meaning: 怀疑的；可疑的；猜疑的；猜疑的，疑心的；可疑的；表示怀疑的
entries.example: The guard became suspicious when the visitor refused to show his badge.
entries.exampleZh: 当来访者拒绝出示证件时，警卫起了疑心。

entries.meaning: 保持，使持续下去；供养，维持；支持，支撑；经受，遭受
entries.example: The small farm cannot sustain so many animals through the dry season.
entries.exampleZh: 这个小农场无法在旱季养活这么多动物。

entries.meaning: 沼泽；淹没，浸没；难倒，压倒
entries.example: Heavy rain turned the low field into a muddy swamp overnight.
entries.exampleZh: 大雨在一夜之间把低洼的田地变成了泥泞的沼泽。

entries.example: We can swap seats if you prefer a window view.
entries.exampleZh: 如果你更喜欢靠窗的座位，我们可以交换座位。

entries.example: His calm voice may sway the committee to support the plan.
entries.exampleZh: 他平静的声音可能会影响委员会支持该计划。

entries.example: Please sweep the kitchen floor before the guests arrive this evening.
entries.exampleZh: 请在今晚客人到达前扫一下厨房地板。

entries.example: A little honey can sweeten the tea without adding much sugar.
entries.exampleZh: 一点蜂蜜就能让茶变甜，而不用加很多糖。

entries.example: The sweetness of the fresh fruit made the simple dessert special.
entries.exampleZh: 新鲜水果的甜味让这道简单的甜点很特别。

entries.example: Her ankle began to swell after she fell awkwardly during the match.
entries.exampleZh: 她在比赛中笨拙地摔倒后，脚踝开始肿起来。

entries.example: Please switch off the lights before you leave the office tonight.
entries.exampleZh: 今晚离开办公室前请把灯关掉。

entries.example: The dove is a widely recognized symbol of peace around the world.
entries.exampleZh: 鸽子是世界上广泛认可的和平象征。

entries.example: The small gift was purely symbolic and carried no real value.
entries.exampleZh: 这份小礼物纯粹是象征性的，并没有真正的价值。

entries.example: The garden was designed in a perfectly symmetrical shape.
entries.exampleZh: 这座花园被设计成完全对称的形状。

entries.meaning: 对称（性），匀称；对称；匀称，整齐
entries.example: The building's perfect symmetry pleases everyone who walks past it.
entries.exampleZh: 这座建筑完美的对称让每个路过的人都感到愉悦。

entries.meaning: 同情的；同情的；和谐的；赞同的，支持的；合意的
entries.example: My teacher was very sympathetic when I explained my family problems.
entries.exampleZh: 当我解释家里的问题时，老师非常同情我。

entries.example: She offered her sincere sympathy to the family after the accident.
entries.exampleZh: 事故发生后，她向这家人表达了诚挚的慰问。

entries.meaning: 交响乐；交响乐团；交响乐，交响曲；和谐，协调
entries.example: The orchestra played a beautiful symphony by Mozart last night.
entries.exampleZh: 昨晚管弦乐队演奏了莫扎特的一首优美交响曲。

entries.meaning: 座谈会；讨论会，专题报告会；专题论文集
entries.example: Several experts spoke at the symposium on climate change last Friday.
entries.exampleZh: 上周五，几位专家在气候变化研讨会上发言。

entries.example: A high fever is a common symptom of this viral infection.
entries.exampleZh: 高烧是这种病毒感染的常见症状。

entries.meaning: 综合病症，综合症状；一系列表现
entries.example: The doctor explained that this syndrome affects the body's immune system.
entries.exampleZh: 医生解释说，这种综合症会影响人体的免疫系统。

entries.meaning: 综合，综合物；（化学或生物学物质的）合成；（用电子方式对声音、语音或音乐的）合成；综合；合成
entries.example: Her new book is a synthesis of history and modern science.
entries.exampleZh: 她的新书是历史与现代科学的综合。

entries.example: We need a systematic approach to solve this complicated problem.
entries.exampleZh: 我们需要一套系统的方法来解决这个复杂的问题。

entries.example: The team systematically checked every room before they left the building.
entries.exampleZh: 团队在离开大楼前系统地检查了每个房间。

entries.example: Please tabulate the results before the meeting starts tomorrow morning.
entries.exampleZh: 请在明天上午会议开始前把结果列成表格。

entries.meaning: 平头钉；钉住；平头钉，大头钉；行动方向，方针；用平头钉钉；附加，增补
entries.example: He used a small tack to hang the picture on the wall.
entries.exampleZh: 他用一枚小图钉把画挂在墙上。

entries.meaning: 解决，处理；解决，对付；用具；对付，处理；与…交涉；阻截，擒抱；阻截，擒抱；用具，钓具；辘轳，滑车
entries.example: The government must tackle unemployment before the situation gets worse.
entries.exampleZh: 政府必须在形势恶化之前解决失业问题。

entries.example: She handled the delicate question with great tact and patience.
entries.exampleZh: 她以极大的机智和耐心处理了这个敏感的问题。

entries.example: The coach changed his tactics during the second half of the game.
entries.exampleZh: 教练在比赛下半场改变了战术。

entries.meaning: 驯服的，顺从的；沉闷的，乏味的；制服，控制并利用；驯化，驯服
entries.example: The once wild horse became quite tame after months of gentle training.
entries.exampleZh: 那匹曾经野性的马经过数月温和训练后变得相当温顺。

entries.meaning: 晒成棕褐色；使晒成棕褐色；硝制；棕褐色，棕黄色；晒成棕褐色，晒黑
entries.example: She hopes to tan slowly during her holiday by the sea.
entries.exampleZh: 她希望在海边度假时慢慢晒成棕褐色。

entries.meaning: 使缠结，使纠缠；缠结，乱作一团；乱糟糟的一堆，混乱；复杂的问题；困惑
entries.example: The wires behind my desk often tangle into a messy knot.
entries.exampleZh: 我桌子后面的电线常常缠成一团乱糟糟的结。

entries.example: Her long hair became badly tangled after the windy walk.
entries.exampleZh: 大风中散步后，她的长发缠结得很厉害。

entries.example: The plumber checked the water tank on the roof this morning.
entries.exampleZh: 水管工今天早上检查了屋顶上的水箱。

entries.meaning: 油船；空中加油飞机；油轮
entries.example: A large tanker carried oil across the Atlantic last week.
entries.exampleZh: 上周一艘大型油轮运载石油横渡大西洋。

entries.example: Please tap the screen lightly to open the next page.
entries.exampleZh: 请轻敲屏幕以打开下一页。

entries.example: We need to tape the box shut before moving it.
entries.exampleZh: 搬动这个箱子之前，我们需要用胶带把它封好。

entries.example: A thin taper burned softly on the old wooden table.
entries.exampleZh: 一根细小的蜡烛在旧木桌上柔和地燃烧着。

entries.example: Workers spread hot tar across the damaged road surface.
entries.exampleZh: 工人们把滚烫的柏油铺在损坏的路面上。

entries.meaning: 目标；把…作为目标；靶，标的，目标
entries.example: The company set a clear sales target for the new year.
entries.exampleZh: 公司为新年设定了一个明确的销售目标。

entries.meaning: 关税，税率；价目表，收费表
entries.example: The new tariff on imported steel raised prices for local buyers.
entries.exampleZh: 对进口钢材征收的新关税提高了当地买家的价格。

entries.example: The soup was warm but completely tasteless without any salt.
entries.exampleZh: 这汤是热的，但一点盐都没放，完全没味道。

entries.example: The two departments will team together on the new project.
entries.exampleZh: 两个部门将在新项目上合作。

entries.meaning: 逗乐，戏弄；戏弄，取笑；挑逗，撩拨
entries.example: The older boys often tease him about his new haircut.
entries.exampleZh: 那些年纪大些的男孩常常拿他的新发型取笑他。

entries.meaning: 冗长的；冗长乏味的，沉闷的
entries.example: Copying the same data all afternoon felt extremely tedious.
entries.exampleZh: 整个下午复制同样的数据让人感到极其乏味。

entries.example: The new law will affect telecommunications across the entire region.
entries.exampleZh: 这项新法律将影响整个地区的电信行业。

entries.example: The office sent a telex to confirm the old order.
entries.exampleZh: 办公室发了一份电传以确认那份旧订单。

entries.meaning: 韧度；心情，情绪；调和，使缓和；回火
entries.example: He lost his temper when the train was delayed again.
entries.exampleZh: 火车再次晚点时，他发火了。

entries.example: Her calm temperament makes her very popular with young children.
entries.exampleZh: 她性情平和，很受幼儿喜欢。

entries.example: The tempo of the music slowed down near the end.
entries.exampleZh: 音乐的速度在接近结尾时慢了下来。

entries.meaning: 引诱，诱惑，劝诱；吸引，引起…的兴趣；引诱，诱惑
entries.example: Don't tempt me with another slice of that cake.
entries.exampleZh: 别拿那块蛋糕再切一片来引诱我。

entries.example: She resisted the temptation to check her phone during class.
entries.exampleZh: 上课时她忍住了看手机的诱惑。

entries.example: The offer sounded tempting, but I decided to wait.
entries.exampleZh: 这个提议听起来很诱人，但我决定再等等。

entries.example: The new tenant moved in at the start of June.
entries.exampleZh: 新租客在六月初搬了进来。

entries.example: He has a tendency to forget names after meeting people.
entries.exampleZh: 他见过人之后往往记不住名字。

entries.example: Engineers measured the tensile strength of the new cable.
entries.exampleZh: 工程师测量了新缆索的抗拉强度。

entries.example: You could feel the tension in the room after his remark.
entries.exampleZh: 他说完那句话后，你能感觉到房间里的紧张气氛。

entries.example: We made a tentative plan to meet next Friday.
entries.exampleZh: 我们暂定下周五见面。

entries.example: She typed the command into the terminal and waited.
entries.exampleZh: 她把命令输入终端，然后等着。

entries.example: The company may terminate the contract if payments stop.
entries.exampleZh: 如果付款停止，公司可能会终止合同。

entries.example: The doctor explained the medical terminology in simple words.
entries.exampleZh: 医生用简单的话解释了那些医学术语。

entries.meaning: 平台，阳台，露台；排屋；地坪，草坪；
entries.example: We had breakfast on the terrace overlooking the garden.
entries.exampleZh: 我们在俯瞰花园的露台上吃了早餐。

entries.example: The rocky terrain made the hike much harder than expected.
entries.exampleZh: 多岩石的地形让这次徒步比预想的难得多。

entries.meaning: 极妙的；极大的；令人恐惧的
entries.example: That was a terrific concert, and the crowd loved it.
entries.exampleZh: 那是一场极棒的演唱会，观众们非常喜欢。

entries.meaning: 使恐怖，使惊吓；使害怕，使惊吓
entries.example: Loud thunder can terrify small children at night.
entries.exampleZh: 响亮的雷声夜里会把小孩子吓坏。

entries.meaning: 领域，领土；领土，版图；领域
entries.example: Wolves mark their territory to warn off other packs.
entries.exampleZh: 狼会标记自己的领地，以警告其他狼群不要靠近。

entries.example: The police arrested a terrorist near the border last night.
entries.exampleZh: 警方昨晚在边境附近逮捕了一名恐怖分子。

entries.meaning: 证明，检验；作证；证明，证实；作证，证明；表明，说明；作证，证明
entries.example: Two witnesses will testify at the trial next week.
entries.exampleZh: 两名证人将在下周的审判中作证。

entries.example: Her testimony helped the judge understand what happened that night.
entries.exampleZh: 她的证词帮助法官了解了那天晚上发生的事。

entries.example: The rough texture of the old wooden table surprised the young children.
entries.exampleZh: 那张旧木桌粗糙的质地让年幼的孩子们感到惊讶。

entries.example: Many families travel long distances to share a special meal on Thanksgiving.
entries.exampleZh: 许多家庭长途跋涉，在感恩节共享一顿特别的饭。

entries.example: We watched a powerful play at the small theatre near the river.
entries.exampleZh: 我们在河边的小剧场观看了一出很有感染力的戏剧。

entries.meaning: 盗窃，偷窃（行为）；偷窃，失窃

entries.exampleZh: 警方逮捕了一名偷窃数辆自行车的男子。

entries.meaning: 题目；主题；主旋律；（句子的）主位；词干；主题，题目

entries.exampleZh: 这部小说的主题是友谊的重要性。

entries.example: Our teacher explained a famous theorem about right triangles in class.
entries.exampleZh: 我们老师在课堂上讲解了一个关于直角三角形的著名定理。

entries.example: Her theory about the missing keys sounded strange but possible.
entries.exampleZh: 她关于丢失钥匙的推测听起来奇怪但有可能。

entries.example: The doctor suggested physical therapy to help his injured shoulder heal.
entries.exampleZh: 医生建议用物理疗法帮助他受伤的肩膀愈合。

entries.example: He moved to a new city and lived happily thereafter.
entries.exampleZh: 他搬到了一座新城市，此后生活得很幸福。

entries.example: The road was closed, and therefore we had to take a longer route.
entries.exampleZh: 道路封闭了，因此我们不得不走一条更长的路线。

entries.example: The old contract contained a hidden rule, and therein lay the problem.
entries.exampleZh: 那份旧合同包含一条隐藏规则，问题就在其中。

entries.example: The new law and the effects thereof worried many local farmers.
entries.exampleZh: 这项新法律及其影响让许多当地农民感到担忧。

entries.meaning: 热的；温热的；热的，由热造成的；保暖的
entries.example: This jacket has a thermal lining for very cold winter days.
entries.exampleZh: 这件夹克有保暖内衬，适合非常寒冷的冬日。

entries.exampleZh: 她花了几个月写关于现代城市规划的论文。

entries.example: Add a little flour to thicken the soup before serving it.
entries.exampleZh: 上汤前加一点面粉使汤变稠。

entries.example: He injured his left thigh during the football match yesterday.
entries.exampleZh: 他昨天在足球比赛中伤到了左大腿。

entries.example: A sharp thorn stuck in my finger while I was gardening.
entries.exampleZh: 我在园艺时一根尖刺扎进了手指。

entries.example: The police conducted a thorough search of the abandoned house.
entries.exampleZh: 警方对那所废弃房屋进行了彻底搜查。

entries.example: His thoughtless remark hurt her feelings during the important meeting.
entries.exampleZh: 他在重要会议上那句欠考虑的话伤害了她的感情。

entries.example: The angry waves continued to thrash the small boat all night.
entries.exampleZh: 愤怒的海浪整夜不停地拍打小船。

entries.example: The threat of heavy rain forced us to cancel the picnic.
entries.exampleZh: 大雨的威胁迫使我们取消了野餐。

entries.meaning: 威胁；威胁，恐吓；预示快要来临；构成威胁，可能发生
entries.example: Dark clouds threaten rain, so please take an umbrella with you.
entries.exampleZh: 乌云预示着要下雨，所以请随身带把伞。

entries.example: Farmers thresh the wheat by hand in some rural areas.
entries.exampleZh: 在一些农村地区，农民用手打麦子。

entries.meaning: 门槛；门槛；入门，开端；门槛，门口；入门，开端，起始点
entries.example: She stopped at the threshold and looked back at the room.
entries.exampleZh: 她停在门口，回头望了望房间。

entries.example: My grandmother was thrifty and never wasted a single coin.
entries.exampleZh: 我奶奶很节俭，从不浪费一枚硬币。

entries.meaning: （使）激动；非常兴奋，非常激动；兴奋，激动；引起激动的事物
entries.example: The children felt a thrill when the roller coaster started.
entries.exampleZh: 过山车启动时，孩子们感到一阵兴奋。

entries.example: The final match was so thrilling that nobody left early.
entries.exampleZh: 决赛太激动人心了，没有人提前离场。

entries.meaning: 繁荣，兴旺；兴旺，繁荣，旺盛
entries.example: Small businesses thrive when the local government offers real support.
entries.exampleZh: 当地方政府提供实实在在的支持时，小企业就会兴旺发展。

entries.meaning: 王位；御座，宝座；王位，王权
entries.example: The young king sat on the throne and smiled at everyone.
entries.exampleZh: 年轻的国王坐在王位上，对所有人微笑。

entries.example: He lost his job through no fault of his own.
entries.exampleZh: 他丢了工作，并非因为自己的过错。

entries.meaning: 发出滴答声；记号，勾号；滴答声；给…标记号
entries.example: Put a tick beside the correct answer on the paper.
entries.exampleZh: 在试卷上正确答案旁边打一个勾。

entries.example: The officer gave me a ticket for parking in the wrong place.
entries.exampleZh: 警官因为我违规停车给我开了一张罚款单。

entries.meaning: 挠，胳肢；逗乐；发痒；使发痒；使高兴，逗乐；痒
entries.example: The little girl began to laugh when I tried to tickle her.
entries.exampleZh: 当我试着挠那个小女孩痒痒时，她笑了起来。

entries.example: Please tighten the screws on the shelf before you use it.
entries.exampleZh: 使用架子之前，请把上面的螺丝拧紧。

entries.example: She held the rope tightly and refused to let go.
entries.exampleZh: 她紧紧抓住绳子，不肯松手。

entries.meaning: 瓷砖；贴砖；瓦片；瓦，瓷砖；铺瓦于，贴瓷砖于
entries.example: One floor tile was broken, so we replaced it yesterday.
entries.exampleZh: 有一块地砖破了，所以我们昨天把它换掉了。

entries.example: The old painting began to tilt to the left last week.
entries.exampleZh: 那幅旧画上周开始向左倾斜。

entries.meaning: 及时的；适时的；及时的，适时的
entries.example: Her timely advice saved us from making a costly mistake.
entries.exampleZh: 她及时的建议使我们免于犯下一个代价高昂的错误。

entries.example: The timid boy hid behind his mother during the whole visit.
entries.exampleZh: 那个胆小的男孩在整个拜访过程中都躲在母亲身后。

entries.example: Waiting in long lines at the airport is really tiresome.
entries.exampleZh: 在机场排长队等候真是让人厌烦。

entries.example: The doctor examined a tissue sample under the microscope.
entries.exampleZh: 医生在显微镜下检查了一份组织样本。

entries.example: A large toad sat quietly on the wet garden path.
entries.exampleZh: 一只大蟾蜍静静地蹲在潮湿的花园小路上。

entries.meaning: 辅币；象征；象征性的，装样子的；筹码；信物，标志，纪念品；代金券，礼券
entries.example: He gave her a small token of his appreciation.
entries.exampleZh: 他送给她一件小小的信物，以表谢意。

entries.meaning: 容忍的；有耐力的；宽容的，容忍的
entries.example: My teacher is very tolerant of our careless mistakes.
entries.exampleZh: 我的老师对我们粗心的错误非常宽容。

entries.meaning: 敲；过路费，过桥费；伤亡人数，损失
entries.example: The death toll from the earthquake rose to fifty.
entries.exampleZh: 地震造成的死亡人数上升到了五十人。

entries.example: The warm tone of the painting creates a peaceful mood.
entries.exampleZh: 这幅画温暖的色调营造出一种宁静的氛围。

entries.example: The constant noise became a real torment for him.
entries.exampleZh: 持续不断的噪音对他来说成了一种真正的折磨。

entries.example: The old ship was sunk by a single torpedo.
entries.exampleZh: 那艘旧船被一枚鱼雷击沉了。

entries.example: This engine produces a lot of torque at low speeds.
entries.exampleZh: 这台发动机在低速时能产生很大的扭矩。

entries.meaning: 翻来覆去；掷钱币来决定；翻来覆去；扔，抛，掷；猛抬；拌；掷；使摇动，使颠簸；掷钱币来决定；猛抬头
entries.example: She likes to toss the salad with olive oil.
entries.exampleZh: 她喜欢用橄榄油拌沙拉。

entries.example: The exam was really tough for most of the students.
entries.exampleZh: 这场考试对大多数学生来说真的很难。

entries.example: A truck arrived to tow our broken car away.
entries.exampleZh: 一辆卡车来把我们坏了的车拖走了。

entries.example: She walked slowly towards the door without saying a word.
entries.exampleZh: 她一言不发地慢慢走向门口。

entries.example: The ancient castle seemed to tower above the small village.
entries.exampleZh: 这座古老的城堡似乎高耸于小村庄之上。

entries.meaning: 有毒的；有毒的，因中毒引起的
entries.example: The factory released toxic waste into the river last year.
entries.exampleZh: 去年那家工厂把有毒废料排入了河中。

entries.example: Police tried to trace the source of the strange call.
entries.exampleZh: 警方试图追查那通奇怪电话的来源。

entries.meaning: 追踪；轨迹，踪迹；留下足迹
entries.example: We lost track of time while talking in the garden.
entries.exampleZh: 我们在花园里聊天时忘记了时间。

entries.example: The doctor gave me a tract about healthy eating.
entries.exampleZh: 医生给了我一本关于健康饮食的小册子。

entries.example: The two countries trade goods across the narrow border.
entries.exampleZh: 这两个国家越过狭窄的边界进行货物贸易。

entries.example: The company registered its new logo as a trademark.
entries.exampleZh: 公司把新标志注册成了商标。

entries.example: There is always a tradeoff between speed and accuracy in this task.
entries.exampleZh: 在这项任务中，速度与准确性之间总是存在权衡。

entries.example: The trader sold fresh fruit at the busy morning market.
entries.exampleZh: 这位商人在繁忙的早市上卖新鲜水果。

entries.example: The skilled tradesman repaired our old wooden door in an hour.
entries.exampleZh: 这位熟练的工匠在一小时内修好了我们那扇旧木门。

entries.example: The sudden loss of their home was a terrible tragedy.
entries.exampleZh: 他们突然失去家园是一场可怕的悲剧。

entries.meaning: 悲惨的；悲剧的；悲惨的，可悲的；悲剧的
entries.example: It was a tragic accident that changed the whole village.
entries.exampleZh: 那是一场改变了整个村庄的悲惨事故。

entries.example: Patience is a useful trait for any good teacher.
entries.exampleZh: 耐心是任何优秀教师都有用的特质。

entries.meaning: 以沉重的脚步走（过）；跋涉

entries.exampleZh: 我们不得不踏着深雪跋涉到小屋。

entries.example: Please do not trample the young plants in the garden.
entries.exampleZh: 请不要踩踏花园里的幼苗。

entries.example: The lake looked calm and tranquil in the early morning light.
entries.exampleZh: 清晨的光线下，湖面显得平静而安宁。

entries.example: The bank confirmed every transaction before the shop closed for the day.
entries.exampleZh: 银行在商店当天关门前确认了每一笔交易。

entries.example: Great art can transcend the limits of its own time.
entries.exampleZh: 伟大的艺术能够超越其自身时代的局限。

entries.meaning: 搬，转移；调动，转学；转让，过户；乘车，转乘

entries.exampleZh: 我今天需要转一些钱给我妹妹。

entries.exampleZh: 新油漆能把沉闷的房间变成明亮的空间。

entries.exampleZh: 球队再次失利后，获胜的喜悦显得十分短暂。

entries.example: The old radio still works because its transistor was replaced last year.
entries.exampleZh: 这台旧收音机还能用，因为它的晶体管去年被更换了。

entries.example: The goods were damaged while in transit between the two ports.
entries.exampleZh: 这些货物在两个港口之间运输途中受损。

entries.meaning: 过渡；转变，变迁；过渡；过渡，转变

entries.exampleZh: 这个国家面临向更清洁能源系统过渡的艰难过程。

entries.exampleZh: 医生正在研究该病毒如何通过空气传播。

entries.exampleZh: 蚊子能把危险的疾病传播给温暖地区的人们。

entries.meaning: 移植（器官、皮肤等）；移植，移种（植物）；移栽，移种；移植；使迁移，使移居；移植

entries.exampleZh: 这座城市的公共交通系统既便宜又方便使用。

entries.example: The engineer measured the transverse strength of the wooden beam.
entries.exampleZh: 工程师测量了这根木梁的横向强度。

entries.example: Hunters used a net to trap the wild birds alive.
entries.exampleZh: 猎人们用网活捉了那些野鸟。

entries.example: The explorers had to traverse the desert before nightfall.
entries.exampleZh: 探险者们必须在夜幕降临前穿越沙漠。

entries.example: Please do not tread on the wet paint near the door.
entries.exampleZh: 请不要踩到门边未干的油漆。

entries.example: The club treasurer keeps careful records of every payment.
entries.exampleZh: 俱乐部的财务主管仔细记录每一笔付款。

entries.example: The two countries finally signed a peace treaty last spring.
entries.exampleZh: 两国去年春天终于签署了一项和平条约。

entries.meaning: 巨大的；极大的，非常的；精彩的，了不起的
entries.example: She felt tremendous pride when her son graduated from college.
entries.exampleZh: 儿子大学毕业时，她感到无比自豪。

entries.example: Workers dug a deep trench beside the road for the new pipes.
entries.exampleZh: 工人们在路边挖了一条深沟，用来铺设新管道。

entries.example: Rising food prices have become a worrying trend this year.
entries.exampleZh: 食品价格上涨今年已成为一个令人担忧的趋势。

entries.example: The new medicine will undergo a careful trial next month.
entries.exampleZh: 这种新药下个月将进行仔细的试验。

entries.example: The garden has a small triangular area near the back gate.
entries.exampleZh: 花园后门附近有一小块三角形区域。

entries.example: Members of the tribe still hunt and fish for their food.
entries.exampleZh: 部落成员仍然靠打猎和捕鱼获取食物。

entries.meaning: 献礼；贡物；颂词，称赞，礼物；贡品
entries.example: The song was written as a tribute to his late mother.
entries.exampleZh: 这首歌是为纪念他已故的母亲而写的。

entries.example: He used a clever trick to open the locked box.
entries.exampleZh: 他用一个巧妙的诡计打开了那个锁着的箱子。

entries.meaning: 玩忽；闲混；嬉耍；嘲笑；轻视；琐事，小事，无价值的东西
entries.example: She thought the matter was a mere trifle, not worth arguing about.
entries.exampleZh: 她认为这件事只是小事，不值得争论。

entries.meaning: 引发，引起；扳机；触发，引起；扳机；引起反应的行动

entries.exampleZh: 大雨可能引发山谷里危险的洪水。

entries.example: She asked the barber to trim her hair very short.
entries.exampleZh: 她请理发师把她的头发剪得很短。

entries.meaning: 三部分的，三方的；三倍的，三重的；增至三倍
